string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1_Ino_2_idle_s
string.body: Hey! Please listen to what I've got to say.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1_Ino_3_idle_s
string.body: We have a big problem! Krall are plotting, plotting something.

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_015_Die_S
string.body: Grrrk, you know how to play.

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_016_Batk_S
string.body: Kraark, you are not leaving just like that.

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_030_Die_S
string.body: Please avenge my death, my lord Saendukal...

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_035_Batk_S
string.body: Today... shall be the day... you die...

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_038_Katk_S
string.body: Leave... if you don't want to die...

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_040_Die_S
string.body: I'd rather have an eternal rest...

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_041_Batk_B
string.body: You will regret... having come here, [%userclass]...

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_052_Katk_S
string.body: Kraark, I'll show you the power of magic!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_053_Die_S
string.body: Grrrk, I will never forgive you.

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_060_Batk_S
string.body: Kraark, it's been a while since I last tasted blood!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_065_Die_S
string.body: Grrrk, you are not bad at all...

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_066_Die_S
string.body: Please avenge my death, my lord Saendukal...

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_071_Katk_S
string.body: Kraark, I'll give you a hot lesson!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_076_Batk_S
string.body: Kraark, how dare you come here!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_078_Katk_S
string.body: You not so bad. Worthy opponent!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_084_Katk_S
string.body: Here, just take two more hits!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_085_Katk_S
string.body: Here, just take one more hit!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_095_Batk_S
string.body: You don't seem to be afraid of me.

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_097_Die_S
string.body: It hurts, I don't want to die.

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_098_Idle_S
string.body: I worked too long and I'm tired.

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_099_Idle_S
string.body: I can't work, I'm too hungry.

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_100_Batk_S
string.body: I'll hit you just a little.

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_102_Atk_S
string.body: Just go down already, blast it...

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_103_Flee_S
string.body: Spare me! I only did what I was told to do.

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_104_Die_S
string.body: There are still so many things to do...

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_105_Die_S
string.body: So, this is how Kobold dies...

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_106_Idle_S
string.body: I work too much. It's hard.

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_107_Idle_S
string.body: And they don't even give us enough food to live on! What a life, nyerk.

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_113_Die_S
string.body: I want to be born as a Krall in next life...

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_GOBLIN_002
string.body: The meal-time bell has rung! Time to eat!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_GOBLIN_003
string.body: It's the meal-time bell! Time to eat!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_GOBLIN_005
string.body: I'm very hungry! I'm going to eat and eat a lot.

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_119_Batk_S
string.body: Kraark, what an absurd pup! Daring to attack me!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_120_Katk_S
string.body: I shall soak this place with your blood!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_123_Katk_S
string.body: I'll show you the true horror!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_124_Die_S
string.body: How, how did I... To, to a mere Elyos...

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_125_Die_S
string.body: I will never forget this shame...

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_127_Idle_S
string.body: I will brief you on your mission.

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_128_Idle_S
string.body: The time has come to reveal the hidden power of the Elyos.

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_129_Atk_S
string.body: [%userclass], someone is waiting for you at the Outer Dock!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_130_Atk_S
string.body: Hey, [%userclass], go to the Outer Dock!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_131_Atk_S
string.body: Go and talk to Bella in the Outer Dock.

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_132_Atk_S
string.body: Hey you [%userclass], what are you dallying about?

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_133_Atk_S
string.body: Leave this place to me and just go!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_134_Atk_S
string.body: Are you [%username]? Let us leave quickly!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_135_Batk_S
string.body: Get out of here right now!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_137_Atk_S
string.body: Are you all right over there?

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_138_Eatk_S
string.body: So, there is one less after this...

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_139_Batk_S
string.body: There is not even a moment to rest, eh...

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_141_Atk_S
string.body: I won't let you get away from me!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_142_Eatk_S
string.body: You will not set a single foot in here as long as I'm around!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_144_Atk_S
string.body: Get out of here right now!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_150_Eatk_S
string.body: Just when is the reinforcement going to come...

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_153_Idle_S
string.body: The shaman is looking for you [%usergender], so go quickly.

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_154_Idle_S
string.body: The shaman is waiting for you below the ruins to the northwest from here.

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_155_Idle_S
string.body: I sense something ominous in the west.

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_156_Idle_S
string.body: What will be the fate of Elysea...

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_160_Idle_S
string.body: Now even they are... Just what are they intending to do?

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_161_Idle_S
string.body: Lately, I've been seeing a number of shady characters.

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_162_Idle_S
string.body: I hear there are some curious creatures in the Krall encampment.

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_164_Idle_S
string.body: Are you here to receive supplies?

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_166_Idle_S
string.body: Hold this place with your life!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_167_Batk_S
string.body: Confound it, they are here again!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_170_Eatk_S
string.body: I'm so sick and tired of these battles!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_171_Batk_S
string.body: Hahaha! You dare to attack me!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_FIELDOBJECT_001
string.body: It cannot be used right now.

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_SHANDURA_001
string.body: You'll see how fearsome this sword is!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_181_Idle_S
string.body: Are you [%username]? I have been waiting for you.

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_182_Idle_S
string.body: Are you the [%userclass] who volunteered for the advance party?

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_183
string.body: You cowards, ganging up like this on just one foe!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_184_Atk_S
string.body: It's all right! We can win!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_185_Atk_S
string.body: Keep it up for just a little longer.

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_186_Atk_S
string.body: You will not escape from here!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_188_Atk_S
string.body: You aren't so bad for a Krall!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_189_Atk_S
string.body: You are no match for me!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_191_Atk_S
string.body: Ugh, you are not bad at all...

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_192_Idle_S
string.body: Oh no, the shaman's prophecy is really going to...

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_199_Atk_S
string.body: You aren't so bad, are you? But still there is no way you will defeat me!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_200_Idle_S
string.body: There must be something important to take care of, [%usergender], for you to have come all the way here.

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_201_Idle_S
string.body: There are many Krall about, so be careful around here!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_202_Idle_S
string.body: When the bell rings we eat.

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_203_Idle_S
string.body: I want to eat. Ring the bell.

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_205_Idle_S
string.body: I'm hungry. I hope the bell rings soon.

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_GOBLIN_HELP_002
string.body: Master gave an order! Kobold attack!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_WARNING_BELL_002
string.body: It is the alarm! Kraark, what is happening?

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_WARNING_BELL_003
string.body: Kraark, good. It's been a while since I had a workout!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_206_Katk_S
string.body: Rise again, the spirit of Darkness!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_207_Katk_S
string.body: Answer my call, the spirit of the dead!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_208_Katk_S
string.body: O walking deads, fight for Lord Saendukal!

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_MUSHROOM_POLYMORPH_001
string.body: You feel a strange sensation. You have turned into a mushroom.

string.name: STR_CHAT_E3_GOBLIN_MANAGER_001
string.body: I do not run! I fight to the end!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1A_LUSIS_1_Waypoint
string.body: The Kobolds are rather quiet today.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1A_Naia_1_WayPoint
string.body: The porgus is quite fat, looks like Cannon has been feeding it well.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LC1_NPC_Ulaguru_2_idle_s
string.body: Kraark, I'm hungry. Marmeia! When are you going to feed me?

string.name: STR_CHAT_LC1_NPC_Ulaguru_3_idle_s
string.body: Kraark, Krall are much stronger than Daevas!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LC1_NPC_Ulaguru_4_idle_s
string.body: Kraark, you better be prepared! Soon my brothers will come to rescue me!

string.name: STR_CHAT_AbPRo_003_Idle_S
string.body: Wow! It is the Protector of Sanctum, [%username]!

string.name: STR_CHAT_AbPRo_004_Idle_S
string.body: Now that [%username] is here, the tide of the battle should turn in our favour.

string.name: STR_CHAT_AbPRo_013_Atk_S
string.body: We will not let you wretches to take the Abyss!

string.name: STR_CHAT_AbPRo_015_Atk_S
string.body: So, what do you think? The power of Pandaemonium, that is!

string.name: STR_CHAT_AbPRo_018_Atk_S
string.body: Do you sense the power of Archon?

string.name: STR_CHAT_AbPRo_022_Idle_S
string.body: [%username], please show those wretches the might of Sanctum!

string.name: STR_CHAT_AbPRo_024_Batk_S
string.body: I smell an Elyos. There is an intruder!

string.name: STR_CHAT_AbPRo_025_Batk_S
string.body: It is the punishment of Lord Orissan!

string.name: STR_CHAT_AbPRo_030_Batk_S
string.body: Who the hell is it? Who dares to disturb my slumber!

string.name: STR_CHAT_AbPRo_033_Die_S
string.body: What a shameful way to die, defeated by a Guardian!

string.name: STR_CHAT_postman_03_Idle_B
string.body: Time is silver my friend, akakak!

string.name: STR_CHAT_postman_04_Idle_B
string.body: There is no mail for you, nyerk.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1Farmer_002_Atk_B
string.body: I spent so much time and effort to grow these crops!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1Guard_001_Atk_S
string.body: There is just no end to them and they keep coming!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1Guard_002_Atk_S
string.body: These accursed wretches do not even tire!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1Shugo_001_Idle_S
string.body: We have some nice stuff! Come and have a look, akakak.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1Shugo_002_Idle_S
string.body: Do you want to have a look at the Shugo specialities?

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1NPC_001_Idle_S
string.body: The Kerubs have been particularly persistent lately.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1NPC_002_Idle_S
string.body: We really are in big trouble, with all our crops plundered.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1Guard_003_Idle_S
string.body: I believe even the Akarios village is in danger right now.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1Guard_004_Idle_S
string.body: The Daminu forest is also quite eerie.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1NPC_004_Idle_S
string.body: Hey, keep quiet over there! All the fish are getting away!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1Guard_005_Idle_S
string.body: The movements of the Kobolds have been quite suspicious.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1Guard_006_Idle_S
string.body: Those darned Krall, just what do they have in mind, I wonder?

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1NPC_005_Idle_S
string.body: Ouch, my back! My whole body is aching.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1NPC_007_Idle_S
string.body: There is something ominous about the flow of Aether.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1aGuard_001_Idle_S
string.body: The movements of Tursin of late have been...

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1aGuard_002_Idle_S
string.body: Yet another large scale battle has begun in the Abyss.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1aBroadCaster_001_Idle_B
string.body: Nesia has given birth to a son!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1aBroadCaster_002_Idle_B
string.body: Please be careful! There are lots of things floating in the sky above the Citadel nowadays.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1aBroadCaster_003_Idle_B
string.body: The general store is currently selling a selection of items at a low price.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1aBroadCaster_004_Idle_B
string.body: The entrance of Tolbas Forest is infested with Worgs.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1aBroadCaster_005_Idle_B
string.body: Uno from the Akarios village has won the 1st prize in the Sanctum Cooking Contest.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1aBroadCaster_006_Idle_B
string.body: It is currently the Week of Pilgrimage. Please visit the Holy Ground and show your respect to the Five Empyrean Lords.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1aBroadCaster_007_Idle_B
string.body: Gaurinerk and Toroonerk are providing consignment sales services. Please use it often, thank you.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1aBroadCaster_008_Idle_B
string.body: Poppy, a porgus from the Tolbas village, has gone missing. If you have seen Poppy, please contact Cannon.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1aGuard_004_Idle_S
string.body: I guarantee the safety of the Tolbas village.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1aNPC_001_Idle_S
string.body: I'm going crazy because of my worthless husband, really.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1aNPC_002_Idle_S
string.body: Hurting the tree, the Wriggot is.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1aNPC_003_Idle_S
string.body: A threat to the forest is also a threat to the Elim.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1aNPC_004_Idle_S
string.body: I hear the song of trees.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1aNPC_006_Idle_S
string.body: Must stop the Sapiens, to protect the forest.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1aNPC_007_Idle_S
string.body: I sense the Aether is in its fullness.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1aGuard_005_Idle_S
string.body: There is no anomaly in the flow of the Aether.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1aGuard_006_Idle_S
string.body: Lepharist Revolutionaries are really getting on my nerves.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1_Mercenary_002_Atk_B
string.body: You've asked for it, I'll finish you all today!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1_Mercenary_003_Atk_B
string.body: These accursed wretches do not even tire!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LC1_Mikero_1_idle_s
string.body: Just looking at you makes me want to recite a poem, [%username].

string.name: STR_CHAT_LC1_Mikero_2_idle_s
string.body: Oh, there is no one greater than [%username] under the skies of Atreia.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LC1_Mikero_3_idle_s
string.body: All of Elysea shall come to their knees before [%username]'s name.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LC1_Demodocos_1_idle_s
string.body: Hey, [%username]. Reading your face tells me that you will be wandering around for the rest of your life.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LC1_Demodocos_2_idle_s
string.body: Beware when you board the ship, today. Your fortune says you'll fall overboard.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LC1_Demodocos_3_idle_s
string.body: [%username], don't you have many concerns lately? Come and see me if you are curious about the future.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LC1_Phokas_1_idle_s
string.body: The ship bound for the Outer Airship Dock will arrive soon!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LC1_Phokas_2_idle_s
string.body: Please wait here for the ship if you want to go to the Outer Airship Dock!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LC1_Phokas_3_idle_s
string.body: For your safety, please board the ship after it has completely stopped moving.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LC1_Shugo_c19_1_idle_s
string.body: Careful when you board. You might fall if you aren't, akakak!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LC1_Shugo_c19_2_idle_s
string.body: The ship is coming, the ship is coming, nyerk!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LC1_Shugo_c19_3_idle_s
string.body: Make sure to visit Dionysia when you are in the Outer Airship Dock. The food there is fabulous, akakak.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Q2240_2_idle_B
string.body: It feels as if something might jump out.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Q2258_idle_B
string.body: Hmm, hmm, the young and exalted Archon Grak has subjugated Impetusium!

string.name: STR_CHAT_DF1A_DF1_Jailer_1_idle_s
string.body: Be quiet! I'm telling you to keep your mouth shut.

string.name: STR_CHAT_DF1A_DF1_Jailer_2_idle_s
string.body: You lot are sadly mistaken if you thought Kinah would be useful here, you greedy pigs!

string.name: STR_CHAT_DF1A_DF1_Jailer_3_idle_s
string.body: You dared to rebel against Lord Azphel! Even this dungeon is too good for the likes of you lot.

string.name: STR_CHAT_DF1A_DF1_Jailer_4_idle_s
string.body: Feh, you Balaur minion scums! You are all so dead.

string.name: STR_CHAT_DF1A_Irehilt_002_Atk_S
string.body: Ugh, they are trying to hurt me!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LC1BroadCaster_001_Idle_B
string.body: Glory and praises to the protector of Atreia, the Empyrian Lady Ariel!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LC1BroadCaster_002_Idle_B
string.body: The Protectorate has achieved a tremendous victory in the Battle of Abyss!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LC1BroadCaster_003_Idle_B
string.body: The airship has arrived at the port! Please hurry if you are traveling to the Outer Port!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LC1BroadCaster_004_Idle_B
string.body: Verteron Citadel is currently recruiting Daevas who are willing to take part in removing the floating objects.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LC1BroadCaster_005_Idle_B
string.body: Please use the Hall of Prosperity if you wish to sell on consignment basis, thank you!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LC1BroadCaster_006_Idle_B
string.body: Are you curious about your fortunes for today? Then please seek Demodocos in the Artisans Hall!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LC1BroadCaster_007_Idle_B
string.body: Heerunerk and Yiehmonerk are upgrading the Cubes at a bargain price in the Hall of Prosperity.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LC1BroadCaster_008_Idle_B
string.body: The Coliseum is waiting for Daevas who are willing to train their combat abilities. Please don't hesitate to visit the Coliseum if you are one of them.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF3_Little1_002_Idle_S
string.body: I'm afraid, of those filled with so much hate that they refuse to die even when they are dead.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF3_Little1_003_Idle_S
string.body: Save us from this hell, Lord Trajanus will

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF3_Little2_001_Idle_S
string.body: To fill the ends of my leaves, I want to drink the clear water.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF3_Little2_002_Idle_S
string.body: To fight against them, I am too weak.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF3_Little2_003_Idle_S
string.body: I fear more than death itself, turning into an Agrint.

string.name: STR_CHAT_AbPRoD2_003_Idle_S
string.body: O Azphel! Please take a kindly interest in the Protector of Pandaemonium, [%username]!

string.name: STR_CHAT_AbPRoD2_004_Idle_S
string.body: As [%username] has come, those Elyos packs are as good as dead!

string.name: STR_CHAT_GuardianAssassin_001_Atk_S
string.body: I'll not let you reach Lord Hellion!

string.name: STR_CHAT_DF1a_Serpine_1_idle_s
string.body: Who the hell is it? Be gone if you are an Asmodian scum!

string.name: STR_CHAT_DF1a_Serpine_2_idle_s
string.body: It is about time my Guardian comrades came to rescue me...

string.name: STR_CHAT_DF1a_Serpine_3_idle_s
string.body: The food here is terrible, really. Even the porgus gruel would taste better than this.

string.name: STR_CHAT_DF1_Lycan_Captured_2_idle_s
string.body: Excuse me. Take me to see Captain Suthran, please.

string.name: STR_CHAT_DF1_Lycan_Captured_3_idle_s
string.body: We are emissaries from the Silver Mane tribe who came requesting for help. We aren't here to attack you!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Araison_1_idle_s
string.body: Beholding thy majestic presence inspired me to come up with a wonderful poem, [%username].

string.name: STR_CHAT_Araison_2_idle_s
string.body: I, Araison, have composed a poem for thee, [%username]. Would thou like to hear it?

string.name: STR_CHAT_Araison_3_idle_s
string.body: Well well, I have yet another follower. I just can't help but being popular.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Epren_1_idle_s
string.body: Oh my! You saw, you saw that right? Master Araison looked at my direction and smiled at me!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Epren_2_idle_s
string.body: We love you so much, Master Araison!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Epren_3_idle_s
string.body: That melancholy stare, razor-sharp nose, and the gentle voice... Aah, he is perfection itself!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Geiena_1_idle_s
string.body: Here, Master Araison! Geiena is here again today!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Geiena_3_idle_s
string.body: Sigh, I wonder what sort of woman Master Araison likes?

string.name: STR_CHAT_Agamo_1_idle_s
string.body: Ho-hum, I can't think of any musical motif today.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Agamo_2_idle_s
string.body: Should I compose a military march for the Archons on the battlefield?

string.name: STR_CHAT_Agamo_3_idle_s
string.body: It might be interesting to make music from the sound of flowing water.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Lindhog_1_idle_s
string.body: May the protection of Azphel be with [%username], who visited Pandaemonium!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Lindhog_2_idle_s
string.body: If you have come looking for a Class Master then please make your way to the Great Temple.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Lindhog_3_idle_s
string.body: Please use the Temple of Gold if you wish to sell on consignment basis, thank you!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Lindhog_4_idle_s
string.body: This is an urgent message! Our Archon Legion has achieved a tremendous victory in the Battle of Abyss!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Lindhog_5_idle_s
string.body: Stores on the Prosperity Road have just been stocked with many new items.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Lindhog_6_idle_s
string.body: A teleport statue linking the Vifrost Bridge and Prosperity Road has been erected. Please use it often, thank you.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Lindhog_7_idle_s
string.body: Mistress Deyla is looking for witnesses of the Temple of Artisans incident.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Eiren_1_idle_s
string.body: Hm, this shipment of fabrics looks pretty good. We may get some pretty good designs out of it.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Eiren_2_idle_s
string.body: How come they are still not here with the fabrics! I'll never deal with those scoundrels of the Quairerk Traders again.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Eiren_3_idle_s
string.body: Welcome, [%username]! Here to buy some new clothes? Lark will show you the clothes catalogue, so do browse carefully and make your decision.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Wise_1_idle_s
string.body: Huoh, the fire is a bit strong. I'd better reduce it.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Wise_2_idle_s
string.body: I wonder when will I become as good as Master Kinterun?

string.name: STR_CHAT_Veldina_1_idle_s
string.body: May there be blessing of prosperity on [%username]!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Veldina_3_idle_s
string.body: If you want to use the Legion warehouse, please enter the room behind me.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Emvelu_1_idle_s
string.body: [%username], how about going to the Apellbine Tavern since you haven't had supper yet? Its food is very cheap and delicious.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Emvelu_2_idle_s
string.body: A roasted Conide is a mere 150 Kinah at the Apellbine Tavern! Ah, it's just so cheap!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Emvelu_3_idle_s
string.body: Are you planning any social gathering? We Apellbine have exclusive rooms ready for such group customers.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Kanensa_1_idle_s
string.body: The air current feels rather precarious. I don't think the airship can leave the ground under these conditions.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Kanensa_2_idle_s
string.body: O the canyon-rushing wind, please stop your run for a little while.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Kanensa_3_idle_s
string.body: The wind has stopped! Please board the airship quickly, hurry.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Annju_1_idle_s
string.body: It's OK. Nobody would have seen it...

string.name: STR_CHAT_Annju_2_idle_s
string.body: Oh, should I flee from here? If a Shadow Executor caught me while I stayed here...

string.name: STR_CHAT_Annju_3_idle_s
string.body: Calm down, Annju! You did nothing wrong! All you did was buying a ticket for someone!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Skia_1_idle_s
string.body: What would happen to the value of Daevas and Humans if we were to return to the flow of Aether?

string.name: STR_CHAT_Skia_2_idle_s
string.body: Is Aether really equal for everybody? Does that mean Daevas and Humans are also equal, too?

string.name: STR_CHAT_Skia_3_idle_s
string.body: Are the Aether that comprise our body and the Aether that we consume to exert power identical, or are they something totally different altogether?

string.name: STR_CHAT_Bodrug_1_idle_s
string.body: That would depend on where you place the value itself, wouldn't it?

string.name: STR_CHAT_Bodrug_2_idle_s
string.body: I think the concept of what Aether is must be established first before we could discuss that particular subject.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Bodrug_3_idle_s
string.body: Hm... Don't you think it would be best to ask that question to Master Sterlin?

string.name: STR_CHAT_Herpa_1_idle_s
string.body: Aren't you thirsty, [%username]? The Ringa juice of our Apellbine is perfect for quenching thirst, you know!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Herpa_2_idle_s
string.body: You hardly visit us these days, [%username]! At this rate I'll even forget what you look like.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Herpa_3_idle_s
string.body: Welcome, [%username]! Please go inside and taste the Mosbear honey cookies we just baked.

string.name: STR_CHAT_DF1aBroadCaster_001_Idle_B
string.body: Lepharist Revolutionaries have shown up at the Altgard Ice Lake. Please take extra care when you visit the lake.

string.name: STR_CHAT_DF1aBroadCaster_002_Idle_B
string.body: They are looking for workers in Impetusium. Please inquire to Banatisai if you are interested.

string.name: STR_CHAT_DF1aBroadCaster_003_Idle_B
string.body: The Moslan Forest is shrouded in a thick fog. Please be ware of Karnifs if you are going to the forest.

string.name: STR_CHAT_DF1aBroadCaster_004_Idle_B
string.body: Mosbears are running wild near the Basfelt Village. Common villagers should refrain from visiting the Basfelt Village, for now.

string.name: STR_CHAT_DF1aBroadCaster_005_Idle_B
string.body: Anyone who has seen Sapiens or the Lepharist Revolutionaries near the fortress should report it to an Archon Sentinel at once.

string.name: STR_CHAT_DF1aBroadCaster_006_Idle_B
string.body: Leinolz the herder has gone missing. If anyone knows where he is, then please contact his fiancÃ© Irehilt.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Monster_FakeGrailKeeper_Q2036_001_Atk_S
string.body: Foolish one, you shall pay dearly for this!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Monster_FakeGrailKeeper_Q2036_002_Atk_S
string.body: Death is the price you will pay for your greed!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF2BroadCaster_001_Idle_B
string.body: Asmodians have been infiltrating through a Rift. All residents should be on their guard.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF2BroadCaster_002_Idle_B
string.body: There have been an increasing number of robberies by Manduris lately. Please be careful when you are going through the Manduri Forest.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF2BroadCaster_003_Idle_B
string.body: The desertification of Eltnen is becoming more serious. Please put your efforts into protecting the Mystic Spring and trees.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF2BroadCaster_004_Idle_B
string.body: A strange creature is being seen every night in the Kuriullu Mountain. Please be careful when you are visiting the Agairon Village.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF2BroadCaster_005_Idle_B
string.body: You cannot use the Mystic Spring of Laquepin at the moment because a small problem has occurred.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF2BroadCaster_006_Idle_B
string.body: Eracus Temple Cavern is a dangerous place. Please bear in mind that common villagers are forbidden to go near the place.

string.name: STR_CHAT_DF2BroadCaster_001_Idle_B
string.body: Elyos have been infiltrating through a Rift. All residents should be on their guard.

string.name: STR_CHAT_DF2BroadCaster_002_Idle_B
string.body: If you have any clue about the Daeva who has gone missing lately, then please contact the Centurion or Anund.

string.name: STR_CHAT_DF2BroadCaster_003_Idle_B
string.body: If you want to receive a Coin Quest or a reward, then please go and visit Coin Administrator Nott or Vebna.

string.name: STR_CHAT_DF2BroadCaster_004_Idle_B
string.body: Taygas have been raiding the fortress at night. Please be careful when you are out during the night.

string.name: STR_CHAT_DF2BroadCaster_005_Idle_B
string.body: Use of the Halabana Hot Springs is now prohibited. Let there be no unfortunate accidents by approaching the hot spring, please.

string.name: STR_CHAT_DF2BroadCaster_006_Idle_B
string.body: A protection order has been issued for the Elim in the Patamor Thicket. We hope for much interest and cooperation from the residents.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Ab1BroadCasterL_001_Idle_B
string.body: The battle mothership of the Balaur, Dredgion, has been seen often lately. Please be extra careful when you move to another region.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Ab1BroadCasterL_002_Idle_B
string.body: The battles for the artefact continue to rage in the Sulphur Archipelago.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Ab1BroadCasterL_003_Idle_B
string.body: Asmodians are continuing their provocations in the upper Western Shard of Latesran. Please be on your guard, and do not fall for their evil lies.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Ab1BroadCasterL_004_Idle_B
string.body: The number of Balaur are increasing on the Drakenwreck. All Daevas must rise up to drive the Balaur out. For the glory of Sanctum!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Ab1BroadCasterL_005_Idle_B
string.body: More and more Daevas are disappearing near the Solitary Island. As we don't know what is happening yet, please be careful when you pass near the area.

string.name: STR_CHAT_DF2BroadCasterD_001_Idle_B
string.body: The battle mothership of the Balaur, Dredgion, has been seen often lately. Please be extra careful when you move to another region.

string.name: STR_CHAT_DF2BroadCasterD_002_Idle_B
string.body: The battles for the artefact continue to rage in the Sulphur Archipelago.

string.name: STR_CHAT_DF2BroadCasterD_003_Idle_B
string.body: Elyos are continuing their provocations in the upper Eastern Shard of Latesran. Please be on your guard, and do not be tricked for their wicked schemes.

string.name: STR_CHAT_DF2BroadCasterD_004_Idle_B
string.body: The number of Balaur are increasing at the Grave of Claws. It is time for all Daevas to rise up to drive the Balaur out. For the prosperity of Pandaemonium!

string.name: STR_CHAT_DF2BroadCasterD_005_Idle_B
string.body: More and more Daevas are disappearing near the Shade Island. As we don't know what is happening yet, please be careful when you pass near the area.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDF3_lp_Stein_001_Idle_s
string.body: I'm... Thirsty. If only I could have a sip of wine.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDF3_lp_Stein_002_Idle_s
string.body: Just one cup of Kirka Wine will stop this pain...

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDF3_lp_Stein_003_Idle_s
string.body: Wine... Give me wine. Just a sip of Kirka wine...

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF2a_Guardian_001_Idle_B
string.body: Wait, [%username]! Are you really heading for the Parched Barrens? That area is very dangerous.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF2a_Guardian_002_Idle_B
string.body: Where are you going? The Parched Barrens is really dangerous. You must be very careful.

string.name: STR_CHAT_DF2a_ArchonGuard_001_Idle_B
string.body: Wait, [%username]! Are you really heading for Sudorville? That area is very dangerous.

string.name: STR_CHAT_DF2a_ArchonGuard_002_Idle_B
string.body: Where are you going? If you are heading for Sudorville, you must be very careful.

string.name: STR_CHAT_AbPRo_034_Batk_S
string.body: Aren't you reckless, to come alone to face me!

string.name: STR_CHAT_AbPRo_035_Atk_S
string.body: Haha, not bad, not bad at all! But this might be too much for you to handle!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDAB1_Dreadgion_ShugoExhausted_002_Idle_S
string.body: I must escape...Escape from here, nyerk.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTemple_Fanatic_001_Idle_S
string.body: You brute! Why harm Lord Vallakhan?

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTemple_Fanatic_002_Idle_S
string.body: Help! Lord Vallakhan is in danger!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTemple_Fanatic_003_Idle_S
string.body: By Fregion's might! How could this happen?

string.name: STR_CHAT_Palentine_002_Idle_S
string.body: Here, try these. They're from a new line.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Mione_001_Idle_S
string.body: What are you are wearing, [%username]? Carrin can make you something much better.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Mione_002_Idle_S
string.body: Old man Daskin is going down!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Timogand_002_Idle_S
string.body: Really? You think that [%mainslotitem] matches your outfit? Pull the other one.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Horitius_01_001_Idle_S
string.body: Inggison Outpost is looking for skilled [%userclass]s.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Horitius_01_002_Idle_S
string.body: For your own safety, passengers heading for Soteria Sanctuary should board the Air Line.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Horitius_01_003_Idle_S
string.body: Sanctum flight 714 will be leaving from the Aerolink. Please form an orderly line at the north end of the square.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Horitius_02_001_Idle_S
string.body: It's awful! The Altar of Avarice and the Temple of Scales have fallen to the Asmodians.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Horitius_02_002_Idle_S
string.body: All Elyos in Inggison! Please, hurry to defend Inggison Outpost!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Horitius_02_003_Idle_S
string.body: We must help Veille the Agent. Let's all try the Blessing of Concentration!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Etard_01_001_Idle_S
string.body: Someone just told me a Dredgion has crashed on the Antagor Battlefield!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Etard_01_002_Idle_S
string.body: For your own safety, travelers heading for Rhonnam Refugee Village should board the Air Line.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Etard_02_001_Idle_S
string.body: Shards! The Glow-worms have taken the Vorgaltem Citadel and the Crimson Temple.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Etard_02_002_Idle_S
string.body: Asmodians in Gelkmaros! Gelkmaros Defence Base needs your strength! Now!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Etard_02_003_Idle_S
string.body: Azphel's shadow falls on Mastarius the Agent. Give him your strongest Blessing of Devotion!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Wonded_01_Idle_S
string.body: Just a flesh wound, nothing more...

string.name: STR_CHAT_Wonded_02_Idle_S
string.body: Hello? Doctor? Any doctor? There are healers in this place, right?

string.name: STR_CHAT_SWonded_02_Idle_S
string.body: Argh, I can't lay here like this...

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF4_Guard_02_Idle_S
string.body: No one will stand in our way.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF4_Guard_01_Atk_S
string.body: Prepare to die for what you've done.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF4_ShugoSupplyer_01_Idle_S
string.body: I move boxes here. I move boxes there. Then move boxes back. Sometimes I think, just leave boxes where they are.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF4_ShugoMaker_01_Idle_S
string.body: Ah, so good to see you! Let me squeeze you into my schedule.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDElim_Enalethe_Wounded
string.body: Are you just going to stand there and watch? Please come and help!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDElim_Enalethe_Die
string.body: Ouch, to be done in by some bugs...

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDElim_Enalethe_Win
string.body: Thank you, [%userclass]. You really saved me there.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDElim_Hyas_Idle
string.body: Damn! I'm always out of breath whenever I get to Taloc. Gasp... Gasp...

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDElim_Hyas_Despawn
string.body: Gasp...Gasp, I can't stand it anymore! I'm sorry but I'll leave first.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_02_ShulackWorker_01_Idle_s
string.body: How much longer do I have to carry this around? I want to go home!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_02_ShulackWorker_02_Idle_s
string.body: Leave? Leave! And run into a Balaur guard? No sharding way.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDElim_Engeius_Yell_02
string.body: I am a Templar. I will protect you.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDElim_Abyla_Yell_02
string.body: I am a Cleric. I can cast healing magic.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDElim_Engeius_Yell_03
string.body: Will you accompany me? Tell me if you will.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDElim_Abyla_Yell_03
string.body: Let me know if you need my help.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDElementalGossip44_02_Idle_S
string.body: Tuali served Davlin... But something's wrong with him now...

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDElementalGossip55_01_Idle_S
string.body: Do you hear those noises coming from the rock?

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDElementalGossip66_01_Idle_S
string.body: There are too many Macori! Kutol is scary...

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDElementalGossip66_02_Idle_S
string.body: They have a leader... It's Kutol, Kutol...

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF4_IDArenaGossip_02_Idle
string.body: If you want to be trained at Kaisinel Academy, please go and see Noratha!

string.name: STR_CHAT_DF4_IDArenaGossip_02_Idle
string.body: If you want to challenge the Empyrean Crucible, please see Virvain!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDYunGossip_01_Idle_S
string.body: Merops, you traitor! You'll pay for your perfidy!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDYunGossip_10_Idle_S
string.body: Daevas are here to help us!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDYunGossip_12_Idle_S
string.body: I never thought it would end like this...

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDYunGossip_15_Idle_S
string.body: This is all that lizard-loving traitor's fault!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDYunGossip_17_Idle_S
string.body: This is worse than I thought.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDYunGossip_18_Idle_S
string.body: Which plan is better? I'm no tactician, so I don't know.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF4b_Redina_01_Atk_S
string.body: Why won't this Worg just die?

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF4b_Redina_02_Atk_S
string.body: Ooh, this will make a killer cloak!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF4b_Redina_03_Atk_S
string.body: Fur that thick must be nice and warm...

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF4b_Redina_04_Atk_S
string.body: Grandpa will flip when he sees this pelt!

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_Lf_Personal_02_Idle_C
string.body: Everyone wants to own their own home! Vexramas can help you get your own studio.

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_Lf_Personal_04_Idle_C
string.body: Here you can find all you need for Armoursmithing, Metalsmithing, Handicrafting, and Construction.

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_Lf_Personal_05_Idle_C
string.body: Here you can find all you need for Armoursmithing, Metalsmithing, Handicrafting, and Construction.

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_Lf_Personal_06_Idle_C
string.body: What'll it take to get you into a new mount today?

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_Lf_Personal_08_Idle_C
string.body: Ore prices are going up and up. Buy now. I'm selling at last year's prices!

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_Lf_Personal_09_Idle_C
string.body: Buy two and keep one for later!

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_Lf_Personal_10_Idle_C
string.body: I sell the finest, purest ore you can buy.

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_Lf_Personal_11_Idle_C
string.body: New ore mining prospects are an incredible investment opportunity.

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_Lf_Personal_12_Idle_C
string.body: This is a decent price, but I bet it'll be cheaper next week.

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_Lf_Personal_16_Idle_C
string.body: This year's harvest was disappointing. Prices are up everywhere.

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_Lf_Personal_18_Idle_C
string.body: Okay, okay, I'll take them all. Don't crowd me, there's no rush!

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_Lf_Personal_19_Idle_C
string.body: We've got some quality stuff. Take a look, hey?

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_Lf_Personal_20_Idle_C
string.body: Wow, that has got to be a million-Kinah item.

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_Lf_Personal_21_Idle_C
string.body: We sell sea shells, fresh from the shimmering shore!

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_Lf_Personal_22_Idle_C
string.body: Fresh fish, caught just this morning!

string.body: [%username], you should really invest in real estate. Go talk to Vexramas in Oriel Plaza.

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_Lf_Personal_02_Idle_A

string.body: You must be a powerful Sorcerer, to cast such a spell on my heart. May I buy you a drink, Mage of my soul?

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_Lf_Personal_03_Idle_B
string.body: Ugh, I'd rather kiss a lizard.

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_Lf_Personal_04_Idle_B
string.body: Um, can I get back to you on that?

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_Lf_Personal_05_Idle_B
string.body: There are some things money can't buy.

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_Lf_Personal_06_Idle_B

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_Lf_Personal_07_Idle_B

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_Lf_Personal_08_Idle_B

string.body: Visit Tezz's for the finest in interior design.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LDF4b_Elder_Y_01_Idle_S
string.body: Tiamat is not invincible, but we must prepare well for this fight.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LDF4b_Elder_Y_02_Idle_S
string.body: Breaking through Tiamaranta's defences was only the beginning.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LDF4b_Elder_Y_03_Idle_S
string.body: We must never forget what our ancestors sacrificed for.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LDF4b_Elder_Y_04_Idle_S
string.body: Tense as it may be, our alliance with the Elyos and Asmodians is the only way to crush the Dragon Lord.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LDF4b_Elder_Y_05_Idle_S
string.body: Remain steadfast, and trust in Kahrun!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LDF4b_Elder_Y_06_Idle_S
string.body: If we follow Kahrun, we will succeed. See how far he has already brought us!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LDF4b_Elder_Y_07_Idle_S
string.body: History will remember us as witnesses to the death of a Dragon Lord.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LDF4b_Elder_Y_08_Idle_S
string.body: We shall restore Siel's Temple to glory!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LDF4b_Brax_Manager_Y_02_Idle_S
string.body: Can we ship all this today?

string.name: STR_CHAT_LDF4b_Brax_Manager_Y_04_Idle_S
string.body: It looks healthy enough, but I'm still going to check its teeth.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LDF4b_Brax_Manager_Y_05_Idle_S
string.body: This weather has been fortuitous. The supply shipments come through so much faster in fine weather.

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_LF_Compliment_1
string.body: [%username], that outfit looks spectacular on you.

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_LF_Compliment_2
string.body: [%username], you seem like an old soul.

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_LF_Compliment_3
string.body: [%username], beauty as powerful as yours must come from the inside.

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_LF_Compliment_4
string.body: [%username], you're as radiant as Lady Ariel herself!

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_LF_Compliment_5
string.body: Wow, [%username], have you been working out?

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_LF_Compliment_6
string.body: [%username], your eyes sparkle like an Aether Gem!

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_LF_Compliment_7
string.body: [%username], you're as cute and charming as a Kitter!

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_LF_Compliment_8
string.body: I've heard that you're as wise as you are good-looking, [%username].

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_DF_Compliment_1
string.body: I've heard much of your gallant deeds, [%username].

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_DF_Compliment_2
string.body: [%username], you have such a striking profile.

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_DF_Compliment_3
string.body: I can tell why you have so many friends, [%username].

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_DF_Compliment_4
string.body: You have the dignity of Lord Azphel himself , [%username].

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_DF_Compliment_5
string.body: [%username], you have the bearing of a hero.

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_DF_Compliment_8
string.body: [%username], your eyes sparkle like an Aether Gem!

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_Interartion_Compliment_1
string.body: The weather is really lovely, isn't it, [%username]?

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_Interartion_Compliment_3
string.body: Hi, [%username], hope you're having a great day!

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_Interartion_Compliment_5
string.body: Hi, [%username], what are you up to?

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_data_ment_1
string.body: What a beautiful day for a walk! But the day pales in comparison to you. Would you accompany me for a stroll?

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_data_ment_2
string.body: Someday you'll regret letting me slip away.

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_data_ment_3
string.body: I'm so happy I could die.

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_data_ment_4
string.body: I don't usually do this, but you've lit my heart afire.

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_data_ment_5
string.body: Tell me, do you carry me in your heart like I carry you in mine?

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_data_ment_6
string.body: Don't be cruel. All I want is to buy you a drink!

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_woman_ment_1
string.body: Sorry, I'm looking for someone with brains as well as brawn.

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_woman_ment_2
string.body: I'm sorry, I've already forgotten your name.

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_woman_ment_4
string.body: If your heart is burning, then perhaps you should see a healer.

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_woman_ment_5
string.body: I've got to go. I need to... wash my wings. Or something.

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_woman_ment_6
string.body: I'm not interested in wasting time with a man like you.

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_woman_ment_7
string.body: Bug off, lizard breath. I'm busy.

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_woman_ment_9
string.body: Tenacity is a great quality, but I still think you're a pain in the neck.

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_woman_ment_10
string.body: That's kind of you to say, but I'm not interested.

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_woman_ment_11
string.body: What a sweet thing to say! I'll be sure to tell my boyfriend about it.

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_woman_ment_12
string.body: Oh, honey, I'm way out of your league!

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_idealist_ment_1
string.body: I dream of a world without war, where all can live in peace.

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_idealist_ment_2
string.body: There's so much suffering in the world. Shouldn't we strive to lessen it?

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_realist_ment_1
string.body: But can a world at peace have progress?

string.name: STR_CHAT_housing_realist_ment_2
string.body: Struggle and strife are a necessary part of life. Even animals fight between themselves!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LDF4b_Shugo_Spa_1
string.body: Ooh, lightheaded... maybe in hot spring for too long, nyerk!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LDF4b_Shugo_Spa_2
string.body: Ooh, so hot! Feels so good!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LDF4b_Shugo_Spa_3
string.body: Come on in, Daeva. Water's fine, nyerk nyerk!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LDF4b_Shugo_Spa_4
string.body: Come on, get up! You can't spend all day in the bath, nyerk!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTiamat_Kahrun_3_01_Idle_S
string.body: Onward! Be not afraid! I am right behind you, Kahrun!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTiamat_Kahrun_3_02_Idle_S
string.body: The Tiamat legion is still a force to be reckoned with! Keep your eyes open!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTiamat_Kahrun_4_01_Idle_S
string.body: How strange... I can't find the entrance to Tiamat's Shelter...

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTiamat_Kahrun_4_02_Idle_S
string.body: The Tiamat Legion's downfall is nigh...

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTiamat_Kahrun_6_01_Idle_S
string.body: The magic of the four Tiamat's Incarnations is preventing the passage from being activated. Please deal with them.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTiamat_Kahrun_1_01_Idle
string.body: Tiamat might have tracked us down by now. We must hurry.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTiamat_Kahrun_1_02_Idle
string.body: I've never seen such a strong Aetheric Field before.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTiamat_Kahrun_1_03_Idle
string.body: Today could be the day the Tiamat Legion meets its doom.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTiamat_Surama_1_01_Idle_S
string.body: To receive help from a Daeva... I am truly ashamed.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTiamat_Murugan_2_01_Idle_S
string.body: I'll open the door, but you must not disturb Surama!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTiamat_Murugan_1_01
string.body: I never thought I'd be thanking a Daeva... I'm still alive thanks to you... Thank you.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTiamat_Murugan_1_03
string.body: Surama! I shall pave the way for you!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTiamat_Surama_2_03
string.body: Silence! Are you not ashamed to have gained your rank of Brigade General by treachery?!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTiamat_Surama_2_05
string.body: I never thought... that my life here... would come to an end... How very sad...

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTiamat_Rakshaka_01
string.body: Helped by a Daeva? The shame of it!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTiamat_Rakshaka_02
string.body: Perhaps it would be best to lock them up again, so that we have peace.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTiamat_Rakshaka_03
string.body: What a weakling you are! So much for the mighty Surama!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTiamat_Murugan_3_02
string.body: I can't believe it... Surama has been defeated...

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTiamat_Murugan_3_03
string.body: I thank you... for the revenge of Surama.

string.name: STR_QUEST_SAY_IDTiamat_02
string.body: You have my sincere thanks... Finally I am free again...

string.name: STR_QUEST_SAY_IDTiamat_03
string.body: You followed me all this way! Oh, you vile Elyos!

string.name: STR_QUEST_SAY_IDTiamat_06
string.body: Ah... Finally I am rid of my curse...

string.name: STR_QUEST_SAY_IDTiamat_07
string.body: I am most grateful for your help. Now I can relax...

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTiamat_Kahrun_6_01
string.body: Very well. I shall take care of the final negotiation.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTiamat_ShulackScientist_01
string.body: There's no formula that I can't solve!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTiamat_ShulackScientist_02
string.body: More soil samples will be needed to research Poeta ...

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTiamat_ShulackScientist_03

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTiamat_Kahrun_6_02

string.name: STR_ZONE_COMMENT_TizeridB
string.body: Tijerid Central Area links the main gate and the city, and it is also where the Eljeris Military Academy which symbolizes the power of Tijerid is located. The military academy is the base of the Red Flame Brigade and the Blood Sky Templars, but it also functions as a public educational facility for Tijerid citizens and the masters of all Classes teach their skills here as well. The academy also has an expansive drill ground for training, and on either side of the academy there are arcades of Collecting and Craft related guilds.

string.name: STR_ZONE_COMMENT_FF1
string.body: A dry and barren wilderness constantly swept by gales, its name comes from the sound of the wind passing underneath the great gorge that sometimes echoes like the roaring of a maddened beast. There are mines in the fissures on the ground of the great gorge, and there is a road leading back to Tijerid for the transport of minerals extracted from the mines. The Tursin Krall that have lairs throughout the region are known to raid the adventurers or supply-transport wagons. Tijeridians have been fighting them for a long time, but eradicating the numerous Krall who have settled in the area for generations has proven impossible and as a result they continue to coexist if not harmoniously.

string.name: STR_ZONE_COMMENT_FF2
string.body: A vast wasteland where a fierce battle had taken place during the Elyos-Asmodian War, it is infested with numerous wild beasts and Krall but the Guard Posts scattered in various locations protect the Elyos from getting harmed. Lewindal Stonefort was built after the Krall invasion to further strengthen the defence of the city, and it is a safe place with many stationed guards as well as a centre of active resource management. Moreover, it is where the lifeline of Tijerid, Cheravic Docks, is located, which receives the resources arriving from other countries by ships and sends them to the city by road. The wasteland is divided into two halves where the opposing Elyos and Krall have taken the north and south respectively.

string.name: STR_ZONE_COMMENT_FF3
string.body: This geothermal area used to be an ordinary wasteland a long time ago, but the Cataclysm had caused the lava of the Red Mountains to overflow and turned the whole region into a land of death where life finds it difficult to survive. Plants either burned or turned into ashes, the heated earth gushes out smoke and gas if not covered by hardened lava, and the magma inside the Mouth of the Fregion cave flowed out to block the path to the Holy Ground. The gorge in the northeast of the area is occupied by the Kaidan Krall, and there is a Village of Kobolds to the south of the gorge. The front of the path leading to the Mouth of Fregion is where the well-renowned attraction of the area, the Kobold Inn, is found.

string.name: STR_ZONE_COMMENT_EE2
string.body: It has been a long while since the people of Erole built the Outer Castle and begun to develop the surrounding areas to expand their living space. Maybe it is due to bad fengshui, but despite a favourable natural environment a continuous stream of inexplicable accidents disrupted the development process and the fruits of their labour are only evident inside the Outer Castle. The ruins of facilities used for development and half-finished buildings are commonly found, and the only thing still intact is the road laid for the transport of materials. Yet they still managed to complete the Lighthouse, which is used for keeping a watch on the surroundings and there are guards regularly patrolling the road between the Outer Castle and the Lighthouse.

string.name: STR_ZONE_COMMENT_TizeridBL
string.body: The left area of Tijerid comprises of residential blocks for commoners and a central market street busy with small street vendors selling food, weapons and various other items. There is also a dock to the north where goods imported from other countries are received, and the biggest tavern in all of Tijerid can be found on the road between the market street and the dock.

string.name: STR_ZONE_COMMENT_TizeridBR
string.body: The right area of Tijerid comprises of a market street occupied by many high-end stores including a Soul Healing clinic, and the northern part of the area boasts a gladiatorial arena that maybe regarded as the flower of Tijeridian cultural experience, and luxurious mansions of nobles and a martial arts gym are also located nearby. However, a corner district that has turned into a slum area displays a dark side of Tijerid as well.

string.name: STR_ZONE_Comment_IDAb1_Dreadgion
string.body: The Dredgion of the Baranath Legion, which is terrorizing Reshanta. Elyos and Asmodians must kill its captain, Adhati, while keeping each other in check. Abyss Points are up for grabs.

string.name: STR_E3_DISH_HP_01_DESC
string.body: An ambitious piece of work by the famous baker Fredor. It recovers HP continuously for a period of time.

string.name: STR_E3_DISH_MP_01_DESC
string.body: A concentration of the Shellizard tears that are shed rarely and only during night. It restores MP continuously for a period of time.

string.body: A well cooked steak of Drakie meat. It increases STR and VIT for a period of time.

string.name: STR_E3_DISH_AGI_DEX_01_DESC

string.body: Barghest meat smoked for preservation. It increases STR and decreases VIT for a period of time.

string.name: STR_E3_DISH_KNO_WIL_02_DESC

string.name: STR_ITEM_SKILL_PROC_STUN_DESC
string.body: A physical Altered State. You cannot move because of a strong shock. You cannot remove this Altered State by using magic or potion.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SKILL_PROC_PARALYZE_DESC
string.body: A mental Altered State. You cannot move as your mind wanders. You can remove this Altered State by using magic.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SKILL_PROC_ROOT_DESC
string.body: A physical Altered State. You cannot move because your feet are bound. You can remove this Altered State by using magic or potion.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SKILL_PROC_SILENCE_DESC
string.body: A physical Altered State. You cannot cast a spell because you cannot talk.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SKILL_PROC_BLIND_DESC
string.body: A physical Altered State. Your attack accuracy lowers because you cannot see.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SKILL_PROC_SNARE_DESC
string.body: A physical Altered State. You walk slowly because you have your legs injured. You can remove this Altered State by using magic or potion.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SKILL_PROC_SLOW_DESC
string.body: A physical Altered State. Your attack speed decreases because you are mentally and physically exhausted. You can remove this Altered State by using magic or potion.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SKILL_PROC_POISON_DESC
string.body: A physical Altered State. Your HP decreases gradually because you are intoxicated with dangerous poison. You can remove this Altered State by using magic or potion.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SKILL_PROC_BLEED_DESC
string.body: A physical Altered State. Your HP decreases gradually because you are severely injured. You can remove this Altered State by using magic or potion.

Use Gchief_Light, LF4_2011_Boss_Li_1, LF4_2011_Boss_Li_2, LF4_2011_Boss_Li_3, and LF4_2011_Boss_Li_4 in the test
Possible to test by summoning LF4_2011_Boss_Li_1~4
The test should work.

string.name: STR_ITEM_TEST_AVATAR_BUFF_05DESC
string.body:
Item to test the simultaneous raise limit for 5 multiple classes
Use Gchief_Light, LF4_2011_Boss_Li_1, LF4_2011_Boss_Li_2, LF4_2011_Boss_Li_3, LF4_2011_Boss_Li_4, and LF4_2011_Boss_Li_5 in the test
Possible to test by summoning LF4_2011_Boss_Li_1
The test should not work. You can apply up to 4 classes. Actually it doesn't matter whether it works or not... -_-

Possible to test by summoning LF4_2011_Boss_Li_1
The test should not work.

string.name: STR_WING_LIGHT_50A_DESC
string.body: Superb Wings created by 'Kaisinel's Wings', an organization under the guidance of the Empyrean Lord Kaisinel. The wings' performance is outstanding. They were crafted by Haroshunerk, an Expert from the Tigraki Studio.

string.name: STR_EVENT_SCROLL_CRITICAL_PHY_50A_DESC
string.body: Boosts [%e1.StatUp.StatName] by [%e1.StatUp.Value] points for [%e1.StatUp.RemainTime]. Cannot be used if any Crit Spell Scroll is in effect.

string.name: STR_EVENT_FOOD_DRINK_01_DESC

string.name: STR_EVENT_DISH_DRINK_01_DESC

string.name: STR_SALE_EXPLAIN_BUY_LIMIT_01
string.body: When you have exceeded the limit for the number of items you can buy, you must wait for a certain period of time before you can buy again.

string.name: STR_SALE_EXPLAIN_SALE_LIMIT_01
string.body: Items that have been sold out are restocked after a certain period of time has passed.

string.name: STR_SALE_EXPLAIN_BUY_LIMIT_02
string.body: You can't buy more than the allocated amount without reentering Taloc.

string.name: STR_SALE_EXPLAIN_BUY_SALE_LIMIT_01
string.body: This is a limited sale item with a daily purchase limit, and can only be purchased again 24 hours after the time of last purchase. Sold-out items will be restocked at certain hours.

string.name: STR_WRAP_QUEST_L_MEDAL_POCKET_60A_DESC
string.body: You can obtain Mithril coins by opening the chest, but there is no knowing how many it may hold inside.

string.name: STR_WRAP_QUEST_D_MEDAL_POCKET_60A_DESC
string.body: You can obtain Mithril coins by opening the chest, but there is no knowing how many it may hold inside.

string.name: STR_WING_LIGHT_50B_DESC
string.body: Major Wings made by 'Kaisinel's Wings', an organization under the guidance of the Empyrean Lord Kaisinel. Crafted using a new method by an Expert from the Tigraki Studio, Haroshunerk, these are wings of outstanding quality where only one or two pairs are produced from every hundred crafted.

string.name: STR_WING_DARK_50B_DESC
string.body: Major Wings made by the 9th Pandaemonium Research Centre with the skills of Naorunerk, the top apprentice of Daloshunerk. These are wings of outstanding quality where only one or two pairs are produced from every hundred crafted by Naorunerk.

string.name: STR_WING_LIGHT_40B_DESC
string.body: Greater Wings made by 'Kaisinel's Wings', an organization under the guidance of the Empyrean Lord Kaisinel. Crafted by an Expert from the Tigraki Studio, Daloshunerk, these are wings of superb quality where only one or two pairs are produced from every hundred crafted.

string.name: STR_WING_DARK_40B_DESC
string.body: Greater Wings made by the 9th Pandaemonium Research Centre with the skills of Naorunerk, the top apprentice of Daloshunerk. These are wings of superb quality where only one or two pairs are produced from every hundred crafted by Naorunerk.

string.name: STR_WING_LIGHT_30B_DESC
string.body: Wings made by 'Kaisinel's Wings', an organization under the guidance of the Empyrean Lord Kaisinel. The wings' performance is passable, as they were crafted by Chantinerk, an apprentice of Daloshunerk.

string.name: STR_WING_DARK_30B_DESC
string.body: Wings made by the 9th Pandaemonium Research Center, which remodeled the Midnight Wings for mass production.

string.name: STR_WING_LIGHT_30C_DESC
string.body: Wings made by 'Kaisinel's Wings', an organization under the guidance of the Empyrean Lord Kaisinel. Crafted by Chantinerk, an apprentice of Daloshunerk, these are wings of decent quality where only one or two pairs are produced from every hundred crafted.

string.name: STR_WING_DARK_30C_DESC
string.body: Wings made by the 9th Pandaemonium Research Center, which remodeled the Midnight Wings for use by commander-rank officers.

string.name: STR_SALE_EXPLAIN_BUY_SALE_LIMIT_03
string.body: This is a limited sale item with a daily purchase limit, and can only be purchased again 24 hours after the time of last purchase. Sold-out items will be restocked at certain hours.

string.name: STR_SALE_EXPLAIN_BUY_SALE_LIMIT_04
string.body: Items that have been sold out are restocked at 6 and 12 o'clock daily. Each person can buy up to the limited number for each item.

string.name: STR_ITEM_LIGHT_TITLE59_3_DESC
string.body: Bestows the <Alabaster Wing> title.\nThis title increases your physical attack by 2 points and magic boosting power by 10 points, and is usable for 3 days.

string.name: STR_ITEM_LIGHT_TITLE62_3_DESC
string.body: Use it to buy the title <Radiant Fist>.\nIf you bear this title, your physical and magical attack strength will increase by 1%% in PvP.\nIts effect lasts 3 days.

string.name: STR_QUEST_XPBOOST_LIGHT_40_DESC
string.body: You gain 10%% additional XP from hunting, gathering, and crafting while the Heavenly Marvellous Charm is active.\nThe effect lasts for 1 hour, and after it expires you cannot use it again for 10 hours. Players of level 1-40 can use this charm.

string.body: You gain 10%% additional XP from hunting, gathering, and crafting while the Heavenly Recondite Charm is active.\nThe effect lasts for 2 hours, and after it expires you cannot use it again for 10 hours. Players of level 1-50 can use this charm.

string.name: STR_QUEST_XPBOOST_LIGHT_60_DESC
string.body: You gain 10%% additional XP from hunting, gathering, and crafting while the Heavenly Profound Charm is active.\nThe effect lasts for 1 hour, and after it expires you cannot use it again for 10 hours. Players of level 1-60 can use this charm.

string.name: STR_QUEST_XPBOOST_DARK_40_DESC

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_2HSWORD_D_N_U1_35B_DESC
string.body: This greatsword's structural integrity seems questionable. Available Fool's Day only.

string.body: If you can drag this club off the ground, it might make a worthy weapon. Available Fool's Day only.

string.body: This greatsword is surprisingly elegant. Available Fool's Day only.

string.body: The skill of the craftsman who made this greatsword is obvious. Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_2HSWORD_N_U1_44A_DESC
string.body: This greatsword does not seem too happy about its situation. Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_BOOK_D_N_U1_35B_DESC
string.body: There doesn't seem to be anything wrong with this tome. Available Fool's Day only.

string.body: This tome is functional, though it will be difficult to fit on your bookshelf. Available Fool's Day only.

string.body: A tome that for some reason is severely crumpled and tattered, and is available only on April Fool's Day.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_BOOK_N_U1_44A_DESC
string.body: This tome seems perfectly usable, if you don't mind strange looks. Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_BOW_D_N_U1_35B_DESC
string.body: Pray to Aion you don't trip and fall on this spiky bow. Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_BOW_N_E1_50A_DESC
string.body: Don't you love seeing your enemies bristle with your arrows? Available Fool's Day only.

string.body: Can't wait to show off all your new bowstrings? This is the weapon for you! Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_BOW_N_U1_44A_DESC
string.body: This leafy bow is made from wood that's still green. Available Fool's Day only.

string.body: This dagger looks normal enough. Available Fool's Day only.

string.body: This sleek little dagger looks like it's sprouting. Available Fool's Day only.

string.body: Now you can bash skulls with another skull! Available Fool's Day only.

string.body: This box contains either Dye: True White, or Dye: True Black,, or a complete 8-piece Rainbow Dye Pack II.\nDouble-click (or right-click) it to get ready for your big event!

string.body: This box contains a Wedding Dress/Tuxedo, an Elegant Hanbok, a Gift-Wrapped Rillard's Celebrity Line item, and the Bride's Makeup Box.\nDouble-click (or right-click) to open it.

string.name: STR_WRAP_CASH_DRESS_PACKAGE_02_DESC

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_WEAPON_C_01_DESC
string.body: A Balaur's training weapon.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_JEWELBOX_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is a jewellery box that Lady Angerr holds dear.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_SHULACKSHIP_C_01_DESC
string.body: A replica of the Steel Rake, the great Shulack ship.\nThe craftsmanship is remarkable, and shows details that most artists couldn't hope to make out.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_GOLDSAAM_C_01_DESC
string.body: A hundred-year old ginseng that emits a slightly bitter scent.\nFunctions well as potpourri, but has little other purpose.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_REFUGEDOLL_C_01_DESC
string.body: A shabby doll clearly made by Shulack hands.\nThere are no clues as to whether or not the toy was made for someone in particular.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_SIEGEWEAPON_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is a replica of a weapon from the Varsharti Legion.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_TIAMATCRACk_C_01_DESC
string.body: This jewel signifies fissures.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_TIAMATGRAVITY_C_01_DESC
string.body: This jewel signifies gravity.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_TIAMATRAGE_C_01_DESC
string.body: This jewel signifies wrath.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_TIAMATCRYSTAL_C_01_DESC
string.body: This jewel signifies petrification.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_SHULACKPLANE_C_01_DESC
string.body: A replica of a Steam Tachysphere.\nIt is based on the design of an actual Steam Tachysphere, however, the joints' functions are limited, preventing some degrees of movement.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_STIGMAL_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is a stigma stone replica.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_BURNER_C_01_DESC
string.body: This beautiful crystal ball shimmers with Aether.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_DRADGIONL_C_01_DESC
string.body: A miniature replica of the latest Dredgion.\nYou can make out a Gravity Controller, the Dredgion Core, and even a Photon Cannon. With such remarkable detail, it wouldn't be all that surprising to find miniature Balaur working away inside.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_ODRECEIVER_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is an Obelisk inside a transparent cube, an angular accent piece.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_PEARL_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is a clam containing beautiful pearls.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_COMAD_C_01_DESC
string.body: A Komad model that reminds you of your exploits within Taloc's Hollow.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_CANDYBASKET_C_01_DESC
string.body: This lovely basket contains liquor, fruit, and mushrooms.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_PORTALTRIGGER_D_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is a replica of the Krall's guardian stone.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_STIGMAD_D_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is a stigma replica.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_DRADGIOND_D_C_01_DESC
string.body: A miniature replica of the latest Dredgion.\nYou can make out a Gravity Controller, the Dredgion Core, and even a Photon Cannon. With such remarkable detail, it wouldn't be all that surprising to find miniature Balaur working away inside.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_ADMADOLL_D_C_01_DESC
string.body: A little teddy bear that originally belonged to Seiren Ntuamu.\nSadly, Princess Karemiwen took everything from Ntuamu, including Lannok's love, and the bear.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_TELEPORTERRUG_C_01_DESC
string.body: A rug with the magic ward of movement pattern on it.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_MANDURI_LIGHT_C_01_DESC
string.body: This lighting is made of the branches from which condor eggs dangle.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_FLAG_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is an insignia for winning a war.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_DRAGON_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is a Tahabata replica.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_RUDRA_C_01_DESC
string.body: A Stormwing statuette.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_RAKSHA_C_01_DESC
string.body: A Raksha statuette.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_ELEMENTALKING_C_01_DESC
string.body: A model of the terrible Yamennes, the mightiest creature within the Abyssal Splinter.\nEven though the model is a fraction of Yamennes' size, the sculptor still managed to convey the beast's unbridled fury.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_KRALLDRUM_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is Chieftain Kraka's drum.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_TESINON_C_01_DESC
string.body: A model of the Fourth Weapon, Dorhan.\nIt is staring at you as if it were about to eat you alive.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_DAILYNPCSL_C_01_DESC
string.body: A lovely statue of the Arachne Sisters.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_COREBATTERY_C_01_DESC
string.body: An Elemental Core created from the Powers of the Four Spirits.\nIt is a valuable item that shows the powers of the purified spirit that Theobomos created.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_PORGUSS_C_01_DESC
string.body: This replica celebrates the return of Poppy, [%dic:STR_DIC_LA159]'s pet Porgus.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_ATREIA_C_01_DESC
string.body: A replica of all Atreia.\nThe level of detail is quite remarkable, and can be used for strategic planning if needed.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_OD_BOMB_D_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is a non-lethal replica of an Aether bomb.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_UNDEADLIGHT_D_C_01_DESC
string.body: A statue of the Betrayer Villaire.\nVillaire was once a member of the Red Sky Legion, but abandoned his comrades after being tempted by material things.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_DAILYNPCSD_D_C_01_DESC
string.body: A handsome statue of the Marchutan Brothers.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECE_ACHIEVE_LF1PAINTING_C_01_DESC
string.body: An oil painting depicting the beautiful Cliona Lake.\nThe bright and warm strokes adds luster to the peaceful scenes, and reminds you of your life before your ascension.

string.name: STR_DECE_ACHIEVE_DRAGONSCROLL_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is a dragon scroll of good fortune.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECE_ACHIEVE_SHUGOPAINTING_C_01_DESC
string.body: A stunning painting of a Shugo.\nThe gentle smile and slightly turned face, combined with dark and deep eyes gives the subject of the painting a real sense of identity.

string.name: STR_DECE_ACHIEVE_DF1PAINTING_C_01_DESC
string.body: An oil painting depicting Lake Tunapre.\nThe dark and cold colours give the piece a strange, dreamlike feel. It's a shame that the creator's identity is unknown.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_MIRROR_C_01_DESC

string.body: This scroll piece vividly displays the blazing sparks of Raksha.\nObtainable only in spring.\nWhen the remainder of the pieces are collected to complete the whole work, they can be used for decorating a house.

string.body: This scroll piece describes Tahabata's roar in great detail.\nObtainable only in summer.\nWhen the remainder of the pieces are collected to complete the whole work, they can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSAMBLY_ACHIEVE_DRAGONSCROLL_03_DESC
string.body: This special scroll frame can hold the drawings of the Balaur, and forms part of a set.\nObtainable only in fall.\nWhen the remainder of the pieces are collected to complete the whole work, they can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSAMBLY_ACHIEVE_DRAGONSCROLL_04_DESC
string.body: This scroll piece vividly describes the cold eyes of Stormwing.\nObtainable only in winter.\nWhen the remaining pieces are collected to complete the whole work, they can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSAMBLY_ACHIEVE_SHUGOPAINTING_01_DESC
string.body: It is a piece of an elaborate portrait of a Shugo.\nObtainable only in spring.\nWhen the remaining pieces are collected to complete the whole work, they can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSAMBLY_ACHIEVE_SHUGOPAINTING_02_DESC
string.body: It is a bust portrait of a prim Shugo.\nObtainable only in summer.\nWhen the remaining pieces are collected to complete the whole work, they can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSAMBLY_ACHIEVE_SHUGOPAINTING_03_DESC
string.body: It is a piece of a drawing depicting a Shugo's glimmering earrings in detail.\nObtainable only in fall.\nWhen the remaining pieces are collected to complete the whole work, they can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSAMBLY_ACHIEVE_SHUGOPAINTING_04_DESC
string.body: It is a piece of a drawing that beautifully depicts a Shugo's turban.\nObtainable only in winter.\nWhen the remaining pieces are collected to complete the whole work, they can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_NEWDAILYNPCSL_C_01_DESC
string.body: A sculpture of Typhon, president of the Alabaster Order.\nThe words "Pure White Elegance Edition" are etched into the art.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_NEWDAILYNPCSL_C_02_DESC
string.body: A sculpture of Pompo, a Radiant Ops recruiter.\nHis features have been well represented here, and the pose he's pulling off looks very typical of Pompo.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_NEWDAILYNPCSL_C_03_DESC
string.body: A sculpture of Juris Po, captain of the Fortuneers.\nThe model is very accurate, and features his penetrating eyes and wide-brimmed hat.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_NEWDAILYNPCSL_C_04_DESC
string.body: A sculpture of Jiyunia.\nHer laid back attitude has been well represented in the model, mostly through her loosely crossed arms and casual pose. She's every bit as attractive here as in the skin.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_NEWDAILYNPCSD_D_C_01_DESC
string.body: A sculpture of Deryk, registrar of the Field Wardens.\nHis face are hidden behind the brilliant green armour that he wears.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_NEWDAILYNPCSD_D_C_02_DESC
string.body: A sculpture of Viscum, commander of the Blood Crusade.\nA roaring posture to the sky imparts a strong sense of spirited ambitions.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_NEWDAILYNPCSD_D_C_03_DESC
string.body: A sculpture of Tikalanerk, a beautiful member of Charlirunerk's Daemons.\nThis would make a fine decoration for your home.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_NEWDAILYNPCSD_D_C_04_DESC
string.body: A sculpture of Petrarca, manager of The Circle.\nPetty burglars like the Ulgorn Raiders would turn tail after coming under Petrarca's murderous gaze.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_ACHIEVE_DRAGON_01_DESC
string.body: The head of Tahabata.\nFind the other two for the complete form that can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_ACHIEVE_DRAGON_02_DESC
string.body: The skeleton of Tahabata.\nFind the other two for the complete form that can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_ACHIEVE_DRAGON_03_DESC
string.body: The wings of Tahabata.\nFind the other two for the complete form that can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_ACHIEVE_RUDRA_01_DESC
string.body: The head of Stormwing.\nFind the other two for the complete form that can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_ACHIEVE_RUDRA_02_DESC
string.body: The skeleton of Stormwing.\nFind the other two for the complete form that can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_ACHIEVE_RUDRA_03_DESC
string.body: The wings of Stormwing.\nFind the other two for the complete form that can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_ACHIEVE_RAKSHA_01_DESC
string.body: The head of Raksha.\nFind the other two for the complete form that can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_ACHIEVE_RAKSHA_02_DESC
string.body: A skeleton of Raksha.\nFind the other two for the complete form that can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_ACHIEVE_RAKSHA_03_DESC
string.body: The wings of Raksha.\nFind the other two for the complete form that can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_DRAGON_C_01_DESC
string.body: A wall decoration modeled on the great Tahabata.\nThe craftsmanship is so exquisite that it looks ready to spew fire from its mouth any instant.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_RUDRA_C_01_DESC
string.body: A wall decoration modeled on Stormwing, the self-declared sixth Dragon Lord.\nStare at it long enough, and it looks as though it moves before your very eyes.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_RAKSHA_C_01_DESC
string.body: A wall decoration modeled on Raksha's twisted anger.\nRaksha was once powerful enough to challenge Tiamat himself. Sadly, for him, Tiamat was significantly stronger.

string.name: STR_WORLD_XP_BOOST_06_DESC
