string.name: STR_JUNK_DAILYGATHER_SHELL_01_DESC
string.body: Inside the shell, a beautiful pearl awaits.

string.name: STR_JUNK_DAILYGATHER_STONE_01_DESC
string.body: A shining by-product of Aether ore extraction.

string.name: STR_JUNK_DAILYGATHER_PLANT_01_DESC
string.body: A flower that symbolizes the natural cycle. Nepera in Oriel's Green Forest Trail Village is desperately seeking it.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_50A_DESC
string.body: Dukiron's first-ever work.\nIt demonstrates the aesthetics of self-control and restraint, rather than flamboyant exuberance.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_50B_DESC
string.body: The fish that took Liuron half a day to catch.\nIts looks as powerful and as huge as a Balaur soldier, though obviously is a good deal tastier.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_50C_DESC
string.body: Makron crafted this decorative item after being inspired by blazing flames.\nIt is not as hot as it looks!

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_50D_DESC
string.body: The gently reflecting light is simply exquisite.\nEuron once accidentally dropped a pick on it, but fortunately there wasn't a single scratch on it.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_50E_DESC
string.body: Sniron used to take scores of these vegetables to snack on in-between meals.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_50F_DESC
string.body: It was originally made as a gift for Makron, but Makron flew off the handle because he thought it was a waste of precious ore. It had to be discarded.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_50G_DESC
string.body: Kashuron disliked eating vegetables so much that he hid them in a secret place, where they grew larger and larger.\nYou should probably keep these away from children.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_50H_DESC
string.body: The pages in the notebook were made by processing several wide leaves.\nThese were used before the days of paper, and are still used where wood is hard to come by.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_50I_DESC
string.body: The beautiful flower buds put even the most vigilant of soldiers at ease.\nUnfortunate then, that the stalks can strike out with such deadly force.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_50J_DESC
string.body: A basic musical instrument made by weaving twigs together.\nSkilled musicians can make something tuneful from it, but most find it better used as a basic type of bow.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_55A_DESC
string.body: Dukiron thought this brooch took after his look.\nIt's impossibly flamboyant, and Dukiron is totally mesmerized by it.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_55B_DESC
string.body: Its scales and teeth were so sharp that it can't be caught with a regular fishing line.\nPseron finally caught it using a special fishing line made from vines.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_55C_DESC
string.body: Makron made this accessory as he was inspired by the flashing thunderbolt that was falling from dark clouds.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_55D_DESC
string.body: Mikaron made this plate by engraving personally-designed patterns and inserting jewels that he crafted.\nHis attention to detail is phenomenal.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_55E_DESC
string.body: This vegetable's peel is so tough and hard that not many have the perseverance to get to the fruit inside.\nHowever, Fat Sniron would peel it off with much gusto.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_55F_DESC
string.body: Euron's favoured mining pick.\nMakron changed the handle once, though Euron failed to notice any difference.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_55G_DESC
string.body: A vegetable that Kashuron dislikes. This one has hardened considerably.\nThe awful smell is excellent at repelling harmful bugs.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_55H_DESC
string.body: It is a notebook made from the fruits around Tyron's home.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_55I_DESC
string.body: A flower that Pseron cultivated with all her love for Dukiron. \nJust like her heart heads towards Dukiron, this flower grows towards the direction of the Tower of Eternity.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_55J_DESC
string.body: A musical instrument that Hudaron used to play while sitting in his favourite tree.\nIt has only one string but has a beautiful tone to it.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_60A_DESC
string.body: Dukiron was haunted by an terrible sense of jealousy after completing this brooch.\nIt defied his belief that nothing more beautiful than himself could exist.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_60B_DESC
string.body: This is the biggest fish that Liuron has ever caught in his whole life.\nIt was so big that Fat Sniron lost his mind over it.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_60C_DESC
string.body: An accessory Makron made while mulling over the harmony between fire and water, and other contrasting properties.\nMakron was greatly enlightened once he completed the accessory.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_60D_DESC
string.body: A beautiful plate featuring five bold colours.\nYou can hear the gentle rush of the sea when you place your ear next to it.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_60E_DESC
string.body: A snack that Fat Sniron kept deep inside his cave for he fear someone might take it.\nHe ended up leaving it for so long that it turned too hard to eat.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_60F_DESC
string.body: An axe that Euron only used when cutting down the largest trees he could find.\nThough overly heavy, it has a soft and comfortable grip.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_60G_DESC
string.body: A toy made by further hardening rotten vegetables. Yuck!

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_60H_DESC
string.body: A notebook with pages made from thinly sliced pieces of fruit.\nEven though old, it still smells rather sweet.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_60I_DESC
string.body: This flower was wasting away without having to bloom once. But Pseron's dedicated care has given it the life of eternity.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_60J_DESC
string.body: An instrument with strings made from flowers and leaves. How strange.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_50A_DESC
string.body: Dukiron's first-ever work.\nIt demonstrates the beauty of self-control rather than flamboyance.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_50B_DESC
string.body: The fish that took Liuron half a day to catch.\nIts looks as powerful and as huge as a Balaur soldier, though obviously is a good deal tastier.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_50C_DESC
string.body: Makron crafted this decorative item after being inspired by blazing flames.\nIt is not as hot as it looks!

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_50D_DESC
string.body: The gently reflecting light is simply exquisite.\nEuron once accidentally dropped a pick on it, but fortunately there wasn't a single scratch on it.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_50E_DESC
string.body: Sniron used to take scores of these vegetables to snack on in-between meals.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_50F_DESC
string.body: It was originally made as a gift for Makron, but Makron flew off the handle because he thought it was a waste of precious ore. It had to be discarded.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_50G_DESC
string.body: Kashuron disliked eating vegetables so much that he hid them in a secret place, where they grew larger and larger.\nYou should probably keep these away from children.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_50H_DESC
string.body: The pages in the notebook were made by processing several wide leaves.\nThese were used before the days of paper, and are still used where wood is hard to come by.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_50I_DESC
string.body: The beautiful flower buds put even the most vigilant of soldiers at ease.\nUnfortunate then, that the stalks can strike out with such deadly force.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_50J_DESC
string.body: A basic musical instrument made by weaving twigs together.\nSkilled musicians can make something tuneful from it, but most find it better used as a basic type of bow.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_55A_DESC
string.body: Dukiron thought this brooch took after his look.\nIt's impossibly flamboyant, and Dukiron is totally mesmerized by it.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_55B_DESC
string.body: Its scales and teeth were so sharp that it can't be caught with a regular fishing line.\nPseron finally caught it using a special fishing line made from vines.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_55C_DESC
string.body: Makron made this accessory as he was inspired by the flashing thunderbolt that was falling from dark clouds.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_55D_DESC
string.body: Mikaron made this plate by engraving personally-designed patterns and inserting jewels that he crafted.\nHis attention to detail is phenomenal.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_55E_DESC
string.body: This vegetable's peel is so tough and hard that not many have the perseverance to get to the fruit inside.\nHowever, Fat Sniron would peel it off with much gusto.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_55F_DESC
string.body: Euron's favoured mining pick.\nMakron changed the handle once, though Euron failed to notice any difference.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_55G_DESC
string.body: A vegetable that Kashuron dislikes. This one has hardened considerably.\nThe awful smell is excellent at repelling harmful bugs.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_55H_DESC
string.body: It is a notebook made from the fruits around Tyron's home.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_55I_DESC
string.body: A flower that Pseron cultivated with all her love for Dukiron. \nJust like her heart heads towards Dukiron, this flower grows towards the direction of the Tower of Eternity.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_55J_DESC
string.body: A musical instrument that Hudaron used to play while sitting in his favourite tree.\nIt has only one string but has a beautiful tone to it.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_60A_DESC
string.body: Dukiron was haunted by an terrible sense of jealousy after completing this brooch.\nIt defied his belief that nothing more beautiful than himself could exist.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_60B_DESC
string.body: The fish that took Liuron half a day to catch.\nIts looks as powerful and as huge as a Balaur soldier, though obviously is a good deal tastier.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_60C_DESC
string.body: An accessory Makron made while mulling over the harmony between fire and water, and other contrasting properties.\nMakron was greatly enlightened once he completed the accessory.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_60D_DESC
string.body: A beautiful plate featuring five bold colours.\nYou can hear the gentle rush of the sea when you place your ear next to it.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_60E_DESC
string.body: A snack that Fat Sniron kept deep inside his cave for he fear someone might take it.\nHe ended up leaving it for so long that it turned too hard to eat.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_60F_DESC
string.body: An axe that Euron only used when cutting down the largest trees he could find.\nThough overly heavy, it has a soft and comfortable grip.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_60G_DESC
string.body: A toy made by further hardening rotten vegetables. Yuck!

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_60H_DESC
string.body: A notebook with pages made from thinly sliced pieces of fruit.\nEven though old, it still smells rather sweet.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_60I_DESC
string.body: This flower was wasting away without having to bloom once. But Pseron's dedicated care has given it the life of eternity.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_60J_DESC
string.body: An instrument with strings made from flowers and leaves. How strange.

string.name: STR_QUEST_41453A_DESC
string.body: A ring that has been handed down to applicants for Legion of Siel's Spear for a long time.

string.name: STR_RELIC_YUN_01_DESC
string.body: A mark of a devotee to Empyrean Lady Siel.

string.name: STR_RELIC_YUN_02_DESC
string.body: A mark of a steadfast devotee to Empyrean Lady Siel.

string.name: STR_RELIC_YUN_03_DESC
string.body: A mark of an earnest devotee to Empyrean Lady Siel.

string.name: STR_JUNK_EXTEND_STIGMA_01_DESC
string.body: It is absorbing the energy out of a person that possesses it.

string.name: STR_JUNK_DAILYGATHER_SHELL_D_01_DESC
string.body: A shell containing a rare pearl.

string.name: STR_JUNK_DAILYGATHER_STONE_D_01_DESC
string.body: A meteorite exuding the energy of Aether.

string.name: STR_JUNK_DAILYGATHER_PLANT_D_01_DESC
string.body: A flower that symbolizes the natural cycle. Darina at Pernon Plaza is desperately seeking it.

string.name: STR_ITEM_OWNERTREE_ODSTONE_01_DESC
string.body: A Construction Flux Hearthbloom.\nThe house owner can obtain Furniture Construction Flux Stones once a day by using the Hearthbloom Fertilizer while at home.

string.name: STR_ITEM_OWNERTREE_D_ODSTONE_01_DESC
string.body: A Construction Flux Hearthbloom.\nThe house owner can obtain Furniture Construction Flux Stones once a day by using the Hearthbloom Fertilizer while at home.

string.name: STR_CASH_PETCARD_MULT_U_MINITAHABATA_01_7DAY_DESC
string.body:
Tahabata Egg.
It cooks and uses magical items automatically for you.
It picks up items while you're in battle.
You can obtain it from a Pet Minder.
You can keep the adopted pet for 7 days.

string.name: STR_CASH_PETCARD_MULT_U_MINIRUDRA_01_7DAY_DESC

Stormwing Egg.
It cooks and uses magical items automatically for you.
It picks up items while you're in battle.
You can obtain it from a Pet Minder.
You can keep the adopted pet for 7 days.

string.name: STR_CASH_PETCARD_Prod_U_LITTLESHUGOMFORTUNE_01_7DAY_DESC

Lukeshunerk Egg.
It gives you a bundle of fortune items and consumables when you feed it.
You can obtain it from a Pet Minder.
You can keep the adopted pet for 7 days.

string.name: STR_CASH_PETCARD_WARE_U_LITTLESHUGOMSANTA_01_DESC
string.body:
Solorinerk's Egg.
A 24-space pet bag.
Uses your cooking and magic items automatically.
Can be bought from a Pet Minder.

string.name: STR_JUNK_CAT_HAIR_01_DESC

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_BED_55A_DESC
string.body: It is a bed decorated with Queen Klawnickt's visage. How could anyone sleep with that thing staring at them?

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_BED_55B_DESC
string.body: A bed that was modeled after Turatu's features. Even though it looks kinda wet, it's actually really, really comfortable.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_SOFA_55A_DESC
string.body: A seat modeled on Skuma Silvereye's features.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_SOFA_55B_DESC
string.body: A seat modeled on Elder Narikiki's features. It's pure comfort, no matter how you lie on it.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_SOFA_D_55A_DESC
string.body: A seat modeled on Chieftain Ulagu's features. It feels snug and comfortable, though the beak is a bit distracting.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_SOFA_D_55B_DESC
string.body: A seat modeled on Gravekeeper Basaim's features. The head sculpture is beaming with bluish eyes, radiating an ominous vibe. It should be effective for repelling burglars and thieves.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_BED_60A_DESC
string.body: A bed blessed with the protection of the Spirit of Tranquility. It resonates with a calming warmth.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_BED_60B_DESC
string.body: A stone bed decorated with Daturum's bust. More functional than comfortable, this bed is recommended for any Daevas concerned about their spinal health.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_SOFA_60A_DESC
string.body: A lighting stand that was remodeled to look like Captain Babelkin's helmet. The words "Made in the Kaichin Engineering Union" are engraved on the inside of the stand.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_SOFA_60B_DESC
string.body: A couch imbued with the raw power of Vanuka the Earthshaker. Creepy!

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_CHAIR_60A_DESC
string.body: A chair that couldn't be more comfortable if it tried.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_CHAIR_60B_DESC
string.body: A chair inspired by the features of Ironjaw Tarapu. As interesting as it looks, it doesn't look all that comfortable.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_RUG_60A_DESC
string.body: A wall-mounted decoration made from the skin of Gabo the Obstinate. It is a flawless, top-quality product with fine fur and a sharp horn.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_RUG_60B_DESC
string.body: A wall-mounted decoration inspired by the features of Insidious Barolf. Scary stuff.

string.name: STR_ACHARGE_ITEM_LEVEL01_60A_DESC
string.body: Adds magic charge up to the maximum allowed for Level 1 when used on an item that can be augmented.\nAfter activating an item for augmentation, double-click (or use the right mouse button) to select an item as the target to be augmented.

string.name: STR_ACHARGE_ITEM_LEVEL02_60A_DESC
string.body: When augmenting an item, the magic used can be allocated up to a level 2 maximum.\nAfter activating an augmented item by double-clicking (or using the right mouse button), you can select an item as the target to be augmented.

string.name: STR_ACHARGE_ITEM_D_LEVEL01_60A_DESC
string.body: Adds magic charge up to the maximum allowed for Level 1 when used on an item that can be augmented.\nAfter activating an item for augmentation, double-click (or use the right mouse button) to select an item as the target to be augmented.

string.name: STR_ACHARGE_ITEM_PACK_LEVEL01_60A_DESC
string.body: Enhances all suitable and equipped items using magic power up to level 1.\nActivate the item for augmentation by double-clicking (or right-clicking).

string.name: STR_ACHARGE_ITEM_PACK_LEVEL02_60A_DESC

string.name: STR_WORLD_CASH_COUPON_CUSTOMIZE_01_60M_DESC
string.body: You can change your face and body shape.\nElyos can change appearance by going to Maenia in the Fine Boutique in Sanctum, and Asmodians can visit Himingleva in the Fine Boutique in Pandaemonium to change their appearance.

string.name: STR_WORLD_CASH_COUPON_SEX_EXCHANGE_01_60M_DESC
string.body: You can change your gender as well as your face and body shape.\nElyos can change gender by going to Euripides in a tavern in the Outer Dock, and Asmodians can visit Yotunmord in the back alleys of the Pandaemonium Plaza to change their gender.

string.name: WORLD_WRAP_REFILL_SEX_EXCHANGE_3DAY_DESC

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_01A_DESC
string.body: You can fly even if you've only got one wing. Have faith and dedicate yourself to everything you do.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_02A_DESC
string.body: You feel as though you could obtain Aether from the very air around you. Only committed efforts breed hope.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_03A_DESC
string.body: You have lots of issues and mistakes to correct, but a helper will appear to get you out of trouble.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_04A_DESC
string.body: Consider how the mother Brax responds to the cries of her young Braxie. You have a face of preordained promise.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_05A_DESC
string.body: Stop your worries over slow growth. The only thing that should concern you is if you've stopped moving at all.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while the charm remains active.\nThis effect expires after 30 minutes, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_06A_DESC
string.body: You may have anxieties on the outside, but feel pleasant on the inside. Rest yourself for comfort and wellbeing.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_07A_DESC
string.body: The grass lies as the wind blows. Remain committed to your party leader and you'll be compensated in more ways than one.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_08A_DESC
string.body: Consider how Kirrin cross water. You can't make your way across water without your tail getting wet.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_09A_DESC
string.body: You change your equipment according to the changing season, according to the changing needs of your situation. Everything thus falls into place.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_10A_DESC
string.body: As the pond water spreads to plants and trees, trust advances through Porgus and Ribbit. It is beneficial for you to cross the biggest rivers, the toughest challenges. Only then will disasters and difficulties be dissipated.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_11A_DESC
string.body: While stars appear in broad daylight, they retreat so far from the sun that they cannot be seen. When the sun appears under water, it is difficult to get it to brighten up the outlook of your ongoing trials.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_12A_DESC
string.body: The pot looks a Kobold, making them match each other perfectly. Cooking raw food requires changes in the process and creates changes in chemistry. Only when completed, the scent and taste you desire will be obtained.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_13A_DESC
string.body: Daru changes to become Kirrin. You should mend old things and adopt new things. You cannot pour new wine into an old, dirty skin.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_14A_DESC
string.body: An auspicious bird is flying high, promising something better for you. A small seed will sprout slowly, so slowly, into a mighty tree.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_15A_DESC
string.body: It wasn't the item you desired, but perhaps it desired you. Nothing was ever guaranteed, so making the best of your opportunities leads you to something more.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_16A_DESC
string.body: It is as easy as slashing through Spriggs with a Master Orichalcum Dagger. It may look like a loss at first, but will turn out to be a blessing in disguise later on.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_17A_DESC
string.body: The male Brax leans against the fence, rather than carrying its own weight. It is not going to be advantageous for you, so stop seeking support, because whatever help you gain will be minor, indeed.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_18A_DESC
string.body: A flower is about to bloom on a winter tree. Even if you firmly discipline your mind and move forward, you should consider yourself lucky if only half of what you have wished for becomes realised.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_19A_DESC
string.body: The ground rumbles, a Sparkle appears and strikes its wings together. Everything under the sun flows to you so easily, and nothing can go wrong at this point.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_20A_DESC
string.body: A wolf may pass easily among docile sheep. Beware evil intent disguised by beauty. If you keep your heart pure, everything will fall into place.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_21A_DESC
string.body: As fishes seek calm pools in which to play, you get to share an item with your closest Daeva. Everything you desire will be yours. How can you not like everything?\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_22A_DESC
string.body: Although you acquired a Hero item, it doesn't belong to your class. Its greater force instead drags you down, slowing your reactions. If you keep your heart pure and stay focused on who you are, everything will fall into place.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_23A_DESC
string.body: You attack with the strength of several Daeva at once. The number of foes won't be a problem for you. Petty minds should avoid using this.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_24A_DESC
string.body: You continue to pursue Drakie, but you really need to find Daru. Chasing a habit prevents you from seeking something better.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_01B_DESC
string.body: A fair wind is blowing in your direction, everything starts to prosper, and your honourable reputation becomes even more elevated.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 20%% while the charm remains active.\nThis effect expires after 30 minutes, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_02B_DESC
string.body: A path of open wind and water droplets form a bridge across the heavens. If you have a destination to reach, it is definitely an auspicious sign.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 20%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_03B_DESC
string.body: Swords are returned to their sheaths in respect, and you are presented to an Empyrean Lord. Nothing can hinder you do because all will be well.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 20%% while the charm remains active.\nThis effect expires after 30 minutes, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_04B_DESC
string.body: Imagine Stormwing and Tahabata fighting each other in front of your eyes. Even the youngest Daeva will achieve two goals in a single attempt.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 20%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_05B_DESC
string.body: You ride on flooding river water to traverse hundreds of miles in a heartbeat. Even the smallest wing will fly you to your goal.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 20%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_MISSON_WEAPON_60A_DESC
string.body: A weapon that can be infused with the power of the Reian Tribe. Keep this safe until you reach Level 60.

string.name: STR_ITEM_VISITORTREE_IDRAKSHA_GLOVESHOES_01_DESC
string.body: A Guestbloom obtained from Raksang.\nWhen well maintained, often with Guestbloom Fertilizers, this Guestbloom can give you a pair of boots or gloves from the legendary Raksha Legionary.

string.name: STR_ITEM_VISITORTREE_IDYUN_GLOVESHOES_01_DESC
string.body: A Guestbloom obtained from the Rentus Base.\nWhen well maintained, often with Guestbloom Fertilizers, this Guestbloom can give you a pair of boots or gloves from the Resistance Army.

string.name: STR_ITEM_OWNERTREE_TREASURE_04D_01_DESC
string.body: Lesser Ancient Icon Hearthbloom.\nHouse owners of level 50 and lower can obtain Lesser Ancient Icons once per day when by using their Hearthbloom Fertilizers. House owners of level 51 and above are not eligible for a reward.

string.name: STR_ITEM_VISITORTREE_IDCORE_COSTUME_01_DESC
string.body: An Abyssal Plate Costume Guestbloom.\nWhen well maintained, often with Guestbloom Fertilizers, this Guestbloom can give you a Forgotten Abyss Plate Costume or, rarely, a Forgotten Abyss Plate Costume Guestbloom.

string.name: STR_ITEM_VISITORTREE_FANATIC01_COSTUME_01_DESC
string.body: A Dragonbound Leather Costume Guestbloom.\nWhen well maintained, often with Guestbloom Fertilizers, this Guestbloom can give you a Dragonbound Leather Costume, rarely, a Dragonbound Leather Costume Guestbloom.

string.name: STR_WRAP_BIRTHCAKE_OWNER_DESC
string.body: A bundle of birthday cake slices--did you take more than your share?\nIt contains several pieces of a birthday cake, and you can double-click or right-click it to open it.

string.name: STR_WRAP_QUEST_BUTLER_GIFT_01_DESC
string.body: A gift from your butler.\nContains a Guestbloom Fertilizer. Double-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_VISITANTTREE_IDRAKSHA_SHSGLV_DESC
string.body: A bundle containing Raksha's general goods.\nContains either a pair of boots or gloves. Double-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_VISITANTTREE_IDYUN_SHSGLV_DESC
string.body: A bundle containing the Resistance Army's general goods.\nContains either a pair of boots or gloves. Double-click to open.

string.name: STR_TEST_EVENT_FIRECRACKER_01_DESC
string.body: Fireworks full of bangs and flashes!

string.name: STR_ITEM_VISITORTREE_IDCORE_ch_COSTUME_01_DESC
string.body: An Abyssal Chain Costume Guestbloom.\nWhen well maintained, often with Guestbloom Fertilizers, this Guestbloom can give you a Forgotten Abyss Chain Costume or, rarely, an Abyssal Chain Costume Guestbloom.

string.name: STR_ITEM_VISITORTREE_FANATIC01_rb_COSTUME_01_DESC
string.body: A Dragonbound Cloth Costume Guestbloom.\nWhen well maintained, often with Guestbloom Fertilizers, this Guestbloom can give you a Dragonbound Cloth Costume or, rarely, a Dragonbound Costume Guestbloom.

string.name: STR_WRAP_VISITANTTREE_LOOKCHANGE_ABYSS_PL_DESC
string.body: A bundle containing an Abyssal Plate Costume.\nContains one of the following: jacket, trousers, gloves, pauldron, or gloves. Double-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_VISITANTTREE_LOOKCHANGE_ABYSS_CH_DESC
string.body: A bundle containing an Abyssal Chain Costume.\nContains one of the following: jacket, trousers, gloves, pauldron, or gloves. Double-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_VISITANTTREE_LOOKCHANGE_DRAGON_LT_DESC
string.body: A bundle containing an Abyssal Leather Costume.\nContains one of the following: jacket, trousers, gloves, pauldron, or gloves. Double-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_VISITANTTREE_LOOKCHANGE_DRAGON_RB_DESC
string.body: A bundle containing an Abyssal Cloth Costume.\nContains one of the following: jacket, trousers, gloves, pauldron, or gloves. Double-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_OWNERTREE_TREASURE_04D_01_DESC
string.body: A bundle Lesser Ancient Icons.\n Players from level 1 through 50 can use this. Double-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_CASH_REFILL_ENCHANTBOX_02_DESC
string.body: Contains enchantment stones which can be used for a short period of time.\nDouble-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_CASH_UNIQUE_PROC_PACK_01_DESC
string.body: A bundle of unique Godstones.\nContains a variety of Fabled Godstones. Double-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_CASH_FINAL_REWARD_CUBE_01_DESC
string.body: A mysterious box.\nContains one of the following: enchantment stone refill box (10-day coupon), unique godstone bundle, or a lucky wing feather. Double-click to open.

string.name: STR_CASH_XPBOOST_03_DESC
string.body: Gain 20%% additional XP from gathering, crafting, and hunting creatures while the Lodas's Amulet is active.\nThe effect expires after 2 hours, and has a cooldown of 5 hours.

string.name: STR_CASH_SCROLL_START_KIT_01B_DESC
string.body: There is no resurrection penalty or XP loss for being killed, and flight costs/teleport cost only 1 Kinah.

string.name: STR_JUNK_WORLD_EVENT_EASTER_FAKE_01A_DESC
string.body: A rotten Pluma egg.\nThe smell is... well... rotten.

string.name: STR_JUNK_WORLD_EVENT_EASTER_FAKE_02A_DESC
string.body: A smashed Pluma egg.\nIt's far too damaged to be used for the festival.

string.name: STR_JUNK_WORLD_EVENT_EASTER_FAKE_03A_DESC
string.body: This barrel has drained completely due to a leak.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_WORLD_EVENT_MATERIAL_EASTER_01A_DESC
string.body: Red Dye used for drawing pretty pictures.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_WORLD_EVENT_MATERIAL_EASTER_02A_DESC
string.body: Green Dye used for drawing pretty pictures.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_WORLD_EVENT_MATERIAL_EASTER_03A_DESC
string.body: Yellow Dye used for drawing pretty pictures.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_WORLD_EVENT_MATERIAL_EASTER_04A_DESC
string.body: A smooth and well preserved Pluma eggshell, perfectly suited for the festival.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_WORLD_EVENT_COIN_EASTER_01_DESC
string.body: A colourful Pluma egg tinged with red, green, and yellow.\nTake it to Merni in Oriel, or Sia in Pernon.

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_EASTER_REVIVALBOX_01_DESC
string.body: A box containing burgeoning new life.\nDouble-click to open.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_EASTER_FOOD_R_2STATS_S_50I_DESC
string.body: Nutritious and delicious!\n[%e1.StatUp.StatName] and [%e2.StatUp.StatName] increase by [%e1.StatUp.Value] and [%e2.StatUp.Value] points respectively for [%e1.StatUp.RemainTime].

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_EASTER_FOOD_R_2STATS_S_50J_DESC
string.body: Liquor made from Pluma Egg whites. Just a single sip makes you feel energized!\n[%e2.StatUp.StatName] and [%e3.StatUp.StatName] increase by [%e2.StatUp.Value] and [%e3.StatUp.Value] points respectively for [%e2.StatUp.RemainTime]. Warning: slight chance of tummy ache.

string.name: STR_cash_petcard_multy06_u_KolobokRed_Russia_01_3DAY_DESC
string.body:
A Red Bow Kobushka egg.
Automatically uses your cooking and magic items when necessary and gives you an unknown bundle when fed.
Can be obtained from a Pet Minder.
You can keep the parceled pet for 3 days.

string.name: STR_CASH_PETCARD_WARE_u_LITTLESHUGOMVIOLET_01_3DAY_DESC
string.body:
A Big Boy Shugo egg.
Has a 30-space pet bag.
Can be obtained from a Pet Minder.
You can keep the parceled pet for 3 days.

string.name: STR_CASH_PETCARD_MULT_U_MINITAHABATA_01_3DAY_DESC
string.body:
Tahabata egg.
Uses your cooking and magic items automatically.
Picks up items while you're in battle.
Can be obtained from a Pet Minder.
You can keep the parceled pet for 3 days.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_BASARTI_C_01_DESC
string.body: A wall decoration made from the Brigade General Vasharti's Gauntlets.\nIt gives an impression of the stateliness of Balaur armour.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_TIAMATDRAGON_C_01_DESC
string.body: A figurine in the image of Tiamat.\nTiamat was the last of the five Dragon Lords to rise.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_NARIKIKI_C_01_DESC
string.body: Narikiki's Cat Weapon.\nThis item was made in the shape of the cat weapon carried by Narikiki in the Rokoros Village.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_WLLAUOO_C_01_DESC
string.body: Chieftain Ulagus' Mask.\nThe fantastic, spiky hair makes it look like it is alive.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_TIAMATMAGE_C_01_DESC
string.body: A figurine in the image of Tiamat.\nYou feel its gaze upon you.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_NEPILIMHAMMER_C_01_DESC
string.body: That is the all-powerful Debarim hammer.\nYou can feel the power of the minerals processed within it.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_HETGELM_C_01_DESC
string.body: A model of a Hetgolem.\nA dainty-looking little robot.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_GARNON_C_01_DESC
string.body: A model of Garnon.\nIt provides a good impression of Garnon's beautiful appearance, her slim figure and her blonde hair.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_KAISINEL_C_01_DESC
string.body: A Kaisinel figurine.\nHe is the Lord of Illusion and guardian spirit of Summoners and Sorcerers.\nThe figurine embodies mercy and determination in equal measure.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_MARKOOTAN_C_01_DESC
string.body: A Lord Marchutan figurine.\nHe is the Lord of Destiny and patron of Clerics and Chanters. He is a close friend of Tower Protectress Siel and enemies with Zikel, the Lord of Destruction.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_PORGUSS_C_02_DESC
string.body: A figurine made of delicious roasted Poppy.\nThis item spreads around a pleasant, appetising odour.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_SHELLIZARDNAMED_C_01_DESC
string.body: A Behemoth figurine.\nThis souvenir provides an impression of what the hard skin of the Behemoth is like.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_CONDOR_C_01_DESC
string.body: A King Consierd figurine.\nThe soft black feathers look like high-quality silk.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_ABITAS_C_01_DESC
string.body: A Magical Ativas Crystalline figurine.\nIt looks like a beautiful, shiny crystal.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_TATAR_C_01_DESC
string.body: A model of the Golden Tatar.\nHe's a strong creature and said to originaklly have been a normal Gurriki that was mutated.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_PLETOOS_C_01_DESC
string.body: A model of the Unfinished Pletus.\nYou can admire the magnificent, golden appearance of the figurine.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_SCROLL_Devas_Day_L_DESC
string.body: A magic candle. If you use it with the cake on Daeva Day, the XP of all Daevas in the vicinity will triple.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_SCROLL_Devas_Day_D_DESC
string.body: A magic candle. If you use it with the cake on Daeva Day, the XP of all Daevas in the area will triple.

string.name: STR_ITEM_VISITORTREE_MATTER_PROC_U_01_DESC
string.body: Fabled Godstone Gallant Guestbloom.\nYou can obtain Fabled Godstones if the Gallant Guestbloom is taken good care of. Gallant Guestbloom fertiliser is needed for proper cultivation.

string.name: STR_ITEM_VISITORTREE_LILYWEAPON_01_DESC
string.body: Pure Aris Weapons Gallant Guestbloom.\nThe homeowner can receive pure Aris Weapons if guests take proper care of the Gallant Guestbloom. Gallant Guestbloom fertiliser is required for proper cultivation.

string.name: STR_ITEM_VISITORTREE_HOUSINGVEHICLE_01_DESC
string.body: Crestlich Gallant Guestbloom Egg.\nYou can obtain a Crestlich Crate (30 days) if the Gallant Guestbloom is taken good care of. You have a small chance to obtain a Crestlich Crate (unlimited). The Gallant Guestbloom Catalyst is required for proper cultivation.

string.name: STR_ITEM_VISITORTREE_HOUSINGVEHICLE_02_DESC

string.name: STR_CASH_PETCARD_MULT_U_MINIRUDRA_01_DESC
string.body:
Stormwing Egg.
Stormwings automatically use your cooking and magic items.
This pet warns you when enemies are nearby and loots items for you during combat.
You can get it from a Pet Trader.
You can keep this pet for 1 day.

string.name: STR_CASH_PETCARD_MULT_U_MINITAHABATA_01_DESC
string.body:
Tahabata Egg.
Tahabatas automatically use your cooking and magic items.
This pet loots items for you during combat.
You can get it from a Pet Trader.
You can keep this pet for 1 day.

string.name: STR_CASH_PETCARD_WARE_u_LITTLESHUGOFVIOLET_01_DESC
string.body:
Shugo Kit Egg.
A pet that has an inventory of 30 slots.
You can get this pet from a Pet Trader.
You can keep it for 3 days.

string.name: STR_VISITORTREE_MATERIAL_N_E_60A_DESC
string.body: Sacred Drenium Gallant Guestbloom.\nYou can receive 1 sacred Drenium Crystal if the Gallant Guestbloom is taken good care of. If the homeowner receives the crystal, there is a slight chance of obtaining a design for noble weapons. Gallant Guestbloom fertiliser is required for proper cultivation.

string.name: STR_VISITORTREE_MATERIAL_N_E_60B_DESC
string.body: Blessed Drenium Gallant Guestbloom.\nThe homeowner can obtain 1 Blessed Drenium Crystal if the Gallant Guestbloom is well taken care of. If the homeowner obtains the crystal, there is a slight chance of obtaining a design for noble armour. Gallant Guestbloom fertiliser is required for proper cultivation.

string.name: STR_VISITORTREE_MATERIAL_N_E_60C_DESC
string.body: Elegant Drenium Gallant Guestbloom.\nYou can receive 1 elegant Drenium Crystal if the Gallant Guestbloom is taken good care of. If the homeowner receives the crystal, there is a slight chance of obtaining a design for shining accessories. Gallant Guestbloom fertiliser is required for proper cultivation.

string.name: STR_ITEM_VISITORTREE_MATERIAL_N_E_60A_DESC
string.body: Sacred Drenium Gallant Guestbloom.\nThe homeowner can receive 1 sacred Drenium Crystal if guests take good care of the Gallant Guestbloom. If the homeowner receives the crystal, there is a slight chance of obtaining a design for noble weapons. Gallant Guestbloom fertiliser is required for proper cultivation.

string.name: STR_ITEM_VISITORTREE_MATERIAL_N_E_60B_DESC
string.body: Blessed Drenium Gallant Guestbloom.\nThe homeowner can receive 1 blessed Drenium Crystal if the guests take good care of the Gallant Guestbloom. If the homeowner receives the crystal, there is a slight chance of obtaining a design for noble armour. Gallant Guestbloom fertiliser is required for proper cultivation.

string.name: STR_ITEM_VISITORTREE_MATERIAL_N_E_60C_DESC
string.body: Elegant Drenium Gallant Guestbloom.\nThe homeowner can receive 1 elegant Drenium Crystal if the Gallant Guestbloom is taken good care of. If the homeowner receives the crystal, there is a slight chance of obtaining a design for an elegant accessory. Gallant Guestbloom fertiliser is required for proper cultivation.

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_DRESSING_TORSO_BOX_01_DESC
string.body: Asmodians can obtain one of Veille's tunics and Elyos can obtain one of Mastarius' tunics, both of which are made of either cloth, leather, chain or plate.\nDouble-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_DRESSING_GLOVE_BOX_01_DESC
string.body: Asmodians can obtain a pair of Veille's gloves and Elyos can obtain a pair of Mastarius gloves, both of which are made of either cloth, leather, chain or plate.\nDouble-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_DRESSING_SHOULDER_BOX_01_DESC
string.body: Asmodians can obtain a pair of Veille's Spaulders and Elyos can obtain a pair of Mastarius' Spaulders, both of which are made of either cloth, leather, chain or plate.\nDouble-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_DRESSING_PANTS_BOX_01_DESC
string.body: Asmodians can obtain a pair of Veille's breeches and Elyos can obtain a pair of Mastarius' breeches, both of which are made of either cloth, leather, chain or plate.\nDouble-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_DRESSING_SHOES_BOX_01_DESC
string.body: Asmodians can obtain a pair of Veille's shoes and Elyos can obtain a pair of Mastarius' shoes, both of which are made of either cloth, leather, chain or plate.\nDouble-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_GM_EVENT_DYE_BOX_01_DESC
string.body: Contains a white or black dye.\nYou can open it by double-clicking.

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_RUDOLPH_KING_BOX_01_DESC
string.body: A box containing the Granker's Blessing.\nYou can open it by double-clicking.

string.name: STR_JUNK_WORLD_EVENT_ID01_TMAP_03
string.body: Bronze Medal of the Crown Prince

string.name: STR_JUNK_WORLD_EVENT_ID01_TMAP_01_DESC
string.body: Medal of the Emperor.\nIf you place it on the sacred altar, you can enter the Emperor's Treasure Chamber.

string.name: STR_JUNK_WORLD_EVENT_ID01_TMAP_02_DESC
string.body: Medal of the Empress.\nIf you take it to the sacred altar, you can enter the Treasure Chamber of the Empress.

string.name: STR_JUNK_WORLD_EVENT_ID01_TMAP_03_DESC
string.body: Medal of the Crown Prince.\nIf you set it down on the sacred altar, you can enter the Crown Prince's Treasure Chamber.

string.name: STR_KEY_IDDF2FLYING_EVENT01_WORLD_CASH_EVENT_TREASUREBOX_01_DESC
string.body: A powerful spell has been cast upon it, which is why it does not vanish.\nThis key opens the treasure chest in the Imperial Tomb.

string.name: STR_KEY_IDDF2FLYING_EVENT01_WORLD_EVENT_TREASUREBOX_02_DESC
string.body: It was poorly crafted and vanishes when you leave the Imperial Tomb.\nThe treasure chest in the Imperial Tomb can be opened with this key.

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_LEAF_LIFE_02_DESC
string.body: A package containing the Leaves of Life.\nYou can open it by double-clicking.

string.name: STR_TEST_SELECT_DISASSEMBLY_ITEM_01_DESC
string.body: An Elyos will receive a bundle of supplies and an Asmodian will receive crafting materials.

string.name: STR_TEST_SELECT_DISASSEMBLY_ITEM_02_DESC
string.body: A Sorcerer will receive crafting materials, a Summoner will receive a Mace and a Staff.

string.name: STR_TEST_SELECT_DISASSEMBLY_ITEM_03_DESC
string.body: You will receive a Cleric weapon from Level 1 to 39, Assassin's Spaulders from level 40 to 50 and Templar Gloves from Level 50 to 60.

string.name: STR_TEST_SELECT_DISASSEMBLY_ITEM_04_DESC
string.body: An Elyos Gladiator / Templar will receive a Cleric's weapon, an Asmodian Hunter / Assassin will receive a bundle of supplies.

string.name: STR_TEST_SELECT_DISASSEMBLY_ITEM_05_DESC
string.body: An level 1 to 39 Elyos will receive a bundle of supplies, a level 40 to 50 Asmodian will receive crafting materials.

string.name: STR_TEST_SELECT_DISASSEMBLY_ITEM_06_DESC
string.body: A level 1 to 39 Gladiator / Templar will receive a classification item, a levels 40 to 50 Assassin / Hunter will receive a level 55 Cleric's weapon.

string.name: STR_TEST_SELECT_DISASSEMBLY_ITEM_07_DESC
string.body: A level 1 to 39 Elyos Hunter / Assassin will receive a bundle of supplies, a level 40 to 50 Asmodian Gladiator / Templar will receive Assassin's Spaulders.

string.name: STR_ITEM_ALL_TITLE_265_DESC
string.body: This lets you acquire the title <Fleet-footed>.\nThis title increases your Movement Speed by 3%%, Attack Speed by 2%%, Effect Speed by 2%% and Attack by 3 points.

string.name: STR_ITEM_ALL_TITLE_266_DESC
string.body: This lets you acquire the title <Nimble Fighter>.\nThis title increases your Attack Speed by 2%%, Critical Hit by 8 points and Attack by 3 points.

string.name: STR_ITEM_ALL_TITLE_267_DESC
string.body: This lets you acquire the title <Mastermind>.\nThis title increases your Effect Speed by 2%%, Critical Hit by 4 points and Magic Boost by 17 points.

string.name: STR_CASH_PETCARD_WARE_U_CAPSULECATSHAM_01_DESC
string.body: This egg contains a Siamese Cat.\nThis pet will carry a bag with 26 slots for you.\nVisit a Pet Minder to hatch this egg.

string.name: STR_CASH_PETCARD_WARE_U_CAPSULETAHABATA_01_DESC
string.body: Tahabata Egg.\nThis pet will carry a bag with 30 slots for you.\nVisit a Pet Minder to hatch this egg.

string.name: STR_WORLD_CASH_SCROLL_START_KIT_01C_1D_DESC
string.body: No resurrection penalty if you are killed, and you keep all your XP. Teleportation and flight only cost 1 Kinah.\nThis effect lasts for 1 hour.

string.name: STR_WORLD_CASH_DRBOOST_07_DESC
string.body: Increases the likelihood of obtaining items when hunting creatures by 10%%.\nThe effect lasts 1 hour and may only be activated again 1 hour after that.

string.name: STR_CASH_WEAPON_REIDENTIFY_M_65A_DESC
string.body: Re-identifies weapons.\nDouble-click on the item bar and select the item to re-identify.\nCan only be used on mythical weapons up to level 65.

string.name: STR_CASH_ARMOR_REIDENTIFY_M_65A_DESC
string.body: Re-identifies armour.\nDouble-click on the item bar and select the item to re-identify.\nCan only be used on mythical armour up to level 65.

string.body:

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_STOLEN_NAME_MAYBE
string.body:
Your account requires identification.

Confirm your identity on the official Aion Support website (http://support.en.aionfreetoplay.com).

You can find further information on the official Aion Support website (http://support.en.aionfreetoplay.com).

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_STOLEN_NAME
string.body:
Your account has been suspended in accordance with the terms and conditions of the AION service agreement. You used other's identity to create your account.

For more information, contact us on the official AION support website (http://support.en.aionfreetoplay.com).

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_STOLEN_PAY
string.body:
Your account has been temporarily suspended because past payments were not received.

Please contact support (http://support.en.aionfreetoplay.com/).

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_HOUSE
string.body:
Your account has been banned due to spamming.

You can find further information on the official Aion Support website (http://support.en.aionfreetoplay.com).

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_BOT_AUTO
string.body:
Your account has been banned in accordance with the guidelines and user policies, because you used software that is not permitted for use in the game by the company.

More information has been sent to your email address.

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_BOT_MANUAL
string.body:
Your account has been suspended in accordance with the terms and conditions of our service agreement. You used illegal software in the game which is not permitted.

For more information, contact us on the official AION website (http://aionfreetoplay.com).

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_BOT_PERIOD
string.body:
Your account has been suspended for 10 days because of the use of illegal software. A repeated violation in the future may lead to a permanent termination of your account.

For more information, contact us by using the 1:1 Petition on the Aion official website (www.Aion.co.kr or Aion.plaync.co.kr).

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_TRADE_7
string.body:
Your account has been banned for 7 days due to attempted spamming, or trading with cash or other games.

You can find further information on the official Aion Support website (http://support.en.aionfreetoplay.com).

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_TRADE_30
string.body:
Your account has been banned for 30 days due to spamming, trading with cash or other games.

You can find further information on the official Aion Support website (http://support.en.aionfreetoplay.com).

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_TRADE_EVER
string.body:
Your account has been banned due to attempted spamming, or trading with cash or other games.

You can find further information on the official Aion Support website (http://support.en.aionfreetoplay.com).

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_TRADE_ACCOUNT_30
string.body:
Your account has been suspended for 30 days in accordance with the terms and conditions of the AION service agreement. You traded or tried to trade items or characters (accounts) of the game with cash, commodities, or items of another game.

For more information, contact us on the official AION website (http://aionfreetoplay.com).

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_TRADE_ACCOUNT_EVER
string.body:
Your account has been suspended in accordance with the terms and conditions of the AION service agreement. You traded or tried to trade items or characters (accounts) of the game with cash, commodities, or items of another game.

For more information, contact us on the official AION website (http://aionfreetoplay.com).

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_TRADE_AGAIN
string.body:
Your account has been suspended in accordance with the terms and conditions of the AION service agreement. You reported a false incident or interfered with the operation of the game.

For more information, contact us on the official AION website (http://aionfreetoplay.com).

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_TRADE_ACCOUNT
string.body:
Your cannot access your account as your integrated account has been suspended in accordance with the terms and conditions of the AION service agreement. You traded or tried to trade items or characters (accounts) of the game with cash, commodities, or items of another game.

For more information, contact us on the official AION website (http://aionfreetoplay.com).

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_STOLEN_ACCOUNT_MAYBE
string.body:
Your account has been banned due to account theft.

If you have given us an e-mail address, we have sent you a notification.

If you are not involved in account theft, please let us know on the official Aion Support website (http://support.en.aionfreetoplay.com). You can find further information from the Customer Centre.

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_STOLEN_ACCOUNT_LIE
string.body:
Your account has been banned in accordance with our principles regarding the reporting of account theft, because you falsely reported the theft of an account.

Falsely reporting account theft can be damaging to other players.

You can find further information on the official Aion Support website (http://support.en.aionfreetoplay.com).

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_STOLEN_ACCOUNT_NO_CONFIRM
string.body:
Your account has been suspended because your account theft report was determined to be false as you didn't confirm your identity within 7 days after the account theft report.

But, if you confirm your identity within 30 days after the report, we will proceed with the investigation of your report normally. So, please do so at the customer centre on the AION website (http://aionfreetoplay.com).

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_FRAUD
string.body:
Your account has been banned in accordance with company policy due to attempted fraud or disturbing the public order.

You can find further information on the official Aion Support website (http://support.en.aionfreetoplay.com).

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_FRAUD_7
string.body:
Your account has been banned in accordance with company policy due to attempted fraud or disturbing the public order.

You can find further information on the official Aion Support website (http://support.en.aionfreetoplay.com).

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_FRAUD_EVER
string.body:
Your account has been suspended in accordance with the terms and conditions of the AION service agreement. You committed or tried to commit an act that obstructs public safety or goes against the social order.

For more information, contact us on the official AION website (http://aionfreetoplay.com).

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_GAMBLE
string.body:
You should not do any of the listed or similar acts, including the obstruction of public order and wrongful communication against the goodwill of the game. Your account has been suspended in accordance with the terms and conditions of the AION service agreement.

For more information, contact us on the official AION website (http://aionfreetoplay.com).

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_GAMBLE_30
string.body:
Your account has been banned for 30 days due to illegal gambling.

You can find further information on the official Aion Support website (http://support.en.aionfreetoplay.com).

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_GAMBLE_EVER
string.body:
Your account has been suspended in accordance with the terms and conditions of the AION service agreement and the company's operation policy. You participated in advertising, supporting, or assisting improper game play in the game.

For more information, contact us on the official AION website (http://aionfreetoplay.com).

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_BOT
string.body:
Your account has been suspended in accordance with the terms and conditions of the Aion service agreement and the company's operation policy because you used illegal software, which is not permitted.

For more information, contact us by using the 1:1 Petition on the Aion official website (www.Aion.co.kr or Aion.plaync.co.kr).

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_ABUSE
string.body:

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_ABUSE_LIGHT
string.body:
Your account has been suspended in accordance with the terms and conditions of the Aion service agreement because you either abused the system or directly affected the game in a wrongful way.

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_ABUSE_SERIOUS

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_BAD_LANGUAGE
string.body:
Your account has been banned in accordance with the company policy, due to the use of curse words or insults.

More information has been sent to your email address.

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_BAD_PROGRAM_BUT_BOT
string.body:
Your account has been banned for a year due to the use of illegal programmes.

You can find further information on the official Aion Support website (http://support.en.aionfreetoplay.com).

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_PRETEND_INSIDER
string.body:
Your account has been suspended in accordance with the terms and conditions of the AION service agreement. You were found to have impersonated a game master (GM), an employee of the company, or the company itself.

For more information, contact us on the official AION website (http://aionfreetoplay.com).

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_PLAY_ABNORMAL
string.body:
Your account has been permanently banned due to a breech against the user policy of AION Free-to-Play.

More information has been sent to your email address.

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_BUNDLE
string.body:
Your account has been temporarily banned due to a breech against the AION Free-to-Play game rules.

More information has been sent to your email address.

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_ETC
string.body:
Your account has been suspended because you breached the AION game service agreement or the company's operation policy.

For more information about the account suspension, contact us by visiting the AION website (http://aionfreetoplay.com).

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_EXTERNAL_REQUEST
string.body:
Your account has been suspended by an official request from a law enforcement agency.

This action was taken because an official request from such a body has legal implications. For more information, contact us on the official AION website (http://aionfreetoplay.com).

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_UNPAIED
string.body: Your account has been suspended temporarily because you have not made a recent payment. Please pay the outstanding amount, and then confirm by visiting the AION support site (http://support.en.aionfreetoplay.com/).

string.name: STR_L2AUTH_BLOCK_DETOUR_IP
string.body:
Your account has been temporarily suspended because you are suspected of using an other's identity without permission.

string.name: STR_ACCUSE_UPGRADE_1_LEVEL
string.body:
You entered into the Phase 1 Restriction state because auto hunting reports have been received. The Phase 1 Restriction does not do any harm on your play. But more reports will increase the level of restriction, which will affect your XP and item acquisition.
You can use the '/Restriction' command to see your restriction phase and the release time.
Enter '%0' in the input window after you check the message.

string.name: STR_ACCUSE_UPGRADE_2_LEVEL
string.body:
You entered Phase 2 Restriction because of reports against your account. Phase 2 Restriction lowers your XP, Kinah and Abyss Point Rates as well as your Gathering and Extraction Success Rates. If your Restriction Phase increases due to more reports, your play will become more limited.
You can use '/Restriction' command to see the Restriction Phase and release time.
Enter '%0' in the input window after you check the message.

string.name: STR_ACCUSE_UPGRADE_3_LEVEL
string.body:
You entered Phase 3 Restriction because of reports against your account. While you are in Phase 3 Restriction, you cannot acquire rewards, and your XP, Kinah and Abyss Points as well as Gathering and Extraction Success Rates will continue to decrease. You are also banned from joining a Group or Alliance. You will face even greater restrictions should the reports continue to accumulate.
You can use '/Restriction' command to see your current Restriction Phase and release time.
Enter '%0' in the input window after you have checked the message.

string.name: STR_ACCUSE_UPGRADE_4_LEVEL
string.body:
You entered Phase 4 Restriction because of reports against your account. While you are in Phase 4 Restriction, you cannot acquire rewards, XP, Kinah or Abyss Points, and you will be unable to gather or extract items. You are also banned from joining a Group or Alliance.
You can use '/Restriction' command to see your current Restriction Phase and release time.
Enter '%0' in the input window after you have checked the message.

string.name: STR_NOTICE_MIXED_RACED_AFTER_SERVER_MERGE
string.body:
Aion was designed for players to play only one race per server. We have temporarily allowed you to play both Elyos and Asmodians on the same server. When this period ends, you won't be able to play on this server until you have only one race on this server.


To enjoy Aion after the dual race play period, and to prepare yourself for an easy transition to normal server race constraints, take action:

1. Transfer any characters of the opposite race that you want to keep during the free transfer period by logging in to your NCsoft Master Account, clicking on your Aion Game Account and following the remaining on-screen instructions.

2. Delete any low-level characters of the race that you do not currently play.

In the coming months, we will be moving characters off of the servers to return the game to its normal server race constraints. However, before we take any action, we'll provide more information here and on www.aionfreetoplay.com.

Type OK to continue.

string.name: STR_IDKAMAR_MATCH_DESC
string.body:
An Instance is a place in which Elyos and Asmodians fight each other for a specified time.

The faction that earns the most points using tanks and supplies wins.

When you enter the Instance, all enchantments will be lifted.

string.name: STR_DIC_M_IDF5_TD_DragonRider_Chief_N_65_Al
string.body: Supreme Commander Pashid;A Beritra Army commander leading the attack on the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_IDLDF5b_TD]. He must be eliminated in order to end the conflict.

string.name: STR_DIC_M_LDF5b_F1_Vri_Post_1st_Q_KN_Nmd_65_Ah
string.body: Captain Vasti;The captain of the 43rd Beritra Army's first unit. He is a battle-tested commander and leads the first unit, the unit with the most combat experience. He will appear randomly at one of the posts along the Beritra Defence Line in South Katalam.

string.name: STR_DIC_M_LDF5a_5011_Vri_1stBoss_Q_Fi_Nmd_65_Al
string.body: Tavrosh;Brigade General of the 43rd Army, the Beritra core troops in Katalam, and supreme commander of all Beritra units posted in Katalam. He will only appear if the Balaur occupy the Sillus Fortress.

string.name: STR_DIC_M_IDF5_U2_P_VriIU_Wi_N_65_Ah
string.body: Staff Officer Syaroka;A commander of the special research troop, sent to the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_IDLDF5_Under_02_all] to obtain the relics containing instructions on the use of Idgel. She is a member of the third unit of the Beritra Army.

string.name: STR_DIC_M_IDF5_U2_P_VriRP_Ri_N_65_Ae2
string.body: Supreme Healer Tagnu;A commander of the special research troop, sent to the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_IDLDF5_Under_02_all] to obtain the relics with instructions on the use of Idgel. She is a member of the 3rd troop of the Beritra Army.

string.body: Guard Captain Rohuka;A member of the 40th Beritra Army Brigade General's escort. Sita promoted him due to his outstanding skills, and he is now acting as the guard captain in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_IDVritra_Base_all].

string.name: STR_DIC_M_IDVritra_Base_Drakan_Gi_65_Ae2_Nmd
string.body: Chief Cannoneer Kurmata; The chief cannoneer of the 40th Beritra Army Brigade General's escort, and superior officer to all other cannoneers. She can be found in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_IDVritra_Base_all].

string.name: STR_DIC_M_IDVritra_Base_Drakan_Wi_65_Ae2_Nmd
string.body: Researcher Teselik;A researcher of the 40th Beritra Army Brigade General's advisers. She is researching the weapons in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_IDVritra_Base_all] and enjoys Sita's confidence.

string.name: STR_DIC_M_IDVritra_Base_Drakan_Fi_65_Ae2_Nmd
string.body: Supply Commander Ranodim;A supply commander of the 40th Beritra Army Brigade General's escort in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_IDVritra_Base_all]. He was promoted to commander because of his extensive combat experience.

string.name: STR_DIC_M_IDVritra_Base_Drakan_Guardian_65_Ae2_Nmd
string.body: Chief of Staff Moriata;The chief of staff of the 40th Beritra Army Brigade General's escort. He can be found in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_IDVritra_Base_all]. Although he doesn't look it, he is very resourceful and experienced, and thus very well suited as chief of staff.

string.body: Makekike;Supreme Harlequin of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_IDASTERIA_IU_WORLD_01]. He is big, violent and not too bright.

string.body: Bibaroka;Chief Tamer of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_IDASTERIA_IU_WORLD_01]. A tamer whose temper allows her to tame even the wildest of beasts.

string.name: STR_DIC_M_IDASTERIA_WORLD_NMD_03
string.body: Rukibuki;A Sorcerer who is in charge of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_IDASTERIA_IU_WORLD_01]. He is so greedy for money that he even abducted the Otherworld Faerie [%dic:STR_DIC_N_IDAsteria_IU_WORLD_IU_NPC01].

string.name: STR_DIC_M_IDDF3_FeA_Naga_All
string.body: Bakarma Balaur;Balaur who can be found in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_H].

string.name: STR_DIC_TEST02
string.body: Aikern Valt;He was born into a region at war and married a wicked woman who beats him daily. His only saving grace is his charming looks.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA01
string.body: Elpas;A Mercenary Sentinel guarding the [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA01] in Poeta. Being innocent and honest, he always takes good care of others.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA02
string.body: Asteros;A priest of [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA02] in Poeta. He is well-respected by the village residents.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA03
string.body: Polinia;A priest helping [%dic:STR_DIC_LA02] at [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA02] in Poeta. She records the missions the mercenary troops have carried out, and settles accounts with them.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA04
string.body: Mune;A seamstress working in the armour shop at the [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA02] in Poeta. She has a generous personality and is good at Tailoring.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA05
string.body: Uno;A skilled cook in [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA02] in Poeta. His only concern is that his wife, [%dic:STR_DIC_LA07], does not pay much attention to the family.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA06
string.body: Ager;The owner of [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA209] in Poeta. He stays in [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA02] now, after being driven out of his farm by Kerubs.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA07
string.body: Feira;An angler fishing at [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA03] in Poeta. She is the wife of [%dic:STR_DIC_LA05] and is engrossed in fishing.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA08
string.body: Pranoa;A farmer living near [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA03] in Poeta. The Kerubs are hindering his ability to work his farm.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA09
string.body: Geolus;An Ecologist at the [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA15] in Verteron. He is researching the contamination of the forest, along with his assistant [%dic:STR_DIC_LA160].

string.name: STR_DIC_LA10
string.body: Namus;A lumberjack making a living from cutting trees at [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA04] in Poeta. He's also skilled at making potions.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA11
string.body: Melponeh;A scholar at the [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA05] in Poeta. She has studied the history of the Krall and Kobolds. She's got a mercenary attitude towards her work.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA12
string.body: Pernos;A mysterious old hermit dwelling near the [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA06] in Poeta.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA13
string.body: Parine;A resident of [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA09]. She worries constantly about everything.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA14
string.body: Alteno;He is studying Soul Healing at [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA09], but his progress is very slow. It's putting a strain on his marriage to [%dic:STR_DIC_LA16].

string.name: STR_DIC_LA15
string.body: Drasia;A Food Merchant of [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA09]. She firmly believes that she is good at cooking, but others would tell you otherwise.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA16
string.body: Enia;The wife of [%dic:STR_DIC_LA14] and a resident of [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA09]. Her husband is studying to be a Soul Healer, which takes all of his time. She worries that their marriage is suffering because of it.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA17
string.body: William;A Guardian Centurion of [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA09]. He stands guard outside the Brigade General's headquarters building, along with his tamed Griffon.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA18
string.body: Hyacinte;A Guardian of [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA09]. He is in charge of the financial affairs of the Guardians stationed in the Fortress, and is always concerned over shortages of supplies.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA19
string.body: Spatalos;The Fortress Commander of [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA09]. He lost his wife and son in the Krall War, and has become correspondingly ruthless in his pursuit of victory.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA20
string.body: Manos;An old man living in [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA09]. He is the father of [%dic:STR_DIC_LA23] and the brother of Belbua.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA21
string.body: Poa;A Mercenary Scout standing between the [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA06] and [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA08] in Poeta. He believes in his work and is quite cautious.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA22
string.body: Selene;A priest of [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA09]. She looks kind, but at the same time she is rather arrogant. She advises newcomers at the Verteron Citadel.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA23
string.body: Qydro;The son of [%dic:STR_DIC_LA20] and a resident of [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA10] in Verteron. He might drink a bit too much, but he respects the elderly and writes to his father frequently.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA24
string.body: Abolos;Watch Leader at [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA10] in Verteron. He became the Leader because there was nobody else suitable, but he is a thoughtful leader in his own way. He has a tamed Griffon at his side at all times.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA25
string.body: Naia;A resident of [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA10] in Verteron. She is rather dissatisfied with her husband [%dic:STR_DIC_LA28] as he seems to do nothing but waste time.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA26
string.body: Santenius;A priest of [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA10] in Verteron. He is quite pious.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA27
string.body: Estino;A Guardian protecting the [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA11] in Verteron.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA28
string.body: Lostes;A member of the [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA10] Watch in Verteron, and [%dic:STR_DIC_LA25]'s husband. He talks a good game but is often not up to the things he brags about. He hangs around in the [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA15].

string.name: STR_DIC_LA29
string.body: Lepios;An Ecology Researcher who studies the contamination of the Tolbas Forest in Verteron. Since being wounded while collecting data, he has been staying in the [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA16].

string.name: STR_DIC_LA30
string.body: Roseino;A Guardian protecting the [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA17] in Verteron. She is a capable and dedicated soldier who fervently studies the cause of the contamination. Despite her average looks, she is popular among the men in the neighbouring village.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA31
string.body: Dronoa;A pilgrim at [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA18] in Verteron. He ran into a bit of trouble during the Great Pilgrimage with his wife [%dic:STR_DIC_LA71].

string.name: STR_DIC_LA32
string.body: Cerios;A Guardian protecting the [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA20_1] in Verteron. He is obedient and responsible.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA33
string.body: Morai;A Guardian protecting the [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA20_1] in Verteron. She uses ambiguous expressions and seems to hide something.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA34
string.body: Zephyros;A Guardian protecting the [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA21_1] at the [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA21] in Verteron. He really hates Potcrabs.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA35
string.body: Notos;A Guardian protecting the [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA21_1] at the [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA21] in Verteron. He is suspicious as well as curious. He seems to have some sort of relationship with Morai.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA36
string.body: Kales;A farmer raising crops in [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA01] in Poeta. He is a simple man and [%dic:STR_DIC_LA03]'s cousin.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA37
string.body: Ino;A Mercenary Scout who used to guard the Timolia Mine with [%dic:STR_DIC_LA21] in Poeta. He was captured by the Krall and imprisoned within the [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA08].

string.name: STR_DIC_LA38
string.body: Khidia;A Protector of the [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA21_1] in the [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA21]. She has the ability to hear the energy of Aether. She was a member of Temple under the command of Lord [%dic:STR_DIC_LA57].

string.name: STR_DIC_LA39
string.body: Meteina;A Guardian protecting the [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA11] in Verteron. She speaks Krallic very well and is good at interrogating captured Krall.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA40
string.body: Bellia;A Protector of Illusion found in [%dic:STR_DIC_ELA24] of [%dic:STR_DIC_ELA07]. She teaches skills to Sorcerers and Spiritmasters.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA41
string.body: Lonian;A Merchant selling general goods at the [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA05] in Poeta. He has a cynical personality, and is good at managing financial affairs. He and Namus don't seem to get along.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA42
string.body: Mirdiena;A Flight Transporter in [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA09]. As a Human she used to roam all over Atreia, but now she spends her days helping others travel.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA43
string.body: Nola;A scarecrow at [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA24] of [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA14] in Verteron. Surprisingly, it can speak.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA44
string.body: Gaione;A Tog wandering about [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA09]. It's known to have once been a Guardian.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA45
string.body: Gaphyrk;A Shugo captured by the Krall and imprisoned in [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA12] in Verteron. He seems to have fallen for a Kobold named Mimiti.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA46
string.body: Dimos;A librarian who manages the Library of the Sages in [%dic:STR_DIC_ELA07]. He thinks he is suffering from chronic asthma due to the dust on the books in the library.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA47
string.body: Jumentis;The preceptor of Rangers and Assassins found in [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA29] of the Sanctum. When it comes to the study of poisons, no one else can compare.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA48
string.body: Quintus;A Guardian in the [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA37] of [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA27]. Since ascending as a Daeva, he has done many good works for the benefit of Humans.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA49
string.body: Hygea;A Guardian of Life found in the [%dic:STR_DIC_ELA24] of [%dic:STR_DIC_ELA07]. She teaches skills to Clerics and Chanters.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA50
string.body: Maniparas;A merchant of [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA10] in Verteron. He was raised as an only child, and as a result is somewhat spoiled and selfish.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA51
string.body: Daminu;Chieftain of the Elim Tribe at the [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA04] in Poeta. He is the ruler of the forest. He is found in the centre of the forest.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA52
string.body: Poppy;A Porgus cherished by [%dic:STR_DIC_LA159], a shepherd at Tolbas Village in Verteron. It has disappeared without a trace.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA53
string.body: Tutty;A pet Porgus raised by [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Pernos] in Poeta. It has disappeared without a trace.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA54
string.body: Kato;A Guardian who made the deadly poison, [%dic:STR_DIC_QILA34]. Nobody knows his whereabouts since he's left [%dic:STR_DIC_ELA07].

string.name: STR_DIC_LA56
string.body: Ariel;Leader of the Five Seraphim Lords who rule Elysea. The Empyrean Lord of Light.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA57
string.body: Nezekan;The Empyrean Lord of Justice, one of the Five Seraphim Lords who rule Elysea.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA58
string.body: Vaizel;The Empyrean Lord of Freedom, one of the Five Seraphim Lords who rule Elysea.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA59
string.body: Kaisinel;The Empyrean Lord of Illusion, one of the Five Seraphim Lords who rule Elysea.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA60
string.body: Yustiel;The Empyrean Lord of Life, one of the Five Seraphim Lords who rule Elysea.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA61
string.body: Amus;The owner of an armour shop at the [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA02] in Poeta. He is fond of the colour purple.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA62
string.body: Forest Protector Noah;An Elim standing at the entrance of [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA04] in Poeta. He is sleeping.

string.name: STR_DIC_LA63

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Devalin

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Tanmarn
string.body: Tanmarn;A Raider guarding the entrance to the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF1_7]. He suffers from nightmares.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Muninn
string.body: Munin;A prescient Daeva, now imprisoned in a crystal at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF1_19]. He was exiled after some sort of accusations in Pandaemonium.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Gungnahogg

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Ran_1

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Ran_2
string.body: Rae;The tomboy daughter of Ulgorn, hiding deep inside the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF1_9].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Fasimedes
string.body: Fasimedes;Governor of [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA27]. He is in the [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA29] of [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA27].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Lavirintos
string.body: Lavirintos;The Commander of the Miragent Holy Templars found in the [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA29] of [%dic:STR_DIC_ELA07]. As the first son of a family which has produced Daevas for generations, he has never doubted his life as a Guardian.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Jupion
