string.name: STR_DIC_N_NPC_Manduri_Survivor
string.body: Melginie;A mysterious woman who has been held for ages in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF2_SZ_A1_SUB_1] in Eltnen and is still alive.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Anasya
string.body: Taera;A Guardian Sentinel guarding the passage connecting [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF2_SZ_A1] and the Outpost Ruins in Eltnen. She has a strong sense of duty as a Daeva.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_NPC_Heratos
string.body: Heratos;A Daeva of Life stationed at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF2_SZ_C2] in Eltnen. He was shattered after failing to carry out a mission, but he seems to be on the road to recovery.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Captured_Engineer_cage
string.body: Civil Engineer;An engineer known to be locked up in the [%dic:STR_DIC_E_LF2_Lehpar_Cage] at the Lepharist Bastion in Eltnen. He is frightened.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Teos
string.body: Teos;A child staying in the refugee camp at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF2_SZ_G2] in Eltnen. He longs for his mother's embrace.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Agrips
string.body: Agrips;A Coin Administration Officer at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF2_SZ_G3_SUB_1] in Eltnen. He issues missions appropriate for each Daeva, and gives rewards from Sanctum to the Daevas who successfully complete the missions.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Lano
string.body: Lano;A Daeva of Fishing who fishes every day at the river near the Eltnen Fortress. It's said that the only thing he was ever good at was fishing.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Telamone
string.body: Telamone;A Soul Healer aiding the Daevas battling in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF2_SZ_A1].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Shugo_LF2_12
string.body: Igorerk;A Shugo living alone in an isolated place on the way from the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF2_SZ_I1] to the Lepharist Bastion in Eltnen. It's not known why he lives alone, but he seems very lonely.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Shugo_LF2_15
string.body: Korumonerk;A member of the Changarnerk Traders in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF2_SZ_E2_SUB_1]. He circles many regions delivering goods.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Shugo_LF2_13
string.body: Harumonerk;A Shugo of the Wind Breeze Shop you can find at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF2_SZ_B] or [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF2_SZ_C1_SUB_2] in Eltnen.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Shugo_LF2_14
string.body: Chiyorinrinerk;A Shugo of the Wind Breeze Shop, who wanders about [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF2_SZ_F1] or the refugee camp near [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF2_SZ_G2] in Eltnen and peddles her wares.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Perento
string.body: Perento;The Brigade General of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_A1]. An outstanding strategist who understands the situation in Heiron perfectly.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Sarantus
string.body: Sarantus;A Guardian Centurion in the Nobelium of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_A1]. Quick and hot-tempered, he gets upset easily when his men don't handle their tasks.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Barsita
string.body: Barzon;A Guardian Centurion of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_A1]. He is often mistaken for lazy because of his laid-back attitude, but he is quite earnest in his duties.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Meiheira
string.body: Meiheira;A Guardian Centurion of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_A1]. She has a deep hatred for Balaur who killed many of her men.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Sofne
string.body: Sofne;A Protector of Divinity residing in the Nobelium of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_A1]. A Daeva who ascended before the Cataclysm, she has witnessed the entire history of Atreia and is a repository of wisdom and knowledge.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Sulates
string.body: Sulates;A priest residing in the Nobelium of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_A1]. A native of Heiron, he doesn't spare his effort to let Sanctum know the difficulties of the Elyos.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Gatuso
string.body: Gasuto;A Guardian Sentinel of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_A1]. He is a newcomer, brimming with enthusiasm. But his abilities aren't yet good enough to support his zeal.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Loktania
string.body: Loktania;A Guardian Sentinel of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_A1]. As Gasuto's senior, she has her hands full.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Sisandra
string.body: Sisandra;A Guardian Sentinel on post at the entrance of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_A1]. She has a habit of marrying Human men, as she doesn't think she can be with just one person for her entire Daevic lifetime. Her third husband passed away recently.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Altiana
string.body: Altiana;A Guardian Sentinel protecting the Nobelium of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_A1]. She is rapidly climbing up the ladder of success thanks to her charisma.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Mato
string.body: Mato;A Guardian Sentinel patrolling inside [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_A1]. He was very pleased to be assigned here as there are many female colleagues.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Dolla
string.body: Dolla;A Guardian Sentinel on post inside [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_A1]. She is not to be underestimated despite her timid appearance. She's a completely different person in combat.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Kisia
string.body: Kisia;A Soul Healer of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_A1]. Frequent battles have saddled her with near-constant fatigue.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Amene
string.body: Amene;One who is in charge of flight transportation in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_A1]. She has a strong sense of responsibility for her job.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Barantus
string.body: Barantus;One who in charge of long-distance Teleportation in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_A1]. He is devoted to his duty.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Belakade
string.body: Belakade;An Administration Officer dispatched to [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_A1]. She is very good at administrative tasks.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Kasarello
string.body: Kasarello;A Guardian Sentinel on post at the entrance of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_A1]. He is a skilled swordsman, so his colleagues incessantly ask for lessons, leaving him with little time to rest.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Daruka
string.body: Daruka;A Guardian Sentinel patrolling inside [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_A1]. He used to work in the Abyss, but was reassigned after the invasion of the Balaur. He is here to give lessons to the Guardians in this area.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Eopede
string.body: Eopede;A Guardian Sentinel patrolling inside [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_A1]. She is good at magic, and was recruited from an Abyss unit. She is teaching the Guardians of the Fortress, but she is a demanding instructor.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Phuthollo
string.body: Phuthollo;A Fortress resident at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_A1]. His family has been living here since his father settled here, and although he is aware that the Fortress is in turmoil at the moment, he is confident that the Guardians can protect it.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Genes
string.body: Genes;A Fortress resident of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_A1]. He is terrified that the Balaur have invaded, but he doesn't know what to do or where to go.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Henobe
string.body: Henobe;A Fortress resident of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_A1]. He came to New Heiron Gate after escaping from Agairon Village. He thought he had come to a safe haven, but the invading Balaur have driven him to despair.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Ephos
string.body: Ephos;An Information Officer of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_A1]. He was appointed to the position when the former officer ran away.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Jukabe
string.body: Jukabe;A weapon merchant of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_A1]. He came to Heiron to make a big fortune during the war.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Kelber
string.body: Kelber;An armour merchant of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_A1]. Persuaded by his brother Jukabe, he came to Heiron to make a fortune with him.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Resha
string.body: Resha;A food merchant of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_A1]. Her food isn't that great but the generous portions and cheap price make up for the low quality.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Molina
string.body: Molina;A Fortress resident of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_A1]. An extremely practical young lady who is determined to have a Daeva for her husband in order to ensure her own safety during this hectic time.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Nekentos
string.body: Nekentos;A Fortress resident of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_A1]. He is seriously concerned about the current situation.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Orhes
string.body: Orhes;A medicine merchant of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_A1]. She is a native of the area and does not seem to have any intention of leaving there.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Gunes
string.body: Gunes;A Fortress resident of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_A1]. He is seriously concerned about the current situation of Elysea. He always listens carefully to what the Information Officer says, and then expresses his views on important issues to those around him.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Graa
string.body: Graa;A Daeva of Zephyr dispatched to [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_A1]. She is in charge of patrolling and collecting information. She organizes the information sent by her men from every corner of Heiron and sends it to Sanctum.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Tegis
string.body: Tegis;A Daeva of Zephyr dispatched to [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_FTW] in Heiron. He is very proud that he is doing something so important. Everyone else just thinks he's doing a job just like everyone else.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Nibeon
string.body: Nibeon;A flight transporter at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_FTW] in Heiron. He is devoted to his duty.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Anto
string.body: Anto;A Soul Healer at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_FTW] in Heiron. He does his best to complete the tasks he is entrusted with.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Senir
string.body: Senir;A Food Merchant at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_FTW] in Heiron. A native resident, he is a hidden master of Cooking.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Maximus
string.body: Maximus;A General Goods Merchant at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_FTW] in Heiron. A retired Daeva, he has been hiding his identity since he moved to the village. He is very reticent for anyone to know who he is.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Aifemis
string.body: Aifemis;A resident of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_FTW] in Heiron. She breaks many hearts with her innocent looks. She's currently trying to seduce several men at the same time.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Endyon
string.body: Endyon;A Guardian Sentinel of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_FTW] in Heiron. The absence of a Centurion leads him to consider himself the leader of the Guardians, and he is very proud of it.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Catid
string.body: Catid;A Guardian Sentinel dispatched to [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_FTW] in Heiron. He understands how serious it is that only two Guardians must protect the village. He thinks [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Endyon] is pathetic.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Hideros
string.body: Hideros;A guard of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_FTW] in Heiron. He is smitten with [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Aifemis].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Lantis
string.body: Lantis;A guard of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_FTW] in Heiron. Realising how desperate his village is, he has decided to protect it as best he can.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Camana
string.body: Camana;A resident of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_FTW] in Heiron. She is a martial artist, and although she hasn't joined the Watch she is prepared to help in the battle if needed.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Hellione
string.body: Heraloene;A resident of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_FTW] in Heiron. A native of the area, he is determined to stay and fight if he must.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Zetus
string.body: Zetus;A resident of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_FTW] in Heiron. An old man with poor hearing, he was labeled as an eccentric when he was younger.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Lupigena
string.body: Lupigena;A member of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_FTW] Watch in Heiron. She is brave and the de facto leader of the Watch.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Aimillia
string.body: Aimillia;A guard protecting [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_FTW] in Heiron. She is docile and performs well in the given tasks.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Menaxia
string.body: Menaxia;An intern researcher of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_FTW] in Heiron. She is very diligent and enthusiastic.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Gorgos
string.body: Gorgos;The Blue Fleet Admiral dispatched to [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_FTW] in Heiron. Losing most of his fleet was a blow to his pride. He doesn't want to admit how desperate his situation is now, so he takes his anger out on his adjutants.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Gella
string.body: Gella;A Blue Fleet adjutant dispatched to [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_FTW] in Heiron. She is on edge after being on the receiving end of one of Admiral Gorgos's frequent tirades.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Voluptes
string.body: Voluptes;A Blue Fleet adjutant dispatched to [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_FTW] in Heiron. He tries to take care of all the miscellaneous affairs, so as not to bother the admiral.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Ekseus
string.body: Ekseus;The Quartermaster of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_FTW] in Heiron. He is doing all he can to get through this difficult situation.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Skanas
string.body: Skanas;A Blue Fleet sailor patrolling [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_FTW] in Heiron. He is counting his lucky stars after coming back alive from the brink of Vanishment.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Rojani
string.body: Rojani;A sailor of the Blue Fleet dispatched to [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_FTW] in Heiron. She was shocked to see all of her fallen comrades raised as Banshees. Now she believes it is better to die as a Human.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Meteria
string.body: Meteria;A Blue Fleet sailor at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_FTW] in Heiron. She is arrogant. She doesn't believe that someone like her, who was once a famous Daeva in [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA27], could be defeated by the Asmodian Daevas of Storm.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Eudora
string.body: Eladora;A Blue Fleet sailor at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_FTW] in Heiron. She thought she could die without regret after having lived for so many years, but when she faced Vanishment her desire for life was rekindled.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Kleio
string.body: Kleio;A Blue Fleet sailor dispatched to [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_FTW] in Heiron. He is ever optimistic even in the toughest of circumstances.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Alexius
string.body: Rexius;A Blue Fleet sailor at Jeiaparan Village in Heiron. He is still in shock after coming very close to disappearing forever.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Lisidike
string.body: Liske;A researcher studying the Puitonen BogsÂ of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_014] in Heiron. She is in agony over whether she should quit her research and bear arms to fulfil her duty as a Daeva since the situation is pretty critical.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Miobera
string.body: Miobera;An archaeologist researching at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_014] in Heiron. She devotes herself single-mindedly to her study regardless of what is happening around her.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Antione
string.body: Antione;A priest of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_FTW] in Heiron. She is in panic over the invasion that may occur at any time.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Euripia
string.body: Euripia;An Administration Officer dispatched to [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_FTW] in Heiron. She is distressed because [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Demodocos] prophecied that misfortune would follow if she came here.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Tolemos
string.body: Tolemos;A magic administration officer at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_FTW] in Heiron.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Aphesius
string.body: Aphesius;An Aetheric Field Protector in charge of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_D1]. He is very capable and has a strong sense of responsibility. He blames himself for not detecting the Abyss Gate in advance.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Klaus
string.body: Klaus;A Guardian Centurion protecting the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_D1]. He has been dispatched to the Observatory only recently. He swears to protect the Observatory, since he failed to prevent the Abyss Gate from opening.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Gairos
string.body: Gairos;A Guardian Sentinel on post at the entrance of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_D1]. If he had his way he would have eradicated all the Krall, but the lack of men has forced him to stand guard and he is frustrated by it.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Rahelio
string.body: Rahelio;A Guardian Sentinel protecting [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_D1]. He obeys orders well as every soldier is supposed to.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Terentius
string.body: Terentius;A Guardian Sentinel protecting [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_D1]. He has been guarding the Observatory alone, but is now relieved that a Centurion has recently arrived.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Panaita
string.body: Panaita;A Guardian Sentinel protecting [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_D1]. She was going to be transferred to Sanctum where her husband is working, but just before her transfer the Abyss Gate opened and now she has to stay at the Observatory.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Erato
string.body: Erato;A priest guarding the altar at the rear of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_FTW] in Heiron. She studies the rituals of Sapiens.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Mirborante
string.body: Mirborante;A Soul Healer in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_D1]. He has been doing his job for ages and now he can heal souls with his eyes closed.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Seiana
string.body: Splendora;A Flight Transporter of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_D1]. Still clumsy at her job, she has to refer to the flight transportation manual regularly.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Tree_Nomove_Trajanus
string.body: Trajanus;The Elim who is the owner of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_DTW] in Heiron. He is wise and thoughtful. He considers it the most important mission to protect the Great Holy Tree, and he doesn't pay attention to Humans any more than necessary.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Tree_Move_Terba
string.body: Terba;An Elim at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_DTW] in Heiron. She is very hostile to both Humans and Daevas. She blames the Elyos for all of the current problems.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Tree_Move_Mersephon
string.body: Mersephon;An Elim at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_DTW] in Heiron. He is proud that his branches are more beautiful and abundant than the other Elim.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Kravis
string.body: Kravis;A Daeva of Zephyr dispatched to [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_DTW] in Heiron. He likes to drink, and is very playful.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Luke
string.body: Luke;A Daeva of Zephyr dispatched to [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_DTW] in Heiron. He is a little tired of his frivolous colleagues.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Edoras
string.body: Edoras;A Daeva of Zephyr at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_DTW] in Heiron. He makes a lot of jokes that only he laughs at.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Tree_Move_Prangos
string.body: Prangos;An Elim at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_DTW] in Heiron. He used to be bothered by the moss and mushrooms that grew around him, but now he has become rather attached to them.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Tree_Move_Sarumok
string.body: Sarumok;An Elim at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_DTW] in Heiron. As he is indifferent to the Elyos and his surroundings, he has no idea that his very existence is currently under threat.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Trou
string.body: Trou;A priest dispatched to [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_DTW] in Heiron. He is a religious fanatic. He thinks everything is the will of the Empyrean Lords.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Arkos
string.body: Arkos;A flight transporter assigned to [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_DTW] in Heiron. He quietly does the job assigned to him.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Sirilis
string.body: Sirilis;A Soul Healer assigned to [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_DTW] in Heiron. He is very popular because he is always cheerful.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Erone
string.body: Erone;A Daeva of Life appointed to protect [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_DTW] in Heiron. She possesses a strong sense of duty.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Rusiridite
string.body: Rusiridite;A Daeva of Life at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_DTW] in Heiron. She believes that all life is equal.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_NPC_Ageios
string.body: Ageios;A Protector of Earth guarding [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_DTW] in Heiron.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Lomulias
string.body: Lomulias;An administration officer at the Arbolu's Haven village in Heiron. He loves nature and leads a simple and honest life.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_NPC_Karanus
string.body: Karanus;A Protector of Earth guarding [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_DTW] in Heiron.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Tree_Move_Little_1
string.body: Young Elim;An Elim in Arbolu's Haven.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Tree_Move_Little_2
string.body: Young Elim;An Elim in Arbolu's Haven.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Rance
string.body: Rance;A Guardian Sentinel of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_DTW] in Heiron. He hates the undead.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Nerison
string.body: Nerison;A Daeva of Zephyr dispatched to the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_C5] in Heiron. His main mission is to deal with the Lepharists.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Kalendros
string.body: Finn;A Daeva of Zephyr dispatched to the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_C5] in Heiron. He is so timid that he can hardly look anyone in the eye.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Seniferes
string.body: Garrett;A Daeva of Zephyr dispatched to the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_C5] in Heiron. He is quite irritable.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Hestonos
string.body: Riley;A Daeva of Zephyr dispatched to the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_C5] in Heiron. He has several hobbies.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Kalione
string.body: Kalione;A scholar at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_C5] area in Heiron. She studies the effects of the Lepharists' experiments.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Kuobe
string.body: Kuobe;A Guardian Sentinel assigned to [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_C5] in Heiron. She reluctantly keeps Kalione safe.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Aiokina
string.body: Aiokina;A Guardian Sentinel protecting [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_C5] in Heiron. She is very tired.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Fenne
string.body: Riala;A Daeva of Zephyr assigned to the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_C5] in Heiron. She is overworked.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Neisthea
string.body: Neisthea;A Protector of Divinity at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_001] in Heiron. She enjoys the rugged beauty of the area.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Iorene
string.body: Iorene;A priest dispatched to the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_001] in Heiron. She has sarcastic tendencies.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Ibelia
string.body: Ibelia;A Daeva of Zephyr dispatched to the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_001] in Heiron. She doesn't realise that other people aren't as interested in history as she is.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Senemonea

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Briana
string.body: Briana;A Daeva of Flame at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_D1_2]. She has had some bad experiences with Shugos.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Vonduca
string.body: Vonduca;The Leader of the Watch at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E1]. She was chosen by popular demand.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Benyar
string.body: Benyar;A member of the Watch at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E1]. He believes Humans should defend themselves.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Auhumla
string.body: Auhumla;A resident of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E1] in Beluslan. She is afraid of dying.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Furiga
string.body: Furiga;A food merchant at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E1] in Beluslan. She has to make do with a lack of ingredients.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Angr
string.body: Angr;A member of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E1] Watch in Beluslan. He has learned some valuable lessons.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Baugi
string.body: Baugi;A member of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E1] Watch in Beluslan. He is hiding from his past.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Ocho
string.body: Ocho;A worthless member of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E1] Watch in Beluslan. He doesn't even know how to swing a sword. He may as well just be a waste of food.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Denarynt
string.body: Denarynt;A resident of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E1] in Beluslan. She left behind a life of luxury.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Ladamantrun
string.body: Ladamantrun;A researcher at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E1] in Beluslan. He helps Rubelik's research because he hopes it'll advance his own career.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Rubelik
string.body: Rubelik;An archeologist at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E1] in Beluslan. He's not interested in the refugees, only the Seiren relics.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Morhen
string.body: Morhen;A priest at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E1] in Beluslan. He does menial labour to help out the refugees.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Rotenan
string.body: Rotenan;A child in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E1] in Beluslan. He's in shock after being attacked by his undead father.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Midheim
string.body: Midheim;A resident of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E1] in Beluslan. She is thankful for the Watch's protection.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Rerua
string.body: Rerua;Lives in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E1] in Beluslan. Although she says that old folk should just die, she lives in a very health-conscious way.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Kunbernan
string.body: Kunbernan;A flight transporter in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E1] in Beluslan. He thinks his uniform makes him popular with the ladies.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Karabe
string.body: Karabe;A Soul Healer in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E1] in Beluslan. She shows concern even for the dead.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Lug
string.body: Lug;A Manastone remover in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E1] in Beluslan. He is a card-carring member of the Manastone Removers Association.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Sleipnirr
string.body: Sleipnir;An Archon Centurion dispatched to the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E1] in Beluslan. He sometimes feels the refugees aren't very bright.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Noarynt
string.body: Noarynt;An Archon Sentinel dispatched to the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E1] in Beluslan. She has her hands full.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Baredo
string.body: Baredo;An Archon Sentinel dispatched to the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E1] in Beluslan. He loathes the Balaur.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Cinnia
string.body: Cinnia;An administration officer dispatched to the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E1] in Beluslan. She is very enthusiastic.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Coventina
string.body: Coventina;An administration officer dispatched to the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E1] in Beluslan. She doesn't enjoy her job.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Shugo_DF3_5
string.body: Reyrinirerk;A general goods merchant at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E1]. She was sent there when her father discovered she'd been embezzling from the Quairerk Traders.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_DF3_NPC_Irlein
string.body: Irelein;A Seiren on Calderon Hill. Nobody knows what a Seiren would want at a place like that.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Onelr
string.body: Kettar;A Mau researcher at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_F] in Beluslan. She respects the Mau as equals.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Borvo
string.body: Borvo;A Red Mane Shaman at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_F] in Beluslan. She knows many secret remedies.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Boudica
string.body: Boudica;A flight transporter at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_F] in Beluslan. She is business-like.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Lint
string.body: Lint;A Soul Healer at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_F] in Beluslan. She really cares about peoples' souls.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_DF3_NPC_Akigatan
string.body: Chieftain Akagitan;A Mau at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_F] in Beluslan. He is concerned about the future of the land and his people.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_DF3_NPC_Nargital
string.body: Nargatal;A Mau at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_F] in Beluslan. She is Akagitan's wife and wishes she could bear him an heir.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Freyja
string.body: Freyja;An Archon Centurion dispatched to the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_F] in Beluslan. She wants to make a name for herself.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Savrina
string.body: Savrina;An Shadow Executor dispatched to the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_F] in Beluslan. She used to specialise in counter-Balaur operations.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Rith
string.body: Rith;A Manastone remover at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_F] in Beluslan. He became a Manastone remover because he doesn't like fighting.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Yoltmund
string.body: Yoltmund;An Archon of Dusk at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_F] in Beluslan. He was dispatched there at Thor's request.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Maponus
string.body: Maponus;An administration officer dispatched to the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_F] in Beluslan. He feels his career's taken a turn for the worse lately.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Art
string.body: Art;An administration officer dispatched to the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_F] in Beluslan. Despite his name, he does not love art.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_DF3_NPC_Laksyatil
string.body: Laksyatil;A Red Mane healer at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_F] in Beluslan. He knows many ancient Mau secrets.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_DF3_NPC_BabaKun
string.body: Baba Kun;A food merchant at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_F] in Beluslan. He loves Human food.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_DF3_NPC_BabaHun
string.body: Baba Hun;A general goods merchant at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_F] in Beluslan. He has strange ways of talking.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_DF3_NPC_LycanWarrior
string.body: Mau Fighter;A Mau at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_F] in Beluslan.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_DF3_NPC_LycanHunter
string.body: Mau Hunter;A Mau at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_F] in Beluslan.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Thor
string.body: Thor;Brigade General of the Drakan Punisher Legion, stationed at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_F]. He is a warrior without peer and has personally killed two thousand Balaur.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Delris
string.body: Delris;A Drakan Punisher adjutant at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_F] in Beluslan. She likes to charge directly into battle without thinking of the consequences.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Mostin
string.body: Mostin;A Drakan Punisher Legionary at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_F] in Beluslan. She loves reading and reads all the time. She's been an avid reader ever since she was three.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Epona
string.body: Epona;A Drakan Punisher Legionary at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_F] in Beluslan. She is quite the gossip, but you can't believe a word she says.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Peredur
string.body: Peredur;A Drakan Punisher Legionary at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_F] in Beluslan. Nobody's ever heard him say more than three sentences in a row.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Bowen
string.body: Bowen;A Drakan Punisher Legionary at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_F] in Beluslan. He has as many scars from cooking as from battle.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Methorn
string.body: Methorn;A Drakan Punisher Legionary at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_F] in Beluslan. He is an arrogant fool.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Skirnir
string.body: Skirnir;A Drakan Punisher Legionary at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_F] in Beluslan. He has little luck in love, but he never gives up searching for that special girl.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Dewi
string.body: Dewi;A spy at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G2_5] in Beluslan. You'd better not tell anybody he's a spy or he'll be in trouble.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Betoni
string.body: Betoni;A ghost near the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G2_3] in Beluslan. He failed in his duty to protect the Observatory.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_DF3_NPC_Hasyaditan
string.body: Hasyaditan;The Hoarfrost Chieftain, hiding at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G2_3] in Beluslan. He seeks revenge on the Balaur for betraying his tribe.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_DF3_NPC_Arita
string.body: Arita;A Mau at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G2_3] in Beluslan. After her tribe was betrayed by the Balaur, she developed some trust issues.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_DF3_NPC_Hikan
string.body: Hikan;A Mau hiding at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G2_3] in Beluslan. He doesn't fully trust the Asmodians.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_DF3_NPC_Molota
string.body: Molota;A Mau shaman at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G2_3] in Beluslan. She would do anything for her cubs.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Gwendolin
string.body: Gwendolin;The soul of the Aetheric Field Protector at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G6_2]. She finds that being a ghost has its advantages.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Shugo_DF3_13
string.body: Luurinerk;A Shugo at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_C3_2]. He says he is good at hiding, but in reality, everybody ignores him because he's boring.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Sorgrim
string.body: Sorgrim;An Archon dispatched to the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_B_2] in Beluslan. He was sent there directly after he got back from a tour of duty in the Abyss, so he's a little cranky.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Svera
string.body: Svera;A priest dispatched to the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_B_2] in Beluslan. She doesn't like grandstanding Daevas who reject menial tasks.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Stua
string.body: Stua;A spy at the Lepharist [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_C6_5] in Beluslan. Be careful not to blow her cover when you're talking to her, okay?

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Gigrite
string.body: Gigrite;A Protector of Divinity dispatched to the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_B_2] in Beluslan. She tries to keep her reptile phobia secret, but everybody knows.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Gark
string.body: Gark;A Sprigg hiding in a corner of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_C1] in Beluslan. It is scared and hungry

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Alfgeir
string.body: Alfgeir;An Archon dispatched to the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_B_2] in Beluslan. He enjoys his work.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Q2564A
string.body: Yarl;A Daeva of Flame at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_D1] in Beluslan. He rarely loses his temper.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Q2564B
string.body: Scoll;A Daeva of Flame at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_D1] in Beluslan. He is very sensitive and emotionally unstable.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Q2564C
string.body: Hefring;A Daeva of Flame at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_D1] in Beluslan. She is unhappy with the progress on melting the city.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Eldir
string.body: Eldir;A torch keeper at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E1] in Beluslan. He takes his work very seriously.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Siegfried
string.body: Siegfried;A smart adjutant dispatched to the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_F]. Epona says he has a thing for Delris, but you can't really believe her gossip.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Svafnir
string.body: Svafnir;A Centurion dispatched to the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G2_3] in Beluslan. He went from being a Mau scholar to an ambassador to the Mau.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Vanargand
string.body: Vanargand;A talking Granker in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_C2]. It doesn't like Asmodians.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Atla
string.body: Atla;A prisoner in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G4_3]. She was kidnapped from Pandaemonium.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Himmel
string.body: Hammel;A Lepharist prisoner held in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_A]. He stubbornly refuses to talk, but maybe he just hasn't been...properly persuaded.

string.name: STR_DIC_NPC_Fafner
string.body: Fafner;A spy who infiltrated [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_H] disguised as a Drakie.

string.name: STR_DIC_NPC_DF3_NPC_Mukaditan
string.body: Mukaditan;A Mau turncoat at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G6] in Beluslan.

string.name: STR_DIC_NPC_DF3_NPC_Kalitan
string.body: Kalitan;A Red Mane Mau guarding the crossroad between the Red Mane Cavern and the Fang Troll Encampment in Beluslan.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_NPC_Lethe
string.body: Lethe;A spy inside the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G4] in Beluslan.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_NPC_Stein
string.body: Strahein;A peasant who disappeared, leaving his son all alone. He may be held in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G4].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Ripley
string.body: Ripley;A Balaur prisoner who escaped from captivity. She hides in a forgotten section of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_H].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Freki
string.body: Freki;A renegade Lepharist hiding at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_C3_3] in Beluslan.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_NPC_Debrie_Hild
string.body: Hild;A curious Ribbit sometimes seen in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_C3_3] in Beluslan.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Byggvir
string.body: Vigbir;A suspicious old man who can be seen lurking around the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_C3_3] in Beluslan.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Hresvelgr
string.body: Hresvelgr;A disciple of Munin at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G2_3] in Beluslan. He obeys his master's wishes in all regards.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Juditio
string.body: Yuditio;An explosives specialist at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_Sub_add5] at Teminon Landing. He's new to the field, but eager to learn.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Taranis
string.body: Michalis;The Governor of Reshanta, at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_2]. He is an austere and serious man, yet always willing to train a new Daeva.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Sakmis
string.body: Sakmis;The Brigade General of the Grey Wind Legion stationed at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_2]. She has no patience for distractions.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Ascalon
string.body: Calon;The Brigade General of the Nezekan's Shield Legion stationed at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_2]. He has a great passion for fine blades.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Nereus
string.body: Nereus;A Centurion of the Grey Wind Legion stationed at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_Sub_add1] in Reshanta. He values practicality over formality.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Euros
string.body: Eulos;An Abyss training instructor at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_Sub_add1] in Reshanta. He instructs troops on the Abyss and the fortress.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Erinyes
string.body: Erienne;A Centurion of the Grey Wind Legion at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_Sub_add3]. She has broken many mens' hearts.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Soniksius
string.body: Soniksius;A Centurion of the Nezekan's Shield Legion at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_Sub_add4]. He is obsessed with his appearance.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Cesilie
string.body: Cesilie;A Centurion of Nezekan's Shield Legion at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_Sub_add4]. Her hardworking ways make her a rising star in the Legion.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Moia
string.body: Moia;A Soul Healer at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_2]. She is infamous for her strict ways.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Denegos
string.body: Denegos;A General Goods Merchant in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_2]. He came to the Abyss to try and make it big.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Zeth
string.body: Zeth;A Potion Merchant in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_2]. He is working on a good advertising slogan.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Obel
string.body: Obel;A warehouse manager on the second floor of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_2] in Reshanta. He became a skeptic after losing all his family in the past. He doesn't believe there is any meaning to life.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Lucius
string.body: Lucius;A Weapon Merchant in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_2]. Rumour has it he sells black-market goods.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Minon
string.body: Minon;An Armour Merchant in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_2]. He is a devout servant of Aion.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Flavius
string.body: Flavius;A Shield Merchant in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_2]. He has an obsession with shields. His favourite pasttime is to polish shields until they shine, then line them up and admire them.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Tenoeril
string.body: Tenoeril;A Food Merchant in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_2]. She is an optimist. She came to the Abyss in the hope of ascending as a Daeva.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Lasendi
string.body: Lasendi;A Manastone Remover in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_2] in Reshanta.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Makidna
string.body: Makidna;A combat Administration Officer in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_2] in Reshanta.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Magnus
string.body: Magnus;A magic Administration Officer in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_2] in Reshanta.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Achelos
string.body: Achelos;A combat Administration Officer in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_2] in Reshanta.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Melpomene
string.body: Melpomene;A magic Administration Officer in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_2] in Reshanta.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Shugo_AB1_L2
string.body: Ikarinerk;A trade broker in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_2] in Reshanta. He is [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Shugo_AB1_L1]'s husband.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Shugo_AB1_L1
string.body: Nayorinerk;A trade broker [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_2] in Reshanta. She is [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Shugo_AB1_L2]'s wife.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Lavinia
string.body: Lavinia;A warehouse manager on the second floor of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_2] in Reshanta.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Evander
string.body: Evander;A Protector of Teminon Legionary in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_2]. He is a by-the-book kind of soldier.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Hecabe
string.body: Hecabe;A Protector of Teminon Legionary guarding the entrance of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_2]. She is a perfectionist.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Eurytion
string.body: Eurytion;A Protector of Teminon Legionary at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_2] in Reshanta. He often gives backhanded complements.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Akastos
string.body: Akastos;A Protector of Teminon Legionary at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_2] in Reshanta. He is hoping to climb up the social ladder by fawning upon [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Taranis].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Akuba
string.body: Akuba;A Protector of Teminon Legionary at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_2] in Reshanta. He is fascinated by the beauty of the Abyss.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Puella
string.body: Puella;A Protector of Teminon Legionary at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_2] in Reshanta. She is a cynic.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Ventus
string.body: Ventus;An Information Officer at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_2] in Reshanta. He worries that the Asmodians may have spies in Elysea.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Rentia
string.body: Rentia;An Information Officer at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_2] in Reshanta. She shows great compassion for others.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Terita
string.body: Terita;An Abyss messenger who delivers messages between [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_2] and [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_Sub_add2] in Reshanta. She is quite a show-off.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Maius
string.body: Maius;An Abyss messenger at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_2] in Reshanta. He is needlessly superstitious.

string.body: Triminos;An Elim at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_9] in Reshanta. He came to the Abyss during the Cataclysm.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Shugo_AB1_7
string.body: Vindachinerk;The master of all Cube makers, he learned the secrets of making Cubes from the Empyrean Lord Israphel. He is hiding somewhere in Reshanta in order to safeguard the secret. It is said that he sometimes shows up in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_48].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Shugo_AB1_9
string.body: Junjunbinerk;A Shugo at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_40] in Reshanta. She is a pupil of Vindachinerk. She believes she will be his successor.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Shugo_AB1_10
string.body: Kuenunerk;A Shugo of the Kidorun Grave Robber Band in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_51]. He is very assertive.

string.body: Gaochinerk;A Shugo of the Tigraki Workshop at [%dic:STR_DIC_E_AB1_name] in Reshanta. He is arrogant.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Shugo_AB1_15
string.body: Guuminerk;A Shugo merchant of the Tigraki Workshop at [%dic:STR_DIC_E_AB1_name] in Reshanta.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Shugo_AB1_16
string.body: Sienrurerk;A Shugo merchant of the Tigraki Workshop at [%dic:STR_DIC_E_AB1_name] in Reshanta.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Shugo_AB1_17
string.body: Nukurinerk;A Shugo of the Tigraki Workshop in Reshanta. He travels to [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_36], [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_29], and [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_32] to procure materials for the Tigraki Workshop.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Ab1_NPC_Leibo_1
string.body: Leibo;Mysterious creatures thought to be somehow associated with the Tower of Eternity. There are many of them at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_Sub_add20] in Reshanta.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Votan
string.body: Votan;The Governor of Reshanta, at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_4]. He is a legendary strategist who killed many Elyos heroes as he worked his way up through the ranks.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Garvages
string.body: Jebal;The Brigade General of the Thunder Shout Legion at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_4]. He is full of bluster.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Herz
string.body: Hisui;The Brigade General of the Red Hasia Legion at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_4]. She is a stickler for rules.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Lasanya
string.body: Lisya;A Centurion of the Red Hasia Legion at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_Sub_add6]. She delights in making the Elyos suffer.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Semotor
string.body: Semotor;A Centurion of the Red Hasia Legion at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_Sub_add9]. He would like to see more action.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Andraste
string.body: Andraste;A Centurion of the Thunder Shout Legion at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_Sub_add8]. She risks Vanishment in the Abyss for the thrill of it.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Lakadi
string.body: Lakadi;A Centurion of the Thunder Shout Legion at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_Sub_add8]. He hopes to be considered for promotion.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Ahin
string.body: Ahin;A Soul Healer on the second floor of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_4] in Reshanta. She has a nice personality.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Kepin
string.body: Keffin;A teleporter at Primum Landing in Reshanta.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Brialen

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Siana
string.body: Siana;A General Goods Merchant on the second floor of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_4] in Reshanta. She has the business sense of a Shugo.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Koag
string.body: Koag;A Potion Merchant on the second floor of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_4] in Reshanta. There is a rumour that he makes experimental potions and tests them on unsuspecting customers.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Kirhenjar
string.body: Kirhenzar;A warehouse manager on the first floor of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_4] in Reshanta. He is scared of the Abyss but was dragged there by his stubborn wife.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Fraiban
string.body: Fraiban;A Weapon Merchant on the first floor of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_4] in Reshanta. He is bad at running a store and will probably go bankrupt soon.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Baht
string.body: Bacht;An Armour Merchant on the first floor of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_4] in Reshanta. He enjoys silly jokes.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Lausan
string.body: Lawusan;A Shield Merchant on the first floor of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_4] in Reshanta. He thinks cheap and sturdy things are the best.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Bihugud
string.body: Bihugud;A Food Merchant on the second floor of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_4] in Reshanta. She is very good at catering for groups, but every now and then foreign substances are found in the meals she prepares.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Hogni
string.body: Hogni;A Manastone Remover on the second floor of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_4] in Reshanta. He is dangerously obsessed with Manastones.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Ozur
string.body: Ozur;A Combat Administration Officer on the second floor of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_4] in Reshanta. He never speaks of private matters during work hours.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Spade
string.body: Spade;A Magic Administration Officer on the second floor of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_4] in Reshanta. His parents didn't like him very much.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Ivaldi
string.body: Ivaldi;A Combat Administration Officer on the second floor of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_4] in Reshanta. He is rather stoic.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Kolga
string.body: Kolga;A Magic Administration Officer on the second floor of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_4] in Reshanta. She is a typical, no-nonsense Administration Officer

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Shugo_AB1_D1
string.body: Yourunerk;A trade broker on the first floor of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_4] in Reshanta. He has a rivalry with Tierunerk.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Shugo_AB1_D2
string.body: Tierunerk;A trade broker on the first floor of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_4] in Reshanta. He has a rivalry with Yourunerk.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Vigeland
string.body: Vernio;A warehouse manager on the first floor of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_4] in Reshanta. He believes that the pride of a warehouse manager is in maintaining a clean warehouse.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Glad
string.body: Ganud;A Protector of Primum Legionary at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_4] in Reshanta. He is obedient.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Igla
string.body: Igla;A Protector of Primum Legionary at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_4] in Reshanta. Originally from Vanahal, she came to the Abyss to further her career.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Edvar
string.body: Edvar;A Protector of Primum Legionary at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_4] in Reshanta. He is a terrible, terrible poet.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Kirten
string.body: Kirten;A Protector of Primum Legionary on the first floor of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_4] in Reshanta. He loves to drink, but as the Legion forbids drinking he makes do with juice instead.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Krog
string.body: Krog;A Protector of Primum Legionary on the first floor of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_4] in Reshanta. He collects pebbles as mementos from his travels.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Larbig
string.body: Larbig;A Protector of Primum Legionary on the first floor of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_4] in Reshanta. She hasn't been in the Abyss for long. She has yet to remember the names of all the fortresses.

string.body: Enno;An Archon of Dusk on the first floor of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_4] in Reshanta. She is a Templar who wishes she'd become a Gladiator instead.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Erik
string.body: Erik;An Archon of Dusk on the first floor of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_4] in Reshanta. He thinks very highly of himself.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Holm
string.body: Holm;An Abyss messenger who delivers messages between [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_4] and [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_Sub_add7] in Reshanta. He is always very busy.

string.body: Konto;An Abyss messenger on the first floor of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_4] in Reshanta. He wants to be the fastest messenger around.

string.body: Huset;A Protector of Primum Legionary on the second floor of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_4] in Reshanta. He is resentful of the mailbox.

string.body: Pareten;A Protector of Primum Legionary on the second floor of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_4] in Reshanta. She wishes she'd become a Priest.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Grunn
string.body: Grunn;An Abyss researcher on the second floor of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_4] in Reshanta. He is in Reshanta researching a theory.

string.body: Himlem;A Thunder Shout Legionary at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_Sub_add8]. He is living his childhood dreams.

string.body: Klasa;A Thunder Shout Legionary at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_Sub_add8]. Her blood boils when she thinks of battle.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Iva
string.body: Iva;A Thunder Shout Legionary at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_AB1_Sub_add8]. She is very selfish.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Glen

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Nineve

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Gymir

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Mure

string.body: Iafes;Soldier from the Gold Feather Legion's Attack Squad. He wants to destroy the Beritra Army with the help of the Tiamat Legion.

string.body: Kuretes;A researcher from the Elyos Sanctum Expeditionary Knights. He is researching Id in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_C2_1], but has had no success so far.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Nesimo_E

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Terea_E

string.body: Heres;A lazy, crafty soldier of the Sanctum Expeditionary Knights. He finds it normal to say other people's work was his.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Demios_E
string.body: Demios;A Tribune of the Gold Feather Legion. He wants Portis to like him.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Paunus_E

string.body: Tuan;A soldier of the Red Fang Underground Troop. He is in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_B1] to destroy the Beritra Troops.

string.body: Lingaman;Fatebound Legionary in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_B1]. He is a faithful legionary who always follows orders.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Gael_E
string.body: Gael;A careless legionary who lost an important set of orders.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Vagion_E
string.body: Vagion;A member of the Red Fang in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_D1]. He has control over the Id research tool in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_D1].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Uster_E
string.body: Uster;A High Priest in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_D1]. He's constantly worried about the soldiers because of the potential dangers in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_D1].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Piahna_E
string.body: Piana;A member of the Red Fang in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_D2]. He is angry about the Rakuri in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_D2].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Macur_E
string.body: Makur;A member of the Red Fang in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_D2]. He is observing the Dragonbound.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Penion_E
string.body: Penion;A member of the Red Fang at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_D3]. He does business with the Shugos to obtain money for the military.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Ruok_E
string.body: Ruok;A Fatebound Legionary who can be found in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_E1]. He observes the Dragonbound very closely, and has doubts about the Shugo who leads the Dragonbound.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Kitos_E
string.body: Kitus;A member of the Red Fang in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_E1]. His lack of motivation would imply that he has doubts about his choice of career.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Berenoos_E
string.body: Berenus;A Fatebound Legion Centurion in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_E2]. He believes that Skurvs and Kobolds are always filthy, no matter where you encounter them.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Quage_E
string.body: Quage;A Fatebound Legion Centurion at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_F3]. He has outstanding expertise in planning operations and analysing the enemy's movements. However, he doesn't notice it when other people steal his achievements.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Navrei_E
string.body: Navrei;A Scout Leader of the Fatebound Legion who is isolated at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_F2]. He is making attack plans even though he's surrounded by enemies.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Ivolk_E
string.body: Ivolk;A member of the Red Fang who is possessed by thoughts of becoming famous through his achievements. He isn't afraid to manipulate reports in order to gain recognition either.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Niame_E
string.body: Niame;Fatebound Legion Centurion in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_F4]. He constantly gets defeated by the Elimination Squad of the 43rd Army and wants to take his revenge on them.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Zair_E
string.body: Zair;A Fatebound Legionary who can be found at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_F4]. He wants to free his petrified comrades at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_F4].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Ulvali_E
string.body: Ulvari;Quartermaster of the Katalam Cleanup Squad in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_G1]. He is fully concentrated on his task of supplying drinking water and doesn't listen to the advice of others.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Entita_E
string.body: Entita;Quartermaster of the Katalam Cleanup Squad in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_E3]. He has not yet understood that everything needs to be checked very carefully when working together with Shugos.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_wallring_E
string.body: Wallinerk;A subcontractor from Goldrinyerk Limited who is supervising the Eremion Ramparts from [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_A1_1].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Detworing_E
string.body: Diturinerk;A Shugo who is only interested in money. He always wants the cheapest offer.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Clrinrin_E
string.body: Klinrinerk;A Shugo who manages Goldrinyerk Limited's storehouse. He has no qualms about snatching items that have already been sold if it means he'll earn more kinah.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Defeat_Drakan
string.body: Survivors of the 55th Unit;Defeated soldiers of the Tiamat Legion who are looking for comrades-in-arms to take revenge on the Beritra Army.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Watering_E
string.body: Waterinerk;Taps spring water in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_G1]. Nobody knows if the water that he sells is drinkable at all.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Pandaroong_E
string.body: Pandarunerk;President of Goldrinyerk Limited who lives in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_E3]. He is in very high standing, but the expensive clothes and accessories that he wears don't really suit him.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Storing_E

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Roadring_E
string.body: Rodrinerk;A Shugo from Goldrinyerk Limited's subsidiary rail company. He is in charge of tracks maintenance, but too lazy to work.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Sparing_E

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Offiring_E

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Iring_E

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Muti_E

string.body: Chakerunerk;A member of the Green Hat Alliance. He loves kokonats.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5a_Perinrin_E
string.body: Perinerk;An administrator of the Lumber Camp who heads up the Perinerk Company. He complains about little things and moans a lot.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5a_Mycenae_E

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5a_Rasir_E
string.body: Rasir;He is part of the Portis Protectorate. As he doesn't like to take on responsibilities, he always attempts to follow orders to the letter.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5a_Minoa_E

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5a_Rogring_E

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5a_Kamoring_E

string.body: Kellran;He is one of Phon's successors and part of the Red Fang Underground Troop. He is at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_A3], and wants to eliminate the Dragonbound in Katalam.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5A_Raky_E
string.body: Laki;He is a follower of Phon and part of the Red Fang Underground Troop. He is planning to infiltrate the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_B5] and find out more about the Dragonbound.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5A_Gregin_E
string.body: Gregin;He is one of Stelman's successors and part of the Stelman Protectorate. He wants to teach the Balaur near the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_B6] a lesson because they are preventing the Asmodians from conquering Katalam.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5A_Shurelon_E
string.body: Shurelron;A scholar of old civilisations who is researching the life of the Rune Tribe at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_B6].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5A_Kadine_E
string.body: Kadine;One of Phon's followers who works for the military authorities and researches Id on the side. He can be found in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_B1].

string.name: STR_DIC_E_LDF5A_FOBJ_B1_EmptyEdgel
string.body: Empty Idgel Cube[pl:"Cubes"];A cube that used to contain Idgel and is now empty. It was found north of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_B1].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5A_Pagut_E
string.body: Pagut;An Archon. He is supposedly looking for Kahrun but doesn't look like a member of the Katalam Cleanup Squad. He can be found in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_B1].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5A_Ranis_E
string.body: Lanis;He is a follower of Phon and is part of the Red Fang Underground Troop. He is handling territorial expansion for the military authorities in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_B2], but is investigating the Beritra Army and reporting to Phon at the same time.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5A_Serip_E
string.body: Serif;He is investigating the Beritra Army in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_B2] with Stelman's support. Lanis and Balbrin are helping him.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5A_Balbrin_E
string.body: Balbrin;He is a follower of Phon and is part of the Red Fang Underground Troop. He is handling territorial expansion for the military authorities in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_B2], but is investigating the Beritra Army and reporting to Phon at the same time.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5A_Asir_E
string.body: Asir;A member of the Reian tribe at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_A3]. He wants to help the members of this tribe who were brainwashed by the Dragonbound.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5A_Raten_E
string.body: Laten;A member of the Reian Tribe who was brainwashed by the Dragonbound. He can be found at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_A3].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5A_Hagnon_E
string.body: Hagnon;A Reian citizen. He can be found at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_A3].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5A_Akad_E
string.body: Akad;One of Tiamat's Id Researchers, who can be found in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_F]. He feels responsible for the fact that his colleagues have turned into zombies.

string.name: STR_DIC_E_LDF5A_FOBJ_F_TiamatBox
string.body: Akad's Mysterious Lockbox;A lockbox belonging to Tiamat's Id researcher, Akad, which can be found at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_F]. He hid his research results in the lockbox so the Beritra Army couldn't take them.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5a_Mooling_Silverlin
string.body: Murinerk;An Advisor of Silverine Limited in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_OP_L].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5a_Jialinlin_Silverlin
string.body: Jiarinerk; An Administrator of Silverine Limited in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_OP_L].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5a_Minggiling_Silverlin
string.body: Mingirinerk; An Administrator of Silverine Limited in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5a_E8].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5a_Joongling_Silverlin
string.body: Jirlinerk;An Advisor of Silverine Limited in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_OP_D].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5a_Bialinlin_Silverlin
string.body: Biarinerk;An Administrator of Silverine Limited in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_OP_D].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5a_Dunaling_Silverlin
string.body: Dunarinerk;An Administrator of Silverine Limited in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5a_C3].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5a_Taureun_Greenhat
string.body: Taureun;A representative of the Green Hat Alliance in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_OP_L].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5a_Bios_Greenhat
string.body: Vios;A representative of the Green Hat Alliance in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_OP_L].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5a_Irin_Greenhat
string.body: Airin;A representative of the Green Hat Alliance in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5a_G2].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5a_Guniaro_Greenhat
string.body: Guniaro;An advisor of the Green Hat Alliance in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_OP_D].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5a_Bareak_Greenhat
string.body: Barek;A representative of the Green Hat Alliance in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_OP_D].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5a_Lily_Greenhat
string.body: Airin;A representative of the Green Hat Alliance in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5a_C2].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5a_Lop_Silverlin_Join
string.body: Danurinerk;Recruiter for Silverine Limited in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_OP_L].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5a_Dop_Silverlin_Join
string.body: Dumurinerk;Recruiter for Silverine Limited in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_OP_D].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5a_Lop_Greenhat_Join
string.body: Manurunerk;A recruiter of the Green Hat Alliance in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_OP_L]

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5a_Dop_Greenhat_Join
string.body: Sunarunerk;A recruiter of the Green Hat Alliance in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_OP_D].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Sootaling_Silverlin
string.body: Sutarinerk; An administrator of Silverine Limited in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_G1].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Malinlin_Silverlin
string.body: Marinerk; An Administrator of Silverine Limited in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_E3].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Gumaling_Silverlin
string.body: Gumarinerk; An Administrator of Silverine Limited in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_E2].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Ubarung_Greenhat
string.body: Ubarunerk;A representative of the Green Hat Alliance in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_E2].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Argarung_Greenhat
string.body: Algarunerk;A representative of the Green Hat Alliance in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_E3].

string.name: STR_DIC_E_LDF5a_Idgel_Q39601
string.body: Idium Stalk[pl:"Stalks"];Gleaming Idium in the form of a stalk, which can be found in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_B2] as well as by the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_B8].

string.name: STR_DIC_E_LDF5a_Wood_Q39605
string.body: Pile of Wood;A pile of hard and sturdy-looking pieces of wood. You can find these piles of wood in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5a_G3] as well as in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5a_C3].

string.name: STR_DIC_E_LDF5a_Wall_Q39608
string.body: Fragment[pl:"Fragments"] of the Eremion Ramparts;Fragments of the Eremion Ramparts, which can be found at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5a_E4] and at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5a_E6].

string.name: STR_DIC_E_LDF5a_Coconas_Q39702
string.body: Kokonat Tree[pl:"Trees"];A tree of round and tasty kokonats. The fruits contain a sweet juice. It can be found at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5a_G1] and at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5a_C1].

string.name: STR_DIC_E_LDF5a_Garbage_Q39708
string.body: Rubbish bag[pl:"Rubbish bags"];A bag containing rubbish. It seems to have been dumped a long time ago. You can find it near the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5a_E4] as well as near the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5a_E7].

string.name: STR_DIC_E_LDF5b_Bottle_Q39712
string.body: Water Bottle[pl:"Water Bottles"];A sealed bottle containing drinking water. Upon closer inspection, however, the water is unclean and stinks as well. The bottle can be found in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_G1].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5a_Dv8_Exchange_Cera
string.body: Pungt;A Ceranium Administration Officer. He can be found by the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5a_E1_8].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5a_Lv8_Exchange_Cera
string.body: Cebes;A Ceranium Administration Officer. He can be found by the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5a_E1_8].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5A_Pepe_E
string.body: Tribune Pepe;Tribune of the Gold Feather Legion, which is part of the Katalam Patrol. He is always busy because of the numerous assignments from Portis. He has followers all over Katalam, and can himself be found at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_OP_L] in northern Katalam.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5A_Portis_E
string.body: High Priest Portis;High Priest of the Order of Priests. The Portis Protectorate, named after him, is subordinate to him and he has followers all over Katalam. He can be found in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_OP_L] in northern Katalam.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5A_Stelman_E
string.body: Senior Tribune Stelman;Senior Tribune of the Katalam Cleanup Squad. The Stelman Protectorate, named after him, is subordinate to him but he also has followers throughout Katalam. He can be found at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_OP_D] in northern Katalam.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5A_Phone_E
string.body: Commander Phon;The leader of the Katalam Cleanup Squad's Red Fang Underground Troop. This underground troop is small, but its members are all over Katalam nevertheless. Phon can be found at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_OP_D] in northern Katalam.

string.name: STR_DIC_E_LDF5aREsolo_RuneBook
string.body: Research Journal of the Rune Tribe;A book which contains records of the Rune Tribe's research, compiled by the Beritra Head Researcher.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_IDAsteria_IU_IN_NPC01
string.body: Otherworld Faeries;These beings from another world are looking for Daevas to rescue [%dic:STR_DIC_N_IDAsteria_IU_IU_NPC01]. Elyos can find the faeries at the following locations: [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA31],[%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4b_SZ_OP_A1] and [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_OP_L]. Asmodians can find the faeries at the following locations: [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DC1_1], [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4b_SZ_OP_A2] and [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_OP_D].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_IDAsteria_IU_IU_NPC01
string.body: IU;An Otherworld Faerie with a dreamy singing voice. The greedy circus director [%dic:STR_DIC_M_IDASTERIA_NMD_03] captured her because he wants to use her to make money.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_IDAsteria_IU_FOBJ01
string.body: Sturdy Iron Chain;Iron chain used to seal the cage in which [%dic:STR_DIC_N_IDAsteria_IU_IU_NPC01] is imprisoned. If you destroy the iron chain, IU will help you in battle.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5_Under_Hadius_E
string.body: Hadius;An Elyos who has been deployed to the Katalam Underground. He is trying to emulate [%dic:STR_DIC_N_LDF5_Under_Kurius_E], despite his lack of skill.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5_Under_Kurius_E
string.body: Kurius;Elyos Captain who was deployed in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_ZONE_NAME_LDF5_SZ_M1]. He leads the Elyos forces in the Katalam Underground. He is the superior of [%dic:STR_DIC_N_LDF5_Under_Hadius_E] and is extremely ambitious.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5_Under_Dures_E
string.body: Dyures;He is observing the battle against the Balaur in the Katalam Underground.[%dic:STR_DIC_N_LDF5_Under_Hadius_E] is his supervisor.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5_Under_Liponia_E
string.body: Liponia;She researches ancient cultures and is currently investigating the relics of the Rune Tribe. [%dic:STR_DIC_N_LDF5_Under_Kurius_E] is her supervisor.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5_Under_Brief_E
string.body: Brif;A Captain leading the Asmodian forces in the Underground. He is the twin brother of [%dic:STR_DIC_N_LDF5_Under_Oturu_E]. Brif willingly accepted the mission in the Katalam Underground so he could boost his image again.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5_Under_Oturu_E
string.body: Otur;An Asmodian who has a quiet and cautious character, who was deployed to the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_ZONE_NAME_LDF5_SZ_M1]. He volunteered for service in the underground as he was worried about his twin brother, [%dic:STR_DIC_N_LDF5_Under_Brief_E].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5_Under_Merde_E
string.body: Merne;He is observing the battle against the Balaur in the Katalam Underground.[%dic:STR_DIC_N_LDF5_Under_Brief_E] is his supervisor.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5_Under_Nibella_E
string.body: Nivella;She researches ancient cultures and is currently investigating the relics of the Rune Tribe. Although she is working for [%dic:STR_DIC_N_LDF5_Under_Oturu_E], she prefers to pursue her own interests.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5_Under_Broringring_E
string.body: Borinerk;A representative of the Kuporinerk Company. He can be found in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_ZONE_NAME_LDF5_SZ_M1].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5_Under_Pudirung_E
string.body: Mampfrunerk;He manages food rations and is very proud of his range of foodstuffs. He can be found in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_ZONE_NAME_LDF5_SZ_M1].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5_Under_Rashiv_E
string.body: Lashiv;Member of the Beritra Army. He was captured by a group of survivors of Tiamat's Legion and appears to be very angry.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5_Under_Gritt_E
string.body: Gritt;A Tiamat soldier captured by the 5th Unit of the Beritra Army. It seems as though he knows about some secret matters.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_OBJ_LDF5_Under_FOBJ_T2_Document
string.body: Confidential Document on the Desk;A confidential document from Grit that was left behind on the desk.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_OBJ_LDF5_Under_FOBJ_T2_Grave
string.body: Sealed Rune Grave;A Rune Tribe grave which has a warning inscribed in it.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_OBJ_LDF5_Under_FOBJ_RuneSlate_1
string.body: Weathered Rune Stone Plate;Old legends of the Rune Tribe have been etched into it. Apparently you will find a ruin somewhere if you head in the direction of the temple.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_OBJ_LDF5_Under_FOBJ_RuneSlate_2
string.body: Old Rune Stone Plate;Legends of the Rune Tribe have been etched into it. Apparently you will find a ruin somewhere if you head in the direction of the tower.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_OBJ_LDF5_Under_FOBJ_T1_Document
string.body: Confidential Document on the Desk;A confidential document from Grit that was left on the desk.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_OBJ_LDF5_Under_FOBJ_T1_Grave
string.body: Sealed Grave;A Rune Tribe grave which has a warning inscribed in it.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_OBJ_LDF5_Under_FOBJ_H1_Stone
string.body: Broken Rune Jewellery;Broken pieces of jewellery that can be found in the Katalam Underground.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_OBJ_LDF5_Under_FOBJ_A1_Plant
string.body: Fresh Kataluna;A special plant that only grows in the Katalam Underground.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5_Under_Acterun_E
string.body: Aktorunerk;A highly suspicious Shugo whose true selfis not known to anybody. He seems to be injured for some reason.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_OBJ_LDF5_Under_FOBJ_Idium
string.body: Subterranean Idium Vein;Idium that has been found in the Catalam Underground. It seems to be purer than the Idium on the surface.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5a_Avsada_E
string.body: Avsada;One of the survivors of Tiamat's Legion who was captured in northern Katalam at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_OP_L]. It seems as though Avsada knows about important proceedings.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5a_Egant_E
string.body: Egant;A survivors of Tiamat's Legion who was captured in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5A_OP_D] in northern Katalam. It seems as though he knows about some secret matters.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5_Under_Seller_Cera
string.body: Shukrunerk;Caretaker for Ceranium medals. He advises you to exchange the Ceranium medals in the Katalam Underground.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5_Under_Timarchus_E
string.body: Timarkus;An Elyos of the Zephyr Daevas who was despatched to the Katalam Underground. He is observing the activities of the Beritra Army.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5a_Klaf_E
string.body: Klav;An Asmodian spy. He was taken prisoner by the Elyos, and he has important information about the Beritra Army.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5a_Chaea_G
string.body: Kaiah;He is the administrator of the Sillus Fortress and part of the Katalam Patrol of the Elyos. He will only appear if the Elyos have captured the Sillus Fortress.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Tenisian_G
string.body: Tenisian;He is the administrator of the Prades Fortress and part of the Katalam Patrol of the Elyos. He will only appear if the Elyos have captured the Prades Fortress.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Resco_G
string.body: Lesco;He is the administrator of the Bassen Fortress and part of the Katalam Patrol of the Elyos. He will only appear if the Elyos have captured the Bassen Fortress.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5a_OP_L_Dike_E
string.body: Dike; She is the fourth agent of Kaisinel. She is handling things in Katalam in the place of Lord Kaisinel. She is blind.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5_Under_Rumela_E
string.body: Rumella;A guard of the Katalam Patrol. She is on patrol in the Katalam Underground and gives out special missions. She only appears between 6 PM and 2 AM.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5_Under_Undgankt_E
string.body: Ungand;An Asmodian of the Nightfall Archons who was despatched to the Katalam Underground. He is observing the activities of the Beritra Army.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5a_Latis_E
string.body: Latis;An Elyos spy. He was taken prisoner by the Asmodians, and he has important information about the Beritra Army.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5a_Sigmund_G
string.body: Sigmund;He is the administrator of the Sillus Fortress and part of the Katalam Cleanup Squad of the Asmodians. He will only appear if the Asmodians have captured the Sillus Fortress.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Kaimir_G
string.body: Kaimeer;He is the administrator of the Prades Fortress and part of the Katalam Cleanup Squad of the Asmodians. He will only appear if the Asmodians have captured the Prades Fortress.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Niber_G
string.body: Niver;He is the administrator of the Bassen Fortress and part of the Katalam Cleanup Squad of the Asmodians. He will only appear if the Asmodians have captured the Bassen Fortress.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5a_OP_D_Skuldun_E
string.body: Skuldun;The fourth agent of Marchutan. He is handling things in Katalam in the place of Lord Marchutan. He has a talking figure on his shoulder.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5_Under_Hultum_E
string.body: Hultum;A guard of the Katalam Patrol. He is on patrol in the Katalam Underground and gives out special missions. He only appears between 6 PM and 2 AM.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_OBJ_IDF5_U2_Switch_4
string.body: Fourth Release Mechanism;A mechanism found inside the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_IDLDF5_Under_02_all]. It can be used to open one of the doors.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_OBJ_IDF5_U2_Switch_5
string.body: Fifth Release Mechanism;A mechanism found inside the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_IDLDF5_Under_02_all]. It can be used to open one of the doors.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_OBJ_IDF5_U2_Switch_6
string.body: Sixth Release Mechanism;A mechanism found inside the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_IDLDF5_Under_02_all]. It can be used to open one of the doors.

string.name: STR_DIC_OBJ_STR_IDVritra_FOBJ_Ancient_warmachine
string.body: Ancient Weapon Prototype;It is assumed that Idgel was used to power it. It can be found in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_IDVritra_Base_all].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Amalde_E
string.body: Amalde;A legionary of the Katalam Patrol who is stationed in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_E3]. She is looking for a suitable person who can obtain intelligence from the Sauro War Depot.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5_Kanix_E
string.body: Kanix;He will appear near the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_D2_v13] if it is captured by the Elyos. He is part of the Katalam Patrol, and he holds a grudge against the Beritra Army at the Sauro War Depot because they eliminated his comrades.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Sibeldum_E
string.body: Sibeldum;A legionary of the Katalam Cleanup Squad who is stationed in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_E3]. He is looking for a suitable person who can obtain information from the Sauro War Depot.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5_Giriltia_E
string.body: Giriltia;She will appear if the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_D2_v13] is captured by the Asmodians. She is part of the Katalam Cleanup Squad, and she wants all missions that have to do with the Sauro War Depot to be carried out as quickly as possible.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_IDLDF5_Under_02_Alkatron_E
string.body: Alkatron;An explorer who can be encountered when using the [%dic:STR_DIC_N_OBJ_IDLDF5_Under_02_Entrance_In] to get to the[%dic:STR_DIC_W_IDLDF5_Under_02_all]. He is part of the Katalam Patrol.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_IDLDF5_Under_02_Dintanum_E
string.body: Dintanum;An explorer who can be encountered when using the [%dic:STR_DIC_N_OBJ_IDLDF5_Under_02_Entrance_In] to get to the[%dic:STR_DIC_W_IDLDF5_Under_02_all]. He is part of the Katalam Cleanup Squad.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_OBJ_IDLDF5_Under_02_Entrance_In
string.body: Rune Tribe Refuge Teleporter; A teleporter found at the end of the passage to the east of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_ZONE_NAME_LDF5_SZ_T2] in the Katalam Underground. It is linked to the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_IDLDF5_Under_02_all].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_OBJ_IDVritra_Base_Enter
string.body: Sauro War Depot Teleporter;A teleporter found in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_D2_v13] in South Katalam. It is linked to the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_IDVritra_Base_all].

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_Lv11_SpecialSeller

string.body: Leibo Island;A small island at the centre of the lower layer of Reshanta. It is inhabited by Leibos.
