string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF2A_SZ_A
string.body: Settlers Campsite;The campsite where those who came to cultivate the land of Brusthonin settled down.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF2A_SZ_B
string.body: Polluted Waste;The region to the north of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF2A_SZ_A]. Once fertile, the land is now polluted.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF2A_SZ_C
string.body: Havenjark Farm;A region to the north of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF2A_SZ_B]. Once a fertile farm, it is now polluted and covered in undead.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF2A_SZ_C_1
string.body: Havenjark Cemetery;A public cemetery to the northeast of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF2A_SZ_C]. There's probably some ghosts or undead or something there.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF2A_SZ_D
string.body: Vigrid Plains;A plain to the west of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF2A_SZ_C].

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LF2A_SZ_Start
string.body: Meniherk Excavation Camp;A camp that the Meniherk Excavation Union set up in Theobomos.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LF2A_SZ_00
string.body: Crimson Barrens;A region to the south of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF2A_SZ_Start]. It is dry and barren.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LF2A_SZ_01
string.body: The Scorchlands;A region to the east of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF2A_SZ_00]. It has been burning since the Balaur attacks many centuries ago.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LF2A_SZ_02
string.body: Revenge Valley;A region to the west of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF2A_SZ_00]. Viragos nest here.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LF2A_SZ_03
string.body: Theobomos Ruins;A region to the south of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF2A_SZ_00]. It is dotted with the relics of ancient Atreia.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LF2A_SZ_Q1
string.body: Meniherk's First Excavation Site;The ruins of an ancient temple in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF2A_SZ_00], under which lie a great quantity of ancient artefacts.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LF2A_SZ_Q2
string.body: Meniherk's Second Excavation Site;The ruins of another ancient temple in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF2A_SZ_00], under which lie a great quantity of ancient artefacts.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LF2A_SZ_Q3
string.body: Meniherk's Third Excavation Site;The ruins of an ancient temple in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF2A_SZ_00], under which lie a great quantity of ancient artefacts.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_A
string.body: Beluslan Fortress;A fortress in the Beluslan region. It was destroyed in the Cataclysm, but a powerful artefact froze it in time and stopped it from collapsing.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_B
string.body: Black Plains;A black sand plain near [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_A]. It is dry and desolate.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_C1
string.body: Mosbear Snowfield;A habitat of Mosbears to the east of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_A]. Spriggs wander nearby.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_C2
string.body: Besfer Ghost Village;A village contaminated by the poison of the Dragon Lord Beritra.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_C3
string.body: Mahisha's Nest;Drake Queen Mahisha's nest in the Malek fields south of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_A].

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_C4
string.body: Giants Valley;A valley to the north of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_C3]. Many strange tales are told about this place.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_C5
string.body: Malek Mine;A Lepharist-controlled mine to the south of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_A].

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_C6
string.body: Malek Pass;A passage leading into the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_C5].

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_D1
string.body: Kurngalfberg;An ancient city in the southwest of Beluslan. It wa completely frozen by the Dragon Lord Ereshkigal during the Cataclysm.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_D2

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_D3
string.body: Mamut Graveyard;Located to the south of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_D2]. Mamuts come here to die.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_D4
string.body: Frost Spirit Valley;A valley to the east of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_D3]. It is filled with spirits.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_D5
string.body: Beluslan's Roof;The region between [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_D4] and the Red Mane Cavern. It is said to be the tallest point in Asmodae.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E1
string.body: Besfer Refugee Camp;A temporary settlement in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E2]. The refugees here escaped the undead contamination of the nearby villages.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E2
string.body: The Whispering Forest;A forest in the northeast of Beluslan, often covered in thick fogs. Stories say that if you stay there too long, you begin to hear the whisperings of ghosts.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E3
string.body: Anair Ice Lake;A frozen lake to the west of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E4].

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E4
string.body: Anair Harbour;An ancient harbour in the northeast of Beluslan, once the busiest port in ancient Atreia.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E5
string.body: Alukina's Palace;A sea in the eastern end of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E2]. The magic of the Seirens allows Humans to breathe water there.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_F
string.body: Red Mane Cavern;The home of the Red Mane Mau. Since they allied with the Asmodians, detachments of Archons have been stationed here.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G1
string.body: Fang Troll Encampment;A Troll habitat east of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_F].

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G3

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G4

string.body: Hoarfrost Outpost;The northern region of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G2]. It was once the village of the Hoarfrost Mau but fell to the Balaur.

string.body: Bakarma Barracks;A Balaur garrison you can find in the deep north after passing [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G5]. It is swarmed with Drakes, Draconutes, and Nagas.

string.body: Road to Morheim;A road from Beluslan to Morheim.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G4_2

string.body: Ghost Village Observation Post;A small campsite on the road from [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_B] to the Besfer Ghost Village. There stay Daevas who have been dispatched to clean up the Undead.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_C3_3
string.body: The Lone Cottage;An isolated house in the corner of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_C3]. Many awful rumours about the house have been spreading.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_C6_5
string.body: Malek Diggings;A site where a new building is being constructed inside [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_C5]. Spy Stua has infiltrated the site, disguised as a Lepharist.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_C6_6
string.body: Malek Mine Workshop;A stope at the end of a spiral road from [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_C6].

string.body: Camp Kistenian;The outpost of the Daevas of Flame who have been dispatched to restore [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_D1].

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E2_2
string.body: Anair Lighthouse;A lighthouse set up on the hill that overlooks [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_E4]. The soul of a lighthouse keeper is guarding it alone.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G2_2
string.body: Glacier Peaks;A low hill in front of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G2]. Kurins and Taygas nest on the snow-covered hillock.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G2_3
string.body: Hoarfrost Shelter;Located across the entrance of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G2]. There hide the Hoarfrost Mau who managed to survive the attacks of Balaur.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G2_4

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G2_5
string.body: Abandoned Campsite;A small barrack in the corner of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G2_2]. There stays Spy Dewi who has been dispatched to watch the Lepharists.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G2_6
string.body: Alquimia Approach;A recruit training ground of Lepharist Revolutionaries adjacent to [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G3] in the southeastern end of Beluslan.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G4_3
string.body: Alquimia Research Center;A research centre deep inside [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G4]. It conducts secret experiments with Humans.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G4_4
string.body: Lepharist Barracks;A living quarter of the Lepharists in the north of Alquimia Training Ground.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G4_5
string.body: Alquimia Training Ground;A training ground you can find when you follow the road east of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G2_6]. Trainees of the Sentinel Troop are practicing drills.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G6_2
string.body: Beluslan Observatory;A destroyed Observatory on the cliff that borders [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G5] and [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_G6]. As the Aetheric Field was incapacitated, the Balaur poured in.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_MS_Britra
string.body: Beritra's Weapon;A huge sword in the centre of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_C2]. Pollutants are deteriorating the area near the sword.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF3_SZ_D1_3
string.body: The Sacred Orchard;A place where [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Tree_Nomove_Kasadlasil] rests in peace. The Elim considers it a sacred place.

string.name: STR_DIC_SEN_DF4_SensoryArea_Q21069
string.body: Root Hollow;A place in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_SZ_DF4_A2] in Gelkmaros. It is where the wife of Shawster was last seen.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_IDCromede_Seal_Room
string.body: Temple Vault;A vault used by the Siel's Spear Legion to lock away relics that are too dangerous to let out into the world. It is guarded by Divine Hisen.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_IDCromede_Prison
string.body: Kaliga Dungeons;A dungeon hidden under the home of Shadow Judge Kaliga. It is full of prisoners who have been wrongfully incarcerated.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_IDCromede_Boss_Room
string.body: Kaliga Treasury;It is filled with treasures that Judge Kaliga has accumulated through unlawful means. There is supposed to be an entrance somewhere on the first floor.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF4_C4_Q1
string.body: Expedition Campsite;A campsite of the brothers [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Itar] and [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Tanar] in the Dragonrest. It is where the windstream that goes through the Dragonrest begins.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF4_C1_Q1
string.body: Drana Farm Observation Post;The campsite of the Pandaemonium Expeditionary Force in the Viscum Swamp. It is where the windstream leading to [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF4_SZ_C1_Fire] begins.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF2B_SZ_A1
string.body: Sudorville;A settlement area to the north of the Baltasar Hill Village. It used to be a fertile land in the past.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF2B_SZ_A2
string.body: Baltasar Cemetery;The cemetery where those who were sacrificed in Brusthonin are buried.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF2B_SZ_A2_1
string.body: The Legend Shrine;A site where the members of the Red Sky Legion who died fighting for Brusthonin are buried. It is located in the centre of the Baltasar Cemetery.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF2B_SZ_A3
string.body: Wailing Cliffs;An area south of the Baltasar Cemetery. A great battle against the army of Beritra had taken place here in the past.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF2B_SZ_A4
string.body: The Golden Coast;The coast to the south of the Wailing Cliffs. It is not treaded by the feet of men.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF2B_SZ_A_Town
string.body: Baltasar Hill Village;It was protected from contamination thanks to the power of the holy tree Baltasar.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF2B_SZ_B1
string.body: The Eastweald;The eastern region of the Magaro Primeval Forest. It is located on the west of the Baltasar Hill.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF2B_SZ_B2
string.body: Nahor Lake;A lake found in the south of The Northweald.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF2B_SZ_B2_1
string.body: Old Nahor Castle;An old castle standing on the centre of the Nahor Lake.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF2B_SZ_B3
string.body: The Northweald;The western region of the Magaro Primeval Forest.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF2B_SZ_B4
string.body: The Saplands;The downstream of Perpet Falls. It is heavily contaminated.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF2B_SZ_C1
string.body: Iollu Hills;A hilly region spread on the east of the BuBu Village.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF2B_SZ_C2
string.body: Iollu Forest;A forest reached by continuing east from the Iollu Hills. It is free from contamination, and ginseng of good quality grow here.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF2B_SZ_C3
string.body: Brohunir;The region to the east of the Iollu Forest, which is the main habitat of the Brohum.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF2B_SZ_C_Town
string.body: BuBu Village;A village of the BuBu tribe located northwest of Brusthonin.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF2B_SZ_D1
string.body: Carobian Coast;The coast to the west of the BuBu Village. Many cursed creatures wander about here.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF2B_SZ_D1_1
string.body: Black Opal Ship Anchorage;The spot in the Carobian Coast where the Black Opal is anchored.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF2B_SZ_D2
string.body: The Coastal Pass;A road leading from the Carobian Coast to the Adma Plains.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF2B_SZ_D3
string.body: Adma Plains;A canyon leading to the Adma Stronghold. The angry spirits of those who were turned away from the stronghold still linger here.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF2B_SZ_E
string.body: Adma Stronghold;A stronghold to the south of the Adma Plains. It is said to be connected to Old Nahor Castle by a secret passage.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF2B_SZ_A2_2
string.body: Brusthonin Mithril Mine;An old mine to the northwest of Sudorville.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF2B_SZ_C2_1
string.body: Perpet Falls;A clean, clear waterfall located upstream of Iollu Forest.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF2B_SZ_A2_3
string.body: Shaman's House;An isolated house standing at the eastern end of the Baltasar Cemetery. It is inhabited by the shaman Seznec.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF2B_SZ_B3_1
string.body: Decomposed Greens;An area in The Northweald occupied by the Contaminated Elim.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF2B_SZ_C1_1
string.body: BuBu Chan's Hideout;An isolated house to the north of the Iollu Hills. BuBu Chan lives here.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF2B_SZ_C2_2
string.body: Cayron Hill;A hill in the Iollu Forest. Cayron, a wise Brohum, can be found here.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF2B_SZ_D1_2
string.body: Stragglers' Shelter;An area in the Carobian Coast.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF2B_SZ_D2_1
string.body: Canyon Scout Post;An area on The Coastal Pass. Archons have been dispatched here to investigate the situation at the Adma Plains.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_SEN_DF2a_SensoryArea_Q4051
string.body: Cayron Hill;A hill in the Iollu Forest. Cayron, a wise Brohum, can be found here.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LF2B_SZ_A
string.body: Parched Barrens;The dry desert region east of Observatory Village.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LF2B_SZ_A_Town
string.body: Observatory Village;A village built around the Theobomos Observatory.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LF2B_SZ_B1
string.body: Northern Latheron Coast;A huge desert found to the east of the Parched Barrens. It was apparently a seaside in the past.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LF2B_SZ_B2
string.body: Southern Latheron Coast;Although it is a desert at present, it was apparently a seaside in the past.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LF2B_SZ_B3
string.body: Cascade Springs;A dried-up sea to the south of the Southern Latheron Coast.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LF2B_SZ_B4
string.body: Alisary Coast;A dried-up sea, located to the west of the Cascade Springs.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LF2B_SZ_C1
string.body: Dirmoi Pass;A long canyon passage to the south of Fregion's Flame.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LF2B_SZ_C2
string.body: Empyrean Lords Sanctuary;An ancient temple ruin to the south of the Fregion's Flame.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LF2B_SZ_C3
string.body: Fregion's Flame;An area to the east of The Stalking Grounds. It still bears the scars from the attacks of the Dragon Lord Fregion.

string.body: Southern End of Viscum Swamp;A heavily contaminated area in the southern part of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_SZ_DF4_C1].

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LF4_SZ_B8_NepilimCave
string.body: Abandoned Jotun Studio;An ancient Jotun workshop located at the Collapsed Cliff in the Inggison Gravepit. It can only be reached by using a windstream.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LF4_SZ_B3_Cellatu
string.body: Greatshade Valley;A narrow valley inhabited by Cellatus. It is upstream of the Wretched Garden Waterfall. It can be reached by using a geyser.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF4_SZ_C5_Lab
string.body: Naduka Biolab;A Balaur research facility located deep in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_SZ_DF4_C5].

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF4_SZ_B5_Ruin
string.body: Highpass Ruins;A temple site found at the top of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_SZ_DF4_B5] cliff. It can be reached by using a windstream.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF4_SZ_C1_Cave
string.body: Genesis Cave;A habitat of Seafoams in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_SZ_DF4_C1]. It can be entered by using a geyser.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_DF4_SZ_C1_Fire
string.body: Mitrakand Summit;An area in the sky over the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_SZ_DF4_C2]. It is guarded by Mitrakand beacon soldiers and can be reached by using a windstream.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_SZ_DF4_Tw
string.body: Rhonnam Refugee Village;A temporary residence prepared by the Reian tribesman Rhonnam in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_SZ_DF4_B2] for refugees from the Nunglark Ruins.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_IDAbRe_Core_SZ_C
string.body: The Storm Cave;A dangerous place often showered by Aether fragments due to unstable currents. It is located not very far from the entrance of the Abyssal Splinter.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_ZONE_NAME_IDElemental_1
string.body: Elementis Forest;An enchanted forest in the northwest of Sarpan that is protected by the Luminous Sapling.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_ZONE_NAME_IDElemental_2
string.body: Argent Manor;A cliffside mansion in Elementis Forest. It was built by the sorcerer Davlin so that she could research and build Golems in close proximity to the Luminous Sapling.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_idf4re_drana_SZ_Stage_02_1
string.body: Drana Production Lab;A research centre and refinery in the Esoterrace. It processes Drana to produce Dratamin, Surkina, and other materials.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_idf4re_drana_SZ_Stage_03_2
string.body: Esoterrace Secret Laboratory;Surama's secret laboratory beneath the Esterrace. It connects to the Air Conditioning Room by a Secret Passage.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_idf4re_drana_SZ_Stage_02_4
string.body: Laboratory Air Conditioning Room;Not just for cooling air. This room houses the controls for the Drana Esoterrace and the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_idf4re_drana_SZ_Stage_02_1].

string.name: STR_DIC_W_idf4re_drana_SZ_Stage_01_2
string.body: Drana Esoterrace;The Esoterrace's Drana production region. It has improved both the quality and output of Drana by using Elm.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_idf4re_drana_SZ_Stage_03_5
string.body: Esoterrace Bio Lab;An experimental laboratory beneath the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_idf4re_drana_SZ_Stage_03_2].

string.name: STR_DIC_W_Arena_L_Lobby
string.body: Kaisinel Academy;Kaisinel created this facility after disappointing performances in Inggison. To go there, ask [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Arora], in the Inggison Illusion Fortress, or use Kaisinel's Teleport Statue in [%dic:STR_DIC_ELA07].

string.name: STR_DIC_W_Arena_D_Lobby
string.body: Marchutan Priory;Marchutan created this facility after predicting great defeat in Gelkmaros. To go there, talk to [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Virvain], in the Gelkmaros Fortress, or use Marchutan's Teleport Statue in Pandaemonium.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_IDStation_SZ_Station
string.body: Aturam Sky Fortress;A Dredgion repair and maintenance station. Silion at Garldar Village has information on how to gain access to this Balaur fortress.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_IDStation_SZ_01_A
string.body: Sky Fortress Warehouse Zone;A zone that houses weapons and supplies for the Fortress. You can get there by turning left from the Central Corridor.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_IDStation_SZ_02_A
string.body: Dredgion Fabrication Zone;An area of the Sky Fortress that houses the Dredgion's controls. You can get there through the centre exit of the Central Corridor.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_IDStation_SZ_03_B
string.body: Sky Fortress Command Center;The heart of Aturam Sky Fortress, where they Drakan fortress commanders are located. You'll have to take the Steam Tachysphere to reach the Command Center.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_IDStation_SZ_03_Named
string.body: Ashunatal's Ready Room; Ashunatal's Ready Room

string.name: STR_DIC_W_ZONE_NAME_IDYun
string.body: Rentus Base;This covert Reian training base and weapons smithy was built perilously close to Balaur territory.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_IDYun_SZ_2
string.body: Sparring Grounds;A training ground for Reian warriors to practice and hone their skills.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_IDYun_SZ_5
string.body: Siel Smithy;A Reian weapons forge that creates powerful tools of war.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_IDYun_SZ_3
string.body: Residential Zone;The Barracks and housing for Rentus Base troops.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_IDRaksha_Whole
string.body: Raksang;An ancient Balaur dungeon where the dragon Raksha has been sealed for centuries. It is now accessible through Arsa's Corridor.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_IDRaksha_2F
string.body: Terror's Vault;An old crypt used as a dungeon in Raksang. Ethereal blue light marks the path from Raksang Dungeon Chasm to the Vault's entrance.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_IDRaksha_3F
string.body: Torment's Forge; A dungeon in Raksang that is choked with endless flames. Molten red light marks the path from the Flight Area to the Vault's entrance.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_IDRaksha_4F
string.body: Hellpath;The gate to the Hellpath is in Raksang, at the bottom of the Raksang Depths.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4b_SZ_OP_A4
string.body: Garnon's Secret Chamber;Access to Garnon's secret room is usually allowed by summons only.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4b_SZ_T1_S8
string.body: Heart of Fissure;A source of Tiamat's power guarded by the Dragon Lord's avatar, Fissure Incarnate.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4b_SZ_T2_S10
string.body: Heart of Gravity;A source of Tiamat's power guarded by the Dragon Lord's avatar, Gravity Incarnate.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4b_SZ_T3_S7
string.body: Heart of Wrath;A source of Tiamat's power guarded by the Dragon Lord's avatar, Wrath Incarnate.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4b_SZ_T4_S6
string.body: Heart of Petrification;A source of Tiamat's power guarded by the Dragon Lord's avatar, Petrification Incarnate.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4b_SZ_T2_S12
string.body: Watcher's Hill;A hill overlooking the Heart of Gravity that provides a clear view of the Heart and is useful as an observation post.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4b_SZ_T1_S9
string.body: Outcrop Overlook;A outcrop above the Heart of Fissure that offers an unobstructed view of the Heart and is useful for reconnaisance.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4b_SZ_T3_A6
string.body: Wrath Vent;An area destabilized by its proximity to the Power of Wrath. The creatures in this area seem to be affected by the volcanic steam that vents nearby.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4b_SZ_T2_A6
string.body: Gravity Well;An area affected by the Gravity Power. The creatures in this area are twisted by proximity to Tiamat's power.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_IDRaksha_ItemUseArea_Q28703
string.body: Magma Flow;Seething magma that builds up in the bottom of Raksang.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_OP
string.body: Kamar;The magnificent Reian capital city in central [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_sarpan_main], built in defiance of the constant threat from Tiamat and his Balaur servants.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_OP_01
string.body: Sarpan Capitol;The main council chamber of the Reian Elders, where Kahrun and his senior officals discuss the future of the Reian Tribe.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_OP_02
string.body: Griffoen Boarding Site;This chamber allows access to the Elyos airship, Griffoen.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_OP_03
string.body: Habrok Boarding Site;This chamber allows access to the Asmodian airship, Habrok.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_OP_04
string.body: Main Conference Hall;A chamber in the Sarpan Capitol used for the Elders' private councils.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_OP_05
string.body: Great Square of Peace;The wide central fountain square in the Reian capital, Kamar.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_OP_06
string.body: Kahrun Guard Headquarters;This legion, commanded by Kahrun Guard Brigade General [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Kutos], is headquartered in the northeast of the Reian capital, Kamar.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_OP_07
string.body: Siel's Spear Headquarters;Headquartered in east Kamar, this legion is commanded by Elder [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Raffaele].

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_OP_08
string.body: Wisdom Library;A Reian laboratory for research on Drana energy.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_OP_09
string.body: Jotun Research Library;A library compiling all Reian knowledge regarding the Jotun, built over many years by the researcher [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Acheron].

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_OP_10
string.body: Spero Residential Parish;The residential district of Kamar, where the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_OP_17] is located.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_OP_11
string.body: Kamena Development District;An area of Kamar under rapid development as directed by [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Salomone].

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_OP_12
string.body: Kamar Dungeon;A prison dug deep beneath the city of Kamar. Its entrance is north of Lamina Bazaar.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_OP_15
string.body: Lamina Bazaar;Kamar's busy commercial district, populated by traders and merchants of all kinds.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_OP_16
string.body: Room of Relativity;This room is what you make of it.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_OP_17
string.body: Bivarus Tavern;A famously rowdy tavern in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_OP_10].

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_OP_18
string.body: Siel Temple;A temple built in honour of Empyrean Lady Siel, Lady of Time and Guardian of the East, whose noble self-sacrifice during the Cataclysm saved Atreia from total destruction.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_OP_19
string.body: Griffoen;The Elyos fleet flagship, currently docked in Kamar. You can reach the Griffoen through a Warship Crew or Warship Teleport Statue.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_OP_20
string.body: Habrok;The Asmodian flagship, currently docked in Kamar. You can reach the Habrok through a Warship Crew or Warship Teleport Statue.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_OP_21
string.body: Mephitic Caverns;The twisting caverns dug by burrowing Klaw. One has recently broken through a wall in the Kamar Dungeon.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A1
string.body: Kamar Outskirts;The lands surrounding the Reian capital. These areas are mostly forested, save for the desert fronting the eastern city entrance.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A1_01
string.body: Kamar Road Outpost;A guard post watching the road leading to Kamar's west entrance.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A1_02
string.body: Refugee Camp;A temporary camp housing those fleeing Balaur attack and seeking the safety of the Reian capital. It is in the desert of the Kamar Outskirts, near the southeast city walls.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A1_03
string.body: Southern Guardian's Seal;A Guardian Seal in the north of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_D]. The [%dic:STR_DIC_E_guardstone_Q41256] here prevents Tiamat's power from destroying this region of Sarpan.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A1_04
string.body: Redclaw Steppe;This hilly area between Kamar and the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A4_01] is especially dangerous at night.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A2
string.body: Trepone Forest;This northern Sarpan forest was once razed to build Drana plantations, but has since returned to its natural state.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A2_01
string.body: Garldar Village;A Reian village in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A2], which escaped the Dredgion bombardment.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A2_02
string.body: Menin Village;A Reian village in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A2] completely decimated by Dredgion bombings.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A2_03
string.body: Luman Village;A Reian village razed by Dredgion bombings and overrun with Shulack and Drakan forces.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A2_04
string.body: Dredgion Bombing Area;A region of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A2] heavily bombed by Balaur Dredgions.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A2_05
string.body: Nalotia's Cabin;A cabin in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A2] where the Herb Gatherer [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Nalotia] lives.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A2_06
string.body: Solace Cavern;An isolated, well-protected cave that seems to have served as some kind of shelter in the past, though its occupants are long gone.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A2_07
string.body: Wildflower Field;A field crowded with wild flowers, including the [%dic:STR_DIC_N_LDF4a_Dandelion_Big].

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A3
string.body: Cucutero Grove;An ancient forest spreading across southwest Sarpan that is sacred to the [%dic:STR_DIC_E_ldf4a_Owllau_fam] Strigik.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A3_01
string.body: Western Guardian's Seal;The [%dic:STR_DIC_E_guardstone_Q41256] here prevents Tiamat's power from destroying the western region of Sarpan. It is well-fortified.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A3_02
string.body: Hunter's Blind;This overlook commands an unbroken view of the [%dic:STR_DIC_E_ldf4a_Owllau_fam]'s territory.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A3_03
string.body: Urugugu Village;The village of the warrior Strigik [%dic:STR_DIC_E_ldf4a_Owllau_fam], in the south of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A3].

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A3_04
string.body: Urugugu Garrison;An encampment of the most elite and powerful [%dic:STR_DIC_E_ldf4a_Owllau_fam] warriors.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A3_05
string.body: Ashishav's Nest;A sacred tree named in honour of the [%dic:STR_DIC_E_ldf4a_Owllau_fam] patron of battle.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A3_08
string.body: Chief Uliuru's Territory;Land claimed by the Chief Uliuru.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A4_01
string.body: Eastern Guardian's Seal;The [%dic:STR_DIC_E_guardstone_Q41256] sited above Redclaw Steppe prevents Tiamat's power from destroying the eastern region of Sarpan.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A4_02
string.body: Ancestor's Shrine;An altar in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A4_03] dedicated to the Calydon cult of the ancestors.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A4_03
string.body: Humnaz Territory;Land in the eastern Sarpan deserts claimed by the [%dic:STR_DIC_E_LDF4a_calydon_fam].

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A4_04
string.body: Humnaz Garrison;An encampment of elite [%dic:STR_DIC_E_LDF4a_calydon_fam] warriors.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A4_05
string.body: Haridoo's Lodge;The lodge of the Humnaz Tribe's ruler, [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4A_A4_Calydonchief_Nmd_57_Ah], who has kept control of the tribe for an unprecedented length of time.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A4_06
string.body: Warrior's Shrine;An altar in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A4_04] dedicated to the Calydon warrior's cult.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A4_07
string.body: Yearling's Shrine;An altar in the south of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A4_04] dedicated to the Calydon cult of future warriors.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A4_08
string.body: Disguised Humnaz Outpost;A Reian observation post on the fringes of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A4_03], disguised beneath a Calydon tent.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_B1
string.body: Anaz Forest;A dense, lush forest in the west of Sarpan.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_B1_01
string.body: Herbalist's Campsite;A camp convenient for gathering the medicinal plants that grow in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_B1].

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_B1_02
string.body: Yocaris' Retreat;The temporary camp of the powerful Reian sorcerer [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Yocios].

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_B1_05
string.body: Aponos Brohum Village;A Brohum village built on the ruins of many past Brohum civilizations.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_B2
string.body: Jotari Wastes;This trecherous desert spreads across northwest Sarpan. It contains many unexplored ruins.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_B2_01
string.body: Jotun Research Expedition;The campsite for the Jotun relics excavation team, led by [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Linacroft].

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_B2_02
string.body: Thebadim Altar;This ancient holy site is so badly degraded that it's not clear what it was built in honour of, though the Jotun Research Expedition hopes they'll learn more during its excavation.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_B2_03
string.body: Ruined Jotun Watchtower;Ruins in the north Jotari Wastes thoroughly looted by the [%dic:STR_DIC_E_shulak_nightshadowfam].

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_B2_04
string.body: Ruined Jotun Citadel;These ruins in the east Jotari Wastes have already been looted of artefacts by the [%dic:STR_DIC_E_shulak_nightshadowfam].

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_B2_05
string.body: Nightshade Camp; The [%dic:STR_DIC_E_shulak_nightshadowfam] camp in these tents.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_B2_06
string.body: Hushblade Lookout Camp;A Hushblade Legionary encampment.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_B2_07
string.body: Fatebound Lookout Camp;A Fatebound Legionary encampment.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_B2_08
string.body: Crumbling Petralith;The remains of a Petralith destroyed by the Balaur. Old stories claim that a Windstream once originated here.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_B2_09
string.body: Debarim Petralith Studio;A huge Jotun petralith forge in ancient caverns deep beneath the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_B2].

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_B2_10
string.body: Jotari Sanctuary Ruins;An ancient, ruined temple that floats above the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_B2_09].

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_C1
string.body: Destroyed Guardian's Seal;When the [%dic:STR_DIC_E_guardstone_Q41256] here was destroyed, the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_C1_000] ripped the area into a nightmarish landscape.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_C1_01
string.body: Twisted Land Research Expedition;The Twisted Land Research Group uses this camp as its base while investigating the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_C1_000]. It is in one of the deepest fissures in the Great Fissure.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_C1_02
string.body: Twisted Land Outpost;A temporary camp for the team researching the area annihilated by the Destroyed Guardian's Seal.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_C1_05
string.body: Ellesra Cave;A huge cave brimming with Energy of Greater Aether. Its entrance is hidden in the west of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_C1].

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_C2
string.body: Satrakand;The ruins of a fortress where remnants of the Satra Legion are encamped.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_C2_01
string.body: Southeast Guardian's Seal;The [%dic:STR_DIC_E_guardstone_Q41256] hre prevents Tiamat's power from destroying the area north of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_C2].

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_D
string.body: Sabat's End;A valley that contains the only transport lines from Kamar into Tiamaranta, making it strategically vital. The remains of its namesake are fossilized into the western cliffs of the End.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_D_01
string.body: Hushblade Garrison;A Hushblade Legionary garrison protecting [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_D] from Balaur forces.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_D_02
string.body: Fatebound Garrison;A Fatebound Legionary garrison protecting [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_D] from Balaur forces.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_D_03
string.body: Sabat's End Cemetary;Tiamat's power has disturbed the spirits resting in this formerly-peaceful Reian cemetary.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_D_04
string.body: Rancora North Gate;The north end of the heavily-fortified Sarpan entrance to Tiamaranta.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_ZONE_NAME_IDLDF4A_Lehpar
string.body: Israphel's Space;A hidden realm private to Empyrean Lord [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Israphel].

string.name: STR_DIC_W_ZONE_NAME_IDLDF4A
string.body: Protector's Realm;A hidden realm conjured by Protector [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Oriatia] as a retreat from the tumultuous Reian world.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_B1_08
string.body: Macori Hill;A hill in the Anaz Forest populated by Marconnuts.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4b_SZ_T1_A1
string.body: Triumph Gate;The exit of Rancora Fortress.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4b_SZ_T1_A2
string.body: Adora Desert;A brutal waste of desolate land north of Tiamaranta's Eye.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4b_SZ_T1_A3
string.body: Balaur Cavalry Base;A Balaur training base near Rancora Fortress in northeast Tiamaranta, where the Balaur Vasharti Legion train their Pagati.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4b_SZ_T1_A4
string.body: Fissure Barrens;A region rent and twisted by the power emanating from the Heart of Fissure. It is pockmarked with craters.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF4b_SZ_T1_A5
string.body: Fissure's Limits;The northwest corner of Tiamaranta, leading from the Fissure Barrens into the Heart of Fissure.

string.body: Entry to Runadium;Used to serve as an access to the arena in the Katalam Underground for the Rune Tribe. Rumour has it that it was destroyed by the [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF5_Under_Rune_FrostNmd_2_N_Ma_65_Ah].

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF5a_E1_QUEST

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_D1_2
string.body: Arid Basin;Located in the southern part of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_D1]. A cavern connects it to the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_D2].

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_D2_3

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_F4_2

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_F4_3
string.body: Plains of Discord;An area in the southern part of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_F4]. A path leading to the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_D3] is in this area.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_IDASTERIA_IU_WORLD_01
string.body: Rukibuki Circus;Circus run by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_IDASTERIA_NMD_03]. Currently in the red.

string.name: STR_DIC_TEST04
string.body: Test;An ordeal that everyone and everything, even games, has to go through.

string.name: STR_DIC_ELA01
string.body: Sacred Water;Holy water found at [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA20]. Sediment gathers under the water when it's transferred into a bowl.

string.name: STR_DIC_ELA02
string.body: Aion;The Tower of Eternity. It was once the world's axis, and stretched across Atreia's interior. It has since been destroyed, and all that remains is the Tower of Light in Elysea and the Tower of Darkness in Asmodae.

string.name: STR_DIC_ELA03
string.body: Atreia;The name of the world before it was ripped apart by the Cataclysm. Though the term is still used in both Elyos and Asmodian society, the two halves of Atreia now have their own specific names: Asmodae and Elysea.

string.name: STR_DIC_ELA04
string.body: Aion;The being that both Elyos and Asmodians consider to be the creator of Atreia. Aion the creator and Aion the tower are believed to be one and the same.

string.name: STR_DIC_ELA05
string.body: Elysea;The lower half of Atreia. It was created as a result of the Cataclysm, and is now a land blessed with light and beauty. It is ruled by the Five Seraphim Lords.

string.name: STR_DIC_ELA06
string.body: Asmodae;The upper half of Atreia. It was created as a result of the Cataclysm, and is now a land shrouded in darkness. It is ruled by the Five Shedim Lords.

string.name: STR_DIC_ELA07
string.body: Sanctum;The capital city of Elysea that is floating in the air. It is also sometimes used to describe the Elyos government.

string.name: STR_DIC_ELA08
string.body: Pandaemonium;The sole city in Asmodae. The term is occasionally used to describe the Asmodian leadership.

string.name: STR_DIC_ELA09
string.body: Daeva;A winged being able to manipulate the power of Aether. Only very few Humans go through the process of ascension to become Daevas, and the requirements for being chosen are still not understood.

string.name: STR_DIC_ELA10
string.body: Guardians;The very strongest and most powerful of the Elyos Daevas.

string.name: STR_DIC_ELA11
string.body: Archons;The very strongest and most powerful of the Asmodian Daevas.

string.name: STR_DIC_ELA12
string.body: Empyrean Lords;The twelve beings created by Aion to protect Atreia against the Balaur terror. Two were destroyed in the Cataclysm, and the remaining ten became the five Seraphim Lords of Elysea, and the five Shedim Lords of Asmodae.

string.name: STR_DIC_ELA13
string.body: Aether;A fundamental energy used by Daevas to empower their spirits and maintain immortality. Aether is also the source of the Aetheric field. Following the destruction of the tower, Aetheric energy has continually bled from the both the Tower of Light and the Tower of Darkness, and if not stopped will result in Atreia's total destruction.

string.name: STR_DIC_ELA14
string.body: Abyss;A dimension created by the unstable flow of Aether following the fall of Aion. It's connected to Atreia through specific Rifts.

string.name: STR_DIC_ELA15
string.body: Nobelium;Temples constructed long ago in tribute of the Empyrean Lords. Priests work in the temples to serve as mediums between the Lords and Humans.

string.name: STR_DIC_ELA16
string.body: Obelisk;A device that resurrects defeated Daevas. Binding a Daeva's soul at a specific Obelisk allows the Daeva to resurrect there.

string.name: STR_DIC_ELA17
string.body: Cube;A magical device that stores items by reducing their size.

string.name: STR_DIC_ELA18
string.body: Sapien;A group of races that serve the Balaur. They are the Krall and Kobolds in Elysea, and the Mau and Skurvs in Asmodae. They are a constant distraction for both Elyos and Asmodian combat forces.

string.name: STR_DIC_ELA19
string.body: Odium;A stone imbued with Aether. Odium can be mined and has many uses.

string.name: STR_DIC_ELA20
string.body: Tribute to Elysea;Humans are often required to send tribute to their capital as a mark of respect to the Seraphim Lords. Tribute is most often given as livestock or crops.

string.name: STR_DIC_ELA21
string.body: Seraphim Festival;A festival dedicated to the Seraphim Lords. It is a huge event held regularly in Sanctum.

string.name: STR_DIC_ELA22
string.body: Temple of Ariel;A group of Guardians who serve [%dic:STR_DIC_LA56].

string.name: STR_DIC_ELA23
string.body: Temple of Justice;A group of Guardians who serve the Lord of Justice, [%dic:STR_DIC_LA57].

string.name: STR_DIC_ELA24
string.body: Lyceum;A holy ground within Sanctum. It is where the high priest and protectors serve the Five Seraphim Lords.

string.name: STR_DIC_ELA25
string.body: Temple of Illusion;A group of Guardians who serve the Lord of Illusion, [%dic:STR_DIC_LA59].

string.name: STR_DIC_ELA26
string.body: Temple of Freedom;A sacred sanctuary dedicated to the Lord of Freedom.

string.name: STR_DIC_ELA27
string.body: Mysterious Book of Magic;An ancient tome of arcane knowledge, prized by historians and scholars of magic.

string.name: STR_DIC_ELA28
string.body: Encyclopedia of the Wise;The most transcribed text in all of Atreia. This volume is an exhaustive collection of diverse knowledge, ranging from history to geography to just plain common sense.

string.name: STR_DIC_ELA29
string.body: Elim;Spirits of trees which can talk and move. They communicate with trees in the forest and are sensitive to any change in their natural environment.

string.name: STR_DIC_ELA31
string.body: Stigma Stone;A crystal containing the soul of a Daeva. New abilities can be learned by experiencing the defeated Daeva's memories.

string.body: Odella;A rare herb that grows by absorbing Aetheric energy.

string.name: STR_DIC_E_LF2_Morpinos

string.body: Cursed Necklace;It is said that anyone who owns this necklace will gain a great fortune. However, it is imbued with a terrible curse that makes its owner lose all their loved ones, and forces them to live alone for the rest of their life.

string.name: STR_DIC_E_LF1_name
string.body: Poeta;A peaceful region centered around Akarios village.

string.name: STR_DIC_E_LF1A_name
string.body: Verteron;A wet and cold region centered around the fortress village where the Abyss Path was discovered.

string.name: STR_DIC_E_LF2_name
string.body: Eltnen;Eltnen means "the beautiful land". It was the most stunning region in all of Atreia until the Millennium War, but since then has stuggled with a continuing and irresistable desertification that threatens the entire region.

string.name: STR_DIC_E_LF3_name
string.body: Heiron;A region in Elysea that has been invaded by the Balaur through instability of the Aetheric Field.

string.name: STR_DIC_E_DF1_name
string.body: Ishalgen;A small but diverse region in Asmodae. The village there, Ishalgen village, is currently inhabited by raiders.

string.name: STR_DIC_E_DF1A_name
string.body: Altgard;A cold region centered around the fortress village where an Abyss path was discovered. It is so cold that the area surrounding the fortress is permanently frozen.

string.name: STR_DIC_E_DF2_name
string.body: Morheim;Morheim means 'the land of death', and the region is the most rugged area in all of Atreia.

string.name: STR_DIC_E_DF3_name
string.body: Beluslan;A barren region barely capable of sustaining Humans life. It has vast lifeless plains and high mountains.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_ZONE_NAME_LF2A
string.body: Theobomos;A region burnt to ashes during the Cataclysm. Only recently have treasure-hunting Shugos and runaway criminals gathered there to form a ragtag village.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_ZONE_NAME_DF2A
string.body: Brusthonin;It was once the breadbasket of Asmodae but has turned into a wasteland swarmed with the Undead. A reclamation project to revive the land is now in progress.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_ZONE_Path_LF2A
string.body: Theobomos;Onesimus, Eltnen's teleporter and Polyidus, Sanctum's teleporter can both send you there.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_Seirenia_Q
string.body: Seirenia;A mysterious beauty who enjoys bathing in [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA04_1] in the [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA04] every night. Nobody knows what she does or where she goes during the day.

Factional disputes drove him into hiding at the Orton Farm in Heiron, but he has been missing since the Krall took over the area. Now only a number of Porgus he used to raise remain at the site.

string.name: STR_DIC_E_Poeta_Li
string.body: Dark Poeta;A future Poeta, one that burns after being conquered by the Balaur. You can reach it through the Artefact of Transcendence if you have a [%dic:STR_DIC_I_3705_Li].

string.name: STR_DIC_E_Poeta_Da
string.body: Dark Poeta;A glimpse into the future, of an Elyos region now ruled by the Balaur. You can reach it through the Artefact of Circulation if you have a [%dic:STR_DIC_I_4705_Da].

string.body: Steel Rake;A Shulack ship run by the Steel Rake Pirates. The Steel Rake is anchored at one of the floating islands between Elysea and Asmodae. [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Shugo_LC1_29], a Shugo at the Outer Dock can send you to it.

string.name: STR_DIC_E_Ship_Da
string.body: Steel Rake;A Shulack ship run by the Steel Rake Pirates. The Steel Rake is anchored at one of the floating islands between Elysea and Asmodae. [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Shugo_DC1_24], a Shugo at the Airship Dock in Pandaemonium can send you to it.

string.name: STR_DIC_E_Vivre
string.body: Fangwings of the Eracus Temple Cavern;Refers to the [%dic:STR_DIC_M_0C_Vivre_28_An]s, [%dic:STR_DIC_M_1C_Vivre_28_Ae]s, [%dic:STR_DIC_M_2C_Vivre_29_Ae]s, [%dic:STR_DIC_M_2C_VivrePath_29_Ae]s and [%dic:STR_DIC_M_7C_Vivre_31_Ae]s inhabiting the Eracus Temple Cavern.

These are thought to be swallowed by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_DrakeAgDGuard_30_Ae], [%dic:STR_DIC_M_ShadowstalkerreWiGuard_30_Ae], [%dic:STR_DIC_M_SouledstoneDReGuard_31_Ae], and [%dic:STR_DIC_M_ElementalFire3D_31_An].

string.body: Platinum Ore;Best gathered near the NewÂ Heiron Gate.

string.body: Udas Temple;An old Beritra Temple occupied by the Balaur and the Dragonbound. You can reach it by passing through the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF4_SZ_B6].

string.name: STR_DIC_E_IDTemple_DF4
string.body: Udas Temple;An old Beritra Temple occupied by the Balaur and the Dragonbound. You can reach it by passing through the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_SZ_DF4_B6].

string.body: Nexus;The head of the Dragonbound in the Udas Temple, whose power can convert even an ordinary person into a Dragonbound.

string.name: STR_DIC_E_IDTemple_FanaticAsNamed_53_Ah
string.body: Chura Twinblade;A boss of the Dragonbound. Chura Twinblade follows orders from Malika under the Udas Temple.

string.name: STR_DIC_E_Q30151

string.body: Silentera Canyon;An underground corridor connecting Gelkmaros and Inggison. The entrances open from the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF4_SZ_3011_A] and the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF4_SZ_3021_A]. Deep inside the Canyon lies the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_ZONE_NAME_IDCatacombs].

string.name: STR_DIC_Notes_001
string.body: Operation Policy;Refers to the rules that the company has implemented to respond with consistency to any problems that may occur while the company operates Aion. It is also a promise between the company and its customers to create a more stable and efficient game environment.

string.name: STR_DIC_Notes_002
string.body: Fraudulent Item;It is impossible to restore the items that you have obtained for free or in any inappropriate way through actions that violate the [%dic:STR_DIC_Notes_001].

string.name: STR_DIC_Notes_003
string.body: Chatting Restriction;If you repeatedly spam, curse or swear on the chat window, you may be warned or be forbidden to chat according to the [%dic:STR_DIC_Notes_001].

string.name: STR_DIC_Notes_004
string.body: In-game Support;You can ask the [%dic:STR_DIC_Notes_013]s for help when you face a serious trouble during game play and cannot handle it on your own. You can submit a petition from 13:00 pm to 05:00 am of the next day.

string.name: STR_DIC_Notes_005
string.body: Homepage Support;For more information about services, game play or troubleshooting, please submit your petition to the Customer Support Centre on the [%dic:STR_DIC_Notes_011]. You can use this service when you need to attach a screenshot or when you have a relevant question.

string.name: STR_DIC_Notes_006
string.body: Game Guide;The encyclopedia of Aion. The company regularly updates and summarizes ever-changing Aion information for customers.

string.name: STR_DIC_Notes_007
string.body: AION;For the latest Aion news, visit aionfreetoplay.com.

string.name: STR_DIC_Notes_009
string.body: Account Theft;Please write to the [%dic:STR_DIC_Notes_010] immediately if anyone has misused your account.

string.name: STR_DIC_Notes_010
string.body: Account Theft Report Centre;You can report any instance of [%dic:STR_DIC_Notes_009] to the Customer Report Centre on the [%dic:STR_DIC_Notes_011].

string.name: STR_DIC_Notes_011
string.body: Official Homepage;You can find all games that Gameforge provides. The homepage address is http://www.gameforge.com

string.name: STR_DIC_Notes_012
string.body: Official Base;A club community service, which divides into the game base and the social base.

string.name: STR_DIC_Notes_013
string.body: GM;GMs or Game Masters will be always ready to assist customers. They will take care of all troubles you may encounter during the gameplay as soon as possible.

string.name: STR_DIC_Notes_014
string.body: Cargo/Award System;The In-game Cargo System delivers gifts and messages to celebrate certain occasions and to award the best reporters and event winners.

string.name: STR_DIC_Notes_015
string.body: CM;The CM or Community Manager talks with customers on the free bulletin board of the homepage and implements changes into the game.

string.name: STR_DIC_Notes_016
string.body: Tazz;Aion bulletin board manager ([%dic:STR_DIC_Notes_015]), who first started to work online on January 29, 2007. He may be the closest person to the customers. Tazz writes his field experience report every week and serves as a bridge between the Aion Team and its customers.

string.name: STR_DIC_Notes_017
string.body: Personal Authentication;A process to authenticate your identity through your cellular phone or public authentication.

string.name: STR_DIC_Notes_018
string.body: Public authentication;A certificate that you can obtain from a financial institute if you pay a certain fee and follow the specified procedure.

string.name: STR_DIC_Notes_020
string.body: Game Agreement;A process by which you agree to the Service Terms before you start playing the game. You cannot play the game if you do not agree to the terms.

string.name: STR_DIC_Notes_022
string.body: Additional Service;Services that you can use after the [%dic:STR_DIC_Notes_017] process, including gender change and server transfer.

string.name: STR_DIC_Notes_023
string.body: Toll;A means of payment equivalent to cash on the Internet. You can use it to buy paid items or paid services of the game services that the company currently operates.

string.name: STR_DIC_Notes_024
string.body: Unacceptable User;A user who has violated the [%dic:STR_DIC_Notes_001] in or out of the game by engaging in [%dic:STR_DIC_Notes_025] or committing [%dic:STR_DIC_Notes_026]. If you are classified as an acceptable user, you may be subjected to restricted access to your character and account.

string.name: STR_DIC_Notes_025
string.body: Verbal Abuse;Inappropriate speech that may offend others in or out of the game. If you are abusive, you may be subjected to restricted access to your character and account according to the [%dic:STR_DIC_Notes_001].

string.name: STR_DIC_Notes_026
string.body: Fraud;Any behaviour that aims at deceiving other customers for personal gain. If you engage in fraud, you may be subjected to restricted access to your account according to the [%dic:STR_DIC_Notes_001].

string.name: STR_DIC_Notes_027
string.body: Illegal Programs;All illegal software/hardware that can affect the gameplay and all programs not authorized by the company.

string.name: STR_DIC_Notes_028
string.body: Bot Program;All external software and hardware that automatically repeats a specific action infinitely even when additional operation is not made.

string.body: Pandaemonium Expedition Inspector;An inspector dispatched to the Balaur Fortress in Vorgaltem in order to research the disappearance of Balaur Prisoners. So far, only [%dic:STR_DIC_N_hedele] and [%dic:STR_DIC_N_ovirin] have arrived.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_LDF5_Under_all
string.body: Underground of Katalam;The ancient Rune Tribe set up facilities in the underground of Katalam which remained intact after the Tribe's demise. The underground is currently occupied by the Katalam Patrol, the Katalam Cleanup Squad, the Beritra Army, the Tiamat Deserts and Shugos.

string.body: Mad[pl:"Mad"] Anubit[pl:"Anubit"];Undead that can be summoned. His madness is plain to see.

string.body: Sleepy[pl:"Sleepy"] Anubit[pl:"Anubit"];An Undead that can be summoned. He looks sleepy.

string.body: Theano;An Elyos agent who is a member of the Zephyr Daevas and part of the infiltration operation at Jormungand's Bridge.

string.body: Rohellein;An Asmodian agent who is a member of the Nightfall Archons and part of the infiltration operation at Jormungand's Bridge.

string.body: Balaur Generators;Surkana generators for supporting the guard posts by Jormungand's Bridge. Includes the [%dic:STR_DIC_E_IDF5_U1_VriFlag01_65_e], the [%dic:STR_DIC_E_IDF5_U1_VriFlag02_65_e], the [%dic:STR_DIC_E_IDF5_U1_VriFlag03_65_e] and the [%dic:STR_DIC_E_IDF5_U1_VriFlag04_65_e].

string.name: STR_DIC_E_IDF5_U1_VriFlag01_65_e_nouse
string.body: Generator[pl:"Generators"] at the Guard Post;A Balaur generator that was installed at the furthest guard post from Jormungand's Bridge. The generator needs to be shut off so that the guard post can be captured and the bridge operation switch used.

string.name: STR_DIC_E_IDF5_U1_VriFlag02_65_e_nouse
string.body: Generator[pl:"Generators"] at the North Post;A Balaur generator that was installed at the northern guard post by Jormungand's Bridge. The generator needs to be shut off so that the guard post can be captured and the bridge operation switch used.

string.name: STR_DIC_E_IDF5_U1_VriFlag03_65_e_nouse
string.body: Generator[pl:"Generators"] at the South Post;A Balaur generator that was installed at the southern guard post by Jormungand's Bridge. The generator needs to be shut off so that the guard post can be captured and the bridge operation switch used.

string.name: STR_DIC_E_IDF5_U1_VriFlag04_65_e_nouse
string.body: Generator[pl:"Generators"] at the Defence Post;A Balaur generator that was installed at the innermost guard post by Jormungand's Bridge. The generator needs to be shut off so that the guard post can be captured and the bridge operation switch can be used.

string.name: STR_DIC_W_IDVritra_Base_all
string.body: Sauro War Depot;A warehouse in the Sauro Mountains where the Beritra Army stores its war materials and weapons. It once served as the shelter of the Rune Tribe, but is now controlled by Sita, the Brigade General of the 40th Army. It can be reached via the [%dic:STR_DIC_N_OBJ_IDVritra_Base_Enter].

string.name: STR_DIC_W_IDLDF5_Under_02_all
string.body: Refuge of the Rune Tribe;The refuge was discovered in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5_Under_all] and can be entered via the [%dic:STR_DIC_N_OBJ_IDLDF5_Under_02_Entrance_In]. It once served as the grave for high-ranking members of the Rune Tribe and thus hides many valuable ancient relics.

string.body: Commanders of the Special Research Troop;The High Command of the special research troop sent to obtain the relics containing instructions on the use of Idgel. Includes [%dic:STR_DIC_M_IDF5_U2_P_VriIU_Wi_N_65_Ah], [%dic:STR_DIC_M_IDF5_U2_P_VriRP_Ri_N_65_Ae2] and [%dic:STR_DIC_M_IDF5_U2_P_VriRP_As_N_65_Ae2]. You have to hurry to find them because they appear in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_IDLDF5_Under_02_all] and disappear as soon as they have retrieved the relics.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_2112a
string.body: Airon Breast Feather;The breast feather of Blackbeak Airon. It is downy soft and often used for quilted clothes.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_2113a
string.body: Shiny Silver Ring;A shining ring with 'To my love Dabi' engraved on the inside.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_2115a
string.body: Sap Bottle;It contains sap from the trees in the Munihele forest.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_2116a
string.body: Treasure Map;A map showing the location of the Black Opal, a treasure sought by the sailors of Eyvindr.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_2118a
string.body: Pirate's Journal;Found on the body of a sailor of Eyvindr, it is the journal of the Rossio Pirates, who went searching for the Black Opal.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_2119a
string.body: Black Opal;A gem sought by the Eyvindr sailors. It is said that the Opal's owner can change their fate.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_2120a
string.body: Brax Skin;Taken from a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_BraxD_5_n] or a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_BraxBabyD_5_n]. It's thick and warm, though the hair is a bit wiry.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_2121a
string.body: Whetstone;An item Mijou asked you to take to Delle. Used to sharpen blades.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_2122a
string.body: Silver Necklace;Faded silver necklace. It has a pendant engraved with 'Prison Sentinel Crypto'.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_2123a
string.body: Ginseng Root;It is difficult to find it as it is a very elusive plant. The easiest way to get it is to rob [%dic:STR_DIC_M_WormbabyD_10_An]s of it.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_2123b
string.body: Methu Egg;The egg of a Methu tended by a Dundun Looklook in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF1_8]. Generally considered a delicacy.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_2123c
string.body: Sparkie Eggs;The eggs of the [%dic:STR_DIC_M_spakyD_6_n]. They are known to be a delicacy.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_2124a
string.body: Sparkle Leg;The leg of [%dic:STR_DIC_M_SpakleD_7_n]. It is good for leg pains.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_2124b
string.body: Ampha Thorn;The thorn of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_WormbabyD_7_An]. It is good for leg pains.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_2126a
string.body: Odella Juice;Fermented Odella juice. It smells good and is used to make alcoholic drinks.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_2127a
string.body: Mau Adornment;An accessory made from Citrin ore. It can be sold at a high price.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_2128a
string.body: Dried Ginseng Root;A preserved root segment. Regular consumption of ginseng revitalizes the body.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_junk_k_s_13d
string.body: Dukaki Amulet;Wooden amulets of various shapes. You can obtain them from the Kobolds in the [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA12] and the [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA13].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_junk_v_s_09d
string.body: Lepharist Crest;The crest worn by those occupying [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA24]. A skull is drawn on it.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_junk_l_s_16d
string.body: Krall Ration;Rations of the Tursin Krall. The rations reek too much to eat.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1949a
string.body: Ksellid Whisker;Whiskers of [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Shellizard_33_An], rumoured to be very nutritious. It's very much in demand.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_1932a
string.body: Crystal Studded Headband;A headband given to [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LehparFigNamedQ_38_Ae] by Thersites when they were in love.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1930A
string.body: Feather of Fire;A mysterious feather obtainable from [%dic:STR_DIC_N_NPC_Griffonix].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1930B

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1930C
string.body: Burning Barghest Tail;The warm tail of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Hellhound_39_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_herb_n_c_10a

string.name: STR_DIC_I_noblemetal_10a

string.name: STR_DIC_I_vegetable_n_c_10a
string.body: Kukuru;An annual vine of the gourd family growing in [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA24]. It looks similar to a pumpkin and has a variety of uses.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2002A

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2003A
string.body: Dead Folks' Stuff;A precious item carried by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_GhostD_7_An]s.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2004a
string.body: Charmed Cube;A cube carried by the ghost in the Ishalgen Prison. It's supposed to be quite an expensive item.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2004b

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2005A

string.name: STR_DIC_I_herb_n_c_10a2
string.body: Iron Ore;Ore which is used to make weapons or magical materials. You can mine it in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF1_8], [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF1_9], or [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF1A_3].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_GB_SOURCE_TREE_10A

string.name: STR_DIC_I_herb_d_n_c_10a
string.body: Azpha;An herb that grows well in dense forests. It is widely distributed near [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF1_3], [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF1_7] and other areas.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2013C

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2015A

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2016A

string.body: Shania's Poison Potion;A poison that Shania made by mixing Arachna poison with other substances.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2018A
string.body: Umkata's Bones;Shards of Umkata's skeleton needed to awaken his ghost. Carried by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LycanWarriorS_18_Ae]s or [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LycanHunterS_17_An]s.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2018B
string.body: Umkata's Earrings;It can wake up Umkata. It is said that it was placed within [%dic:STR_DIC_E_20] and hidden in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF1A_25].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2018C
string.body: Umkata's Weapon;It can wake up Umkata. It is said that it was stolen by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_AElemental1stD_18_An]s and [%dic:STR_DIC_M_AElemental2ndD_18_An]s.

string.body: Sledgehammer Heads;To be used in the reconstruction of Impetusium. You need to deliver it to Banatisai.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2022A

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_2203a
string.body: Altgard Crystal;A crystal which can be obtained from the [%dic:STR_DIC_E_17]s of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF1A_2]. It contains a lot of Aether.

string.body: Sparkie Sap;The slimy sap of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_SpakyD_10_n]. It can be used in making detergents by mixing it with herbal powder.

string.body: Airon Meat;The breast meat of [%dic:STR_DIC_M_HiivD_10_n]. It tastes good and is many recipes.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_2206a
string.body: Slink Tail;You can obtain it by killing the [%dic:STR_DIC_M_lepismaD_10_n]s living near the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF1A_1].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_2208a

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_2209a

string.body: Pluma Feather;The tail feather of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_lupylliniD_10_n]. The end is strong and sharp so it is often used as a quill.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_2217a

string.body: Frightcorn Seed;The seed of a Frightcorn plant. [%dic:STR_DIC_M_RatmanGathererM_11_An]s, [%dic:STR_DIC_M_RatmanGathererMS_11_An]s, and [%dic:STR_DIC_M_RatmanGathererMS_13_An]s have it.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_2219a
string.body: Ripened Frightcorn Stem;The stem of a Frightcorn that grows in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF1A_17].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_doc_quest_2222a
string.body: Manir's Letter;A letter from Manir to Karl.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_2223a

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_2224a

string.body: Beehive;A beehive in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF1A_11]. Bee swarms will attack if it is disturbed.
