string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2356a
string.body: Spiner Stone;The hard shell of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LobsterReD_27_An]. Some people mistake it for a stone since it is round and solid.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2361a
string.body: Elim Fruit;The fruit that Elim bear once in several decades or centuries. Strangely, this is burnt a little on the outside.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2362a
string.body: Basilisk Scale;The rough scale of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_BasiliskD_30_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2381a
string.body: Tripeed Fruit;A fruit you can pick in [%dic:STR_DIC_DF2_2382_Trifid]. There are some seeds in it that are used in the making of traps and poisons.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2386a
string.body: Spriggan Back Skin;The back skin from a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Sprigg2_32_An]. It is used for winter clothing since it is thin but warm.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2389a
string.body: Crestlich Beak;A beak you can obtain by killing [%dic:STR_DIC_M_CrestlichReD_33_An]s and [%dic:STR_DIC_M_CrestlichReD_35_An]s.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2401a
string.body: Scolopen Poison;Poison that can be extracted from the tail of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_ScorpionDF2_35_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2442a
string.body: Odella Pill;Pills made by concentrating the Odella cultivated by the Nunu tribe. Found on [%dic:STR_DIC_M_ReC_LycanRangerM_40_Ae]s and [%dic:STR_DIC_M_KeB_LycanKnightM_38_Ae]s.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2332a
string.body: Buffalid Neck Meat;The meat of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_HexiggD_26_An]. It is quite fatty.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2332b
string.body: Snuffler Sirloin;The sirloin of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_merdionD_25_n]. You need 5 points to cook it.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2332c
string.body: Kurin Thigh Meat;The thigh meat from a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_CuresD_25_An]. You need 2 points to use it as a food ingredient.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2343a
string.body: Ginseng-shaped Incense;A flat incense that resembles ginseng.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2346a
string.body: Odella String;String belonging to [%dic:STR_DIC_M_KeA_LycanKnightM_28_Ae]s and [%dic:STR_DIC_M_AeA_LycanAssassinM_29_Ae]s. It is made by twisting dried Odella tightly.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2367a
string.body: Shugo Tailring;An accessory that Shugos wear on their tails.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2371a
string.body: Power Crystal;A blue stone embedded in the body of the [%dic:STR_DIC_M_SouledstoneDReD_33_Ae] in the Fire Temple.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2371b
string.body: Magic Power Crystal;A red stone embedded in the body of the [%dic:STR_DIC_M_SouledstoneAReD_33_Ae] in the Fire Temple.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2372a
string.body: Long Arachna Leg;The long leg of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_OctasideD_17_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2372b
string.body: Heart of Flame;A hard lump that can be obtained by killing [%dic:STR_DIC_M_2372]s. It holds the energy of flames.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2372c
string.body: Pungent Liquor;A liquor made of [%dic:STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2372a] and [%dic:STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2372b].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2373a
string.body: Ancient Weapon;A weapon the Kromede the Corrupt is coveting. It is located deep inside the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF2_SUB_toDF2_DFlame].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2384a
string.body: Gauze Bandage;Bandage that Sarinerk lost. You can get it by killing a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_HellhoundD_30_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2384b
string.body: Prex Bandage;Bandage that Sarinerk lost. You can get it by killing a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_SuccubusGuard_30_Ae].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2384c
string.body: Compress;Compress that Sarinerk lost. You can get it by killing a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_MaidengolemD_30_Ae].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2392a
string.body: Green Virago Feather;The wing feather of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_HarpyD_34_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2392b
string.body: Dark Red Crestlich Feather;The tail feather of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_CrestlichReD_33_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2392c
string.body: White Pecku Mane;The mane of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_CockatriceD_33_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2431a
string.body: Sheluk Poison;The poison from [%dic:STR_DIC_M_ShelukD_37_An]s and [%dic:STR_DIC_M_ShelukD_38_An]s. Its poison is so potent that just one drop can paralyse a humanoid.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2452a
string.body: Mosbear Fluid;It can neutralise unclassified poison to a certain extent. You can get it by killing [%dic:STR_DIC_M_MosbearS_37_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2302a
string.body: Opal Necklace;The necklace that Frenai lost. You can get it by killing [%dic:STR_DIC_M_lupylliniD_19_n]s.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2302b
string.body: Sapphire Ring;The ring that Frenai lost. You can get it by killing [%dic:STR_DIC_M_PhainiD_19_n]s.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2302c
string.body: Pearl Earrings;The earrings that Frenai lost. You can get it by killing [%dic:STR_DIC_M_lepismaD_19_n]s.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2391a
string.body: Rynoce Horn;The big horn of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_RhinoceDF2_34_An]. It is highly prized as a material for armour and weapons.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2407a
string.body: Construction Blueprint;A blueprint showing the whole of the Lepharist complex. [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LehparAsNamedDQ_40_Ae] carries it.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2353a
string.body: Amethyst;A violet gemstone that can be extracted from [%dic:STR_DIC_E_OBJ_DF2_FOBJ_Crystal_Q2353].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2423a
string.body: Sparkle Spawner;The spawner you obtained by killing [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Spakle_19_n]. An oddly sweet smell wafts from the pouch.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2425a
string.body: Arachna Poison;The poison of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_OctasideD_23_An]. The strength of the poison is weak. It is mainly used for research.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2427a
string.body: Potion Bottle;A bottle of liquid medicine. It is contained in the [%dic:STR_DIC_OBJ_DF2_WoodenBox_Q2427].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2427b
string.body: Research Materials;Various materials used in the development of a new medicines. They are contained inside the [%dic:STR_DIC_OBJ_DF2_Barrel_Q2427].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2429a
string.body: Crasaur Leather;The smooth, thick hide of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_PhainiD_22_n].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2429b
string.body: Brax Skin;The hide of [%dic:STR_DIC_M_BraxD_21_n]. It is covered with soft, short hairs.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2476a
string.body: Clodworm Tail;The tail you obtained by killing [%dic:STR_DIC_M_ClodwormRe2D_30_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2477a
string.body: Lean Crestlich Ribs;The lean ribs of [%dic:STR_DIC_M_CrestlichReD_29_n] known for its good taste. They can be found only in Beluslan.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2478a
string.body: Gnarl Stump;The tree stump you can get from [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Xipeto_30_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2478b
string.body: Scolopen Meat;The meat you obtained by hunting [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Scorpion_29_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2478c
string.body: Ksellid Hock Meat;The hind leg meat cut from [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Shellizard_30_An] that you hunted.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2478all
string.body: Ingredients for Kselopen Sausage;Refers to [%dic:STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2478a], [%dic:STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2478b], and [%dic:STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2478c].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2430a
string.body: Holy Pendant;A thick-chained necklace that has a hanging medal with a wing-shaped engraving. You can get it from [%dic:STR_DIC_M_DaruD_21_n]s.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2494a
string.body: Magic Earrings;Earrings that have a flame shape engraved on a thin, gold plate. It is carried by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Sprigg3NamedDQA_24_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2494b
string.body: Red Heart Necklace;A necklace of silver with a dark red jewel hanging from it. It is worn by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Sprigg3NamedDQB_25_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2494c
string.body: Dragon Blood Bracelet;A bracelet of red beads threaded together. It is in the possession of [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Sprigg3NamedDQC_25_Ae].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2446a
string.body: Nunu Fertilizer;A dark mass contained in a small sack. It is carried by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_FnC_RatmanGathererM_38_n]s, [%dic:STR_DIC_M_FnA_RatmanWarriorM_38_An]s, [%dic:STR_DIC_M_FnB_RatmanWarriorM_38_An]s, [%dic:STR_DIC_M_FnB_RatmanWarriorM_40_An]s, [%dic:STR_DIC_M_RnA_RatmanScoutM_38_An]s, and [%dic:STR_DIC_M_RnA_RatmanScoutM_38_An_2]s.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1461a
string.body: Vespine Poison Stinger;The poisonous stinger of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_VespaNamed_23_n]. The end of it is hook-shaped.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1461b
string.body: Purple Membrane;A thin purple membrane enveloping the skin of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Debrie_16_n]. It is dangerous to touch as the whole membrane is infused with poison.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1462a
string.body: Arachna Poison Gland;The poison sac of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_OctasideD_22_An]. Squeezing it yields a transparent liquid.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1473a
string.body: Tayga Armour;The armour worn by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_PetA_DireBeastSD_38_An]s, [%dic:STR_DIC_M_PetA_DireBeastSD_40_An]s, and [%dic:STR_DIC_M_PetB_DireBeastSD_39_An]s. It is studded with pointy metal spikes.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1353a
string.body: Kselliki Meat;The soft meat of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_ShellizardBaby_28_An], [%dic:STR_DIC_M_ShellizardBabyL_28_An], [%dic:STR_DIC_M_ShellizardBaby_30_An], or [%dic:STR_DIC_M_ShellizardBabyL_30_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2481a
string.body: Caryatid Piece;A broken piece of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Maidengolem_26_An] in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF2_SZ_G1]. The stone is grey and glossy.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2483a
string.body: Daeva's Soul;The soul of a Daeva who lost his sense of self after being transformed into an [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Shellizard_33_An] for too long. You feel a hot sensation when you hold it in your hands.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2487a
string.body: Pretor Cell Tissue;The skin tissue of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Pretor_38_An]. It is of brownish-green hue.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2487b
string.body: Pretor Research Diary;A book somewhere in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF2_SZ_J]. An in-depth record of the Pretor discoveries, sorted by date.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_2034h
string.body: Abex Meat;The juicy meat of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_FethlotNmD_28_n]. When it is roasted on the [%dic:STR_DIC_E_OBJ_DF2_FOBJ_Q2034] a Tayga appears.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_2032c
string.body: Tranquility Powder;A mixture of various herbal powders. Sprinkling it on the ground between the two pillars of the tower at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF2_SUB_B1_2] can console the Spirits.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1722a
string.body: Eltnen Sunset;A perfume with fragrances of the green trees, hot air of the plains, sweet fruits, and moist earth. You can only get it in Eltnen.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1737a
string.body: Guardian General's Helmet;You can get it by defeating the Guardian Generals of the Siel's Western Fortress, the Siel's Eastern Fortress, or the Sulphur Fortress.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1739a
string.body: Guardian General's Sword;You can get it by defeating the Guardian Generals that guard the Reshanta Top Fortresses.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1771a
string.body: Worn Sword;Its blade is dull and the engravings on the handle have also faded away. You can acquire it by destroying the [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Ab1_1211_Skeleton_30_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1771b
string.body: Broken Sword;It is broken in half and only the handle remains. You can obtain it by killing [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Ab1_1211_SkeletonB_32_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1771c
string.body: Intact Sword;It looks all right at first, but the blade is too dull to be wielded. You can acquire it by destroying a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Ab1_1211_SkeletonC_32_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1772a
string.body: Bright Marble;A marble carried by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Ab1_1211_SouledStoneB_30_An]s. It glows in a different colour each time the direction is changed.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1730a
string.body: Bracer;A leather wrist guard worn by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Ab1_1131_Skeleton_25_An]s. It is of a thick leather and latches with a buckle.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1776a
string.body: Gilt-patterned Bottle;A wine bottle contained inside the [%dic:STR_DIC_E_small_box]. It is a glass wine bottle covered with gilt patterns.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1778a
string.body: Archon Epaulet's;A splendid epaulet decorated with jewels. It is worn by the Asmodian fighters [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Dullaha], [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Greip], and [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Rota].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1731a
string.body: Hard Bone;The shin bone of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Ab1_1131_Skeleton_25_An]. It is hard and heavy.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1749a
string.body: Fortress Protector's Mark;A small epaulet embroidered with a trapezoid shape. You can get it from [%dic:STR_DIC_title_1749] in the Siel's Eastern Fortress.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1751a
string.body: Viscous Fluid;The fluid of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Ab1_1141_Flyingeye_27_An]. A slippery mucus with a mouldy smell.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1751b
string.body: Hoverstone Core;The core of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Ab1_1141_FungyB_29_An]. Yellow granules are scattered on the black stone.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1758a
string.body: Mark of Red Hasia;A badge with a small flower made of gold. It is worn by [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Asynja], [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Gagnrad], and [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Glati].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1796a
string.body: Griffon Egg;The egg you can obtain by defeating [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Griffon_35_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1796b
string.body: Crynac Salivary Gland;The salivary gland of [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Criton_36_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1759a
string.body: Guard's Insignia;A small epaulet embroidered with a branch. It is worn by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_SulphurTree_Guard]s.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1762a
string.body: Hazy Metal Plate;The crystal of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Ab1_1251_Elementalwater3_30_An]. It is difficult to see, but you can feel something cold.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1762b
string.body: Hazy String;The tentacle of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Ab1_1251_WaterWorm_30_An]. It is difficult to see, but you can feel something thin and tough.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1763a
string.body: Translucent Metal;The crystal of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Ab1_1251_ElementalAir4_32_An]. You can vaguely see the other side of this cold metallic object.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1763b
string.body: Translucent String;The tentacle of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Ab1_1251_WaterWorm_30_An]. You can't really see it if you don't look carefully enough.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1764a
string.body: Trico Horn;The hard horn of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Ab1_1251_Tricorn_31_An]. It has patterns very much like a tree's annual rings.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1764b
string.body: Immortal Pluma Feather;The neck feather of [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Ab1_1251_lupyllini_31_An]. It is brightly coloured and soft.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1764c
string.body: Granker Horn;The horn of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Ab1_1251_Giantdeer_31_An]. The end is forked.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1781a
string.body: Klaw Wing;The wings of [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Ab1_1221_NeutL2_38_An]s and [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Ab1_1221_NeutL2_39_An]s. It looks like a thin ellipsoid plate of brown colour.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1781b
string.body: Klaw Leg;The legs of [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Ab1_1221_NeutH2_38_An]s and [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Ab1_1221_NeutH2_39_An]s. It is thin and pointed.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1784a
string.body: Crest of Pandaemonium;The crest worn by [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Rathgrid], [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Laufey], [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Goinn], [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Modir], and [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Lodurr]. It is embroidered with the wings of Asmodians, shield, sword and others.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1786a
string.body: Draconute Weapon;The Balaur weapons taken from [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Ab1_1231_LizardmanFi_39_An] and [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Ab1_1231_LizardmanRa_39_An]. Its surface is bumpy and of blood-red colour.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1789a
string.body: Supply Box;A wooden chest containing weapons and food. You can get it by killing [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Menglad], [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Modsognir], [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Reginlief], [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Moinn] or [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Geri].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1794a
string.body: Operation Order;A written order carried by the Red Hasia Legionaries [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Rossjof], [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Grid], [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Lofn], [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Lifprasir] and [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Magnair], who are on the Drakenwreck.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1801a
string.body: Wing Insignia;An insignia worn by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_1801_all]s. It is embroidered with black wing patterns.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1802a
string.body: Insignia of Reshanta;An insignia worn by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_1802_all]s. It is embroidered with flame shapes of geometric patterns.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1803a
string.body: Fortress Insignia;An insignia worn by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_1803_all]s. It is engraved with a castle gate and spears crossing each other.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1804a
string.body: Insignia of Azphel;An insignia worn by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_1804_all]s. It is engraved with the symbol of Azphel.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1805a
string.body: Tree Insignia;An insignia worn by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_1805_all]s. It is engraved with the simple shape of a tree.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1806a
string.body: Thorny Vine Insignia;An insignia worn by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_1806_all]s. It is in the shape of a shield, and is engraved with thorny vines.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1807a
string.body: Archon Weapon;The weapons carried by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_1807_all]s. The name of their Legion is inscribed on the handle.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1808a
string.body: Archon Insignia;An insignia worn by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_1808_all]s. It is engraved with the wings of an Asmodian and the form of a helmet.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1809a
string.body: Archon's Hairpin;The hairpin of [%dic:STR_DIC_M_1809_all]s who appear when the fortress battle is activated. It is engraved with delicate feather patterns.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1810a
string.body: Archon Kisk;The Kisk carried by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_1810_all]s. It has a purple wing attached on top.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1811a
string.body: Archon Cloak;A red cloak worn by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_1811_all]s.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1812a
string.body: Archon Flag;A flag held by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_1812_all]. Asmodian wings and helmets are drawn on the red cloth.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1813a
string.body: Kysis Archon Insignia;An insignia worn by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_1813_all]s. It has a small pin so the insignia can be attached to clothing.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1814a
string.body: Kysis Archon Weapon;The weapon used by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_1814_all]s.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1815a
string.body: Miren Archon Insignia;An insignia worn by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_1815_all]s. A shield and sword is embroidered on it in red thread.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1816a
string.body: Miren Archon Kisk;The Kisk carried by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_1816_all]s. A purple wing is attached to it.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_1819a
string.body: Cannibal Worm Sap;The sticky sap of [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Ab1_1141_Worm_28_An] and [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Ab1_1141_WormB_29_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_11450a
string.body:
Young Taloc Leaf;Young leaves of Taloc, a Holy Tree. They glitter with dew and mystery.
You can obtain it only from [%dic:STR_DIC_OBJ_IDElim_Seed_Q11450].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_11452a
string.body: Mosqua's Poison;The poison fluid of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_IDElim_2F_NeutWorkmanfly_Qeen_52_Ae]. It's foul-smelling and acidic.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_11454a
string.body: Growth Sap;A potent sap found inside the body of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Ab1_1011_AgrintGi_50_An] in Reshanta. It is known to revive withered plants.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_11456a
string.body: Mutant Chromosome;Biological material drawn from [%dic:STR_DIC_E_Q11456all] that live within Taloc. It has mutated in an unusual way.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_11457a
string.body: Wooden Core;Shards of inner wood from Taloc. Examining it shows how the mighty Elim grew.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_11459a
string.body: Komad Spirit;The inner spirit of [%dic:STR_DIC_M_IDElim_3F_KomadeWa_52_Ae]s and [%dic:STR_DIC_M_IDElim_3F_KomadeWi_52_Ae]s. It shines with vitality stolen from Taloc.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_doc_quest_11461a
string.body: Taloc Research Diary;A diary discovered in [%dic:STR_DIC_OBJ_IDElim_Book_Q11461]. Its content is difficult to understand, but seems important.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_21450a
string.body:
Taloc's Young Leaf;Leaf from Taloc, a Holy Tree. His leaves are known to have a healing effect.
Only found in [%dic:STR_DIC_OBJ_IDElim_Seed_Q11450].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_21452a
string.body: Mosqua's Fluid;The sap of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_IDElim_2F_NeutWorkmanfly_Qeen_52_Ae]. It sticks to almost everything.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_21454a
string.body: Growth Accelerant;Mysterious liquid known to revive withered plants. Obtained from a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Ab1_1011_AgrintGi_50_An] in Reshanta.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_21456a
string.body: Insect Sample;A husk from one of the [%dic:STR_DIC_E_Q11456all] inside Taloc.

string.body: Core Wood;Shards of inner wood from Taloc. Examining it shows how the mighty Elim grew.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_21459a

string.body: Taloc Research Report;An important report that was discovered in [%dic:STR_DIC_OBJ_IDElim_Book_Q11461]. Its contents are hard to understand, but seem important.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_11003a
string.body: Seafoam Energy;The energy of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LF4_A_Foam_Wisp_51_n]. It is used in making Illusion Spheres.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_30207a
string.body: Fragrant Oil Gland;A gland from a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LF4_C_Dragonfly_55_An] or [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LF4_C_DragonSnake_55_An]. When refined, it is a key ingredient in perfumed oils.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_IDCatacombs_Certification_01
string.body: Decree of Valor;Proof of great valor, courage, and strength in service of your people. The more you have, the greater rewards you can earn.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_30217_All
string.body: Stigma Ceremony Relics;Items necessary to hold a ceremony opening a new Stigma slot: the [%dic:STR_DIC_I_QUEST_30217a] and [%dic:STR_DIC_I_QUEST_30217b]. They are held by the Balaur.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_30217a
string.body: Spirit's Incense Burner;A burner holding sweet-smelling incense. Vital to a ceremony opening Stigma slots. It is in the hands of [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Aeshma], a Tiamat underling.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_30217b
string.body: Scroll of Repose;An ancient scroll written with mystic runes. Vital to a ceremony opening Stigma slots. It is in the hands of [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Bhemah], a Stormwing underling.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_30223a
string.body: Plaguebearer's Core;The core of [%dic:STR_DIC_E_IDCatacombsN_HugeSlimeNmd_55_Ah]. Vital to the research of new poisons.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_IDCatacombs_Reric_01

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_30226a

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_30210b

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_30230a
string.body: Balaur Scale;A scale with the power to affect Spirits. Only a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LF4_B4_DrakanWorkerFi_54_An] or [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LF4_B4_DrakanWorkerPr_54_An] have the spiritual energy to grow such scales.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_30231a
string.body: Gryphu's Head Feather;A common focus in ceremonies to summon the Spirits of Balaurea. Usually plucked from a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LF4_B7_Condor_Dr_53_An].

string.body: Ritual Components; [%dic:STR_DIC_I_QUEST_30228a], [%dic:STR_DIC_I_QUEST_30229a], [%dic:STR_DIC_I_QUEST_30230a], and [%dic:STR_DIC_I_QUEST_30231a] requested by Teressa in exchange for the Key to Blue Flame Incinerator.

string.body: Vorpal Essence;Rumour has it that merely looking at it can kill a Human. A Balaur living in Beshmundir Temple is its current guardian.

string.body: Special Shulack Refiner;Shulack Elder Lupukin, held in Beshmundir Temple, has the last known sample of this liquid.

string.body: Supply Report;A report about supplies being transported from Mitrakand to an unknown destination. Currently being used by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_DF4_FanaticFi_Q_54_An]s.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_30307a
string.body: Fragrant Milky Liquid;A cloudy liquid with an intense scent. Obtained from [%dic:STR_DIC_M_DF4_Mudthorn_DR_54_An]s, [%dic:STR_DIC_M_DF4_Foam_DR_55_An]s, or [%dic:STR_DIC_M_DF4_Slime_DR_55_An]s. When refined, it is a common ingredient in perfumed oils.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_30310b
string.body: Maroon Bile;Faded letters treated with this liquid become easier to read. Obtainable from a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_DF4_DragonFly_54_An] or [%dic:STR_DIC_M_DF4_Varanus_DR_54_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_30312a
string.body: Mystical Root;A root that has drunk in arcane energy from deep within the earth. Grows from the tips of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_DF4_Vampire_DR_54_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_30326a
string.body: Dream Powder;An elixir made from this powder allows its drinker to recall any dream. Obtained from a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_DF4_ShadowStalker_Sand_54_An] or [%dic:STR_DIC_M_DF4_ShadowStalker_Sand_55_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_30328a
string.body: Opaque Bladder;An item needed to call out Water Spirits. You can obtain it from a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_DF4_Cellatu_DR_54_An] or [%dic:STR_DIC_M_DF4_CellatuDR_Baby_54_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_30329a
string.body: Oozing Klaw Gland;A gland that is such a strong centre of energy, it is often used to summon Spirits. Obtained from a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_DF4_Neut_Worker_55_An], [%dic:STR_DIC_M_DF4_Neut_WorkerHigh_55_An], [%dic:STR_DIC_M_DF4_Neut_Fly_55_An], or [%dic:STR_DIC_M_DF4_Neut_FlyHigh_55_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_30330a
string.body: Pteron Bone Piece;Shards from the skeleton of a long-extinct bird. [%dic:STR_DIC_M_DF4_KrallFi_DR_55_An]s and [%dic:STR_DIC_M_DF4_KrallSc_DR_55_An]s carry them as talismans.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_30331a
string.body: Tattered Membrane;A material used to summon Fire Spirits. Obtained from an [%dic:STR_DIC_M_DF4_Bonedrake_DR_54_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_30333_All
string.body: Ritual Components;[%dic:STR_DIC_I_QUEST_30328a], [%dic:STR_DIC_I_QUEST_30329a], [%dic:STR_DIC_I_QUEST_30330a], and [%dic:STR_DIC_I_QUEST_30331a] requested by Yumir in exchange for the Key to Blue Flame Incinerator.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_11024a
string.body: Crestlich Beak;A yellow beak from a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LF4_A_Crestlich_Head_51_n]. It is strong enough to shatter rocks.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_11025a
string.body: Boco's Beak;Twice as big as a normal Crestlich's beak. Used with deadly force by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LF4_A1_Crestlich_NamedQ_52_n].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_11028a
string.body: Neokin Fluid;Fluid from a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LF4_A2_Kuillus_Drana_51_An]. It is sticky and smelly.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_11028b
string.body: Crestlich Fluid;Fluid from a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LF4_A2_Crestlich_Drana_51_An]. It is thin and runny.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_11028c
string.body: Murmur Fluid;Fluid from a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LF4_A2_BAT_Drana_51_An]. It is viscous and bubbly.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_11031a
string.body: Moonflower Petal;Petals from a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LF4_A4_Fellial_Dr_51_An]. Eating even a small piece makes you sleepy.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_11033a
string.body: Vortile Fin;Fins from a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LF4_A_Varanus_Axolotl_51_n]. They are perfectly shaped to make sudden bursts of speed.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_11035a
string.body: Pluma Tail Feathers;Tail feathers that once adorned an [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LF4_A_Lupyllini_Peacock_51_n]. They shimmer with many colours.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_11035b
string.body: Obelisk Layout;A document stolen by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LF4_A5_Lupyllini_NamedQ_52_n]. It is a map marking places where Obelisks are installed.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_11037a
string.body: Mookie Stem;A stem from a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LF4_A5_Fungy_Cactus_51_n]. It's as dry as a desert dune.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_11037b
string.body: Cellatu Skin;The skin of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LF4_A5_Cellatu_Frog_51_An]. It's stretched out and almost see-through.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_shell_n_c_50a
string.body: Anevra;A shellfish sold by [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF4_SZ_A5_Shulack]. It makes savoury stews and soups.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_shopmaterial_co_23a
string.body: Triora Noodle;A hearty noodle sold by [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Luelas]. It tastes great with or without sauce.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_11037all
string.body: Tantalizing Recipe;An intricate recipe that requires 15 [%dic:STR_DIC_I_QUEST_11037a]s, 7 [%dic:STR_DIC_I_QUEST_11037b]s, 10 [%dic:STR_DIC_I_shell_n_c_50a]s, and 3 [%dic:STR_DIC_I_shopmaterial_co_23a]s.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_11039a
string.body: Village Chief's Helmet;A helmet worn by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LF4_A5_ShulackFi_NamedQ_52_Ae]. It has been passed down through many generations of Shulack chieftains.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_11044a
string.body: Dionae Aether Gem;Crystallized piece of Aether absorbed by a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LF4_A3_Dionaea_Od_52_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_11044b
string.body: Rotron Aether Gem;Crystallized piece of Aether absorbed by a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LF4_A3_Rottentree_Green_52_An].

string.body: Bloodstained Memento Box[pl:"Bloodstained Memento Boxes"];A box that you can receive from the Frostspirit Healers and Frostspirit Shamans roaming the[%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF2B_SZ_A].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_80140b
string.body: Elyos Soul Fragment;The Frost Granker Fawns and Cornhead Sylphens wandering the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF2B_SZ_A]drop these. They are fragments of the souls of unjustly murdered Daevas.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_80140c
string.body: Energy of Greed;Energy you can obtain from the Obsidian Kirrins and Obstinate Abexes wandering the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF2B_SZ_A]. They smell blood.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_80142a
string.body: Bloodstained Memento Box;The Veteran Tursin Healers and Tempest Spirits of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF1A_2] drop these.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_80142b
string.body: Asmodian Soul Fragment;The Leaf Plumas and Earth Spirits of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF1A_2] drop these. They are fragments of the souls of unjustly murdered Daevas.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_80142c
string.body: Energy of Greed;Energy you can obtain from the Contaminated Sylphens and Aqueous Spirits of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF1A_2]. They smell blood.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_80144a
string.body: Bloodstained Memento Box;The Anubite Seekers and Wounded Ghosts around [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF2_SUB_OP] drop these.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_80144b
string.body: Asmodian Soul Fragment;The Redthroat Crestliches and Bighorn Bakus around [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF2_SUB_OP] drop these. They are fragments of the souls of unjustly murdered Daevas.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_80144c
string.body: Energy of Greed;Energy you can obtain from Roaring Monitors and Wasteland Drakies around [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF2_SUB_OP]. They smell blood.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_80146a
string.body: Bloodstained Memento Box;The Black Spotted Clodworms and Virago Robbers on the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF2_SUB_toDF3A] drop these.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_80146b
string.body: Asmodian Soul Fragment;The Steelback Ksellids and Violeteye Sylphens on the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF2_SUB_toDF3A] drop these. They are fragments of the souls of unjustly murdered Daevas.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_80146c
string.body: Energy of Greed;Energy you can obtain from the Horned Tipolids and Mamut the Gigantic on the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF2_SUB_toDF3A]. They smell blood.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_80148a
string.body: Bloodstained Memento Box;The Gladiator Spirits and the Ancient Dark Spirits of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF2B_SZ_A1] drop these.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_80148b
string.body: Asmodian Soul Fragment;The Trained Tipolids and Desert Bakus of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF2B_SZ_A1] drop these. They are fragments of the souls of unjustly murdered Daevas.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_80148c
string.body: Energy of Greed;Energy you can obtain from the Salt Protrusion Starcrabs and Wasteland Abexes of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DF2B_SZ_A1]. They smell blood.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_WORLD_EVENT_ARENA_SCROLL_SHIELD_ALL_40A
string.body: Broken Crucible Mark;A sad-looking token with chipped corners. You can win one by completing Level 3 of the Empyrean Crucible.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_WORLD_EVENT_ARENA_SCROLL_SHIELD_ALL_50A
string.body: Shining Crucible Mark;A token that shines like a mirror. You can win one by completing Level 7 of the Empyrean Crucible.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_WORLD_EVENT_ARENA_SCROLL_SPEED_RUN_50A
string.body: Faded Crucible Mark;A token that has faded in the sun. You can win one by completing Level 2 of the Crucible Challenge.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_WORLD_EVENT_ARENA_SCROLL_SPEED_FLY_50A
string.body: Sparkling Crucible Mark;A shiny new sparkling token. You can win one by completing Level 4 of the Crucible Challenge.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_junk_world_event_webshop_01a
string.body: Pilit Headband;A headband decorated with joyous spring flowers. Free in the [%shoplink].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_junk_world_event_webshop_02a
string.body: Brax Gloves;Warm, strong gloves made of Brax leather. Free in the [%shoplink].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_10060b
string.body: Eye of Observation;A material vital for the construction of a Vigilance Core. You can get it from [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_T1_Monster_M_Flyingeye]s.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_10063a
string.body: Incarnation's Claw;The [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_T4_Tiamat_Crystal_Named_60_Af]'s massive scimitar-shaped talons, fine as razors. You can also get them by accepting [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Shugo_LDF4b_10]'s request.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_18703g
string.body: Marvellous Aether; Uniquely powerful Aether contained within the [%dic:STR_DIC_FOBJ_IDRaksha_mandali].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_18707A
string.body: Runeseal Stone;A stone infused by powerful magics, possessed by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_IDRaksha_02_DrakanMirrorNmd_60_Ae] and [%dic:STR_DIC_M_IDRaksha_03_DrakanFiremage_Nmd_60_Ae]. [%dic:STR_DIC_E_Raksha] was imprisoned with similar power.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_18711A
string.body: Paruam's Iris;A gooey bit of [%dic:STR_DIC_M_IDRaksha_4F_Evileye_Nmd_57_Ae]'s eye. Gee, won't the other Daevas be impressed?

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_10051A
string.body: Magic Core;A material carried by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4A_A2_IronGolem_57_An]s. The [%dic:STR_DIC_ILDF4a_FOBJ_Q10051] uses this material to channel its power.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_10053B
string.body: Power Crystal;Crystals that help [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Oriatia] maintain her formidable power, which have been stolen by the [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4A_C1_Elementalking_Cristal_57_An]s.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_11507A
string.body: Special Lunch Box;Not only does this lunch taste best when it is fresh, but it is more nutritious as well.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_11516A
string.body: Polished Crystal Ball;Some [%dic:STR_DIC_E_LDF4a_calydon_fam] Calydon carry these glossy crystal spheres.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_11517A
string.body: Jotun Record Plate;A stone plate decoding the secrets of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_B2_09] Jotun.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_20051A
string.body: Wave Battery;A potential power source for the [%dic:STR_DIC_ILDF4a_FOBJ_Q10051], carried by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4A_A2_ShulackFi_57_An]s and [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4A_A2_ShulackRa_57_An]s.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_21508A
string.body: Petralith Piece;A chunk of old Petralith that contains a key piece of technology. The rumour is that a [%dic:STR_DIC_E_LDF4a_calydon_fam] [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4A_A4_Tog_57_An] accidentally ate it.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_21510A
string.body: Hard Fruit;The bitter, mealy fruit of the [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4A_A4_Worm_Oasis_56_An] that grows in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_A1] oasis.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_21515A
string.body: Strigik Claw;The longest talon of a [%dic:STR_DIC_E_ldf4a_Owllau_fam] Strigik. They are impressively sharp, and sometimes used to tip Reian spears.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_41161A
string.body: Tough Brax Meat;Meat from a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4A_A1_Brax_DR_56_n]. This is a major component of the Redscale Hornskull's diet.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_41164A
string.body: Herbivorous Drana;This Drana contains the concentrated nutrients of plants. It can be found in areas of concetrated vegetable decay, such as [%dic:STR_DIC_FOBJ_soil_Q41164].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_41165A
string.body: Carnivorous Drana;This Drana is condensed from the nutrients in an animal's body. It occurs especially in corpses of [%dic:STR_DIC_FOBJ_halfcorpse]s.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_41171A
string.body: Shulack Combat Uniform;A standard uniform for [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4A_A2_ShulackFi_57_An]s and [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4A_A2_ShulackRa_57_An]s, emphasizing practicality and durability.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_41175A
string.body: Mamut Meat;A fresh, thick cut of [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4A_A2_mammoth_DR_57_An]. The meat is marbled with plenty of fat.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_41201A
string.body: Glowing Marble;This marble contains the light of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4A_B1_ElementalLightM_57_An] or a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4A_B1_ElementalLightF_57_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_41216A
string.body: Zayedan's Record;A mysterious device that stores information on [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Oriatia].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_41251A
string.body: Engraving Fragment;An engraving lovingly etched by [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Moraytia]'s husband, which she treasured until the [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4A_C1_Bookie_Crk_58_An] broke it and stole its fragments.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_41256A
string.body: Relic Fragment;Strange artefacts unearthed by the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_C1_000]'s heavings. They must have had some purpose, though it's no longer clear.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_41262A
string.body: Siel's Grail;A mysterious relic whose origin is lost to history. It could be vital to beating the Balaur, or some sort of land cultivation device, or just rusty old junk.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_41268A
string.body: Hornskull's Backbone;The vertebrae from a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4A_C2_SalivadoRed_58_An]. Simmered with chersnips, it makes a rich, oily broth.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_41269A
string.body: Pagati Shank;The leg of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4A_C2_Drakanstrider_wild_58_An]. Pagati is a lean, tough meat, so this cut is best braised.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_41302A
string.body: Pagati Egg;[%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4A_D_Drakanstrider_wild_58_An] incubate two to three eggs at a time, but it is rare for more than one to hatch.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_41304A
string.body: Pagati Call;This flute mimics the sound of a mother Pagati calling her offspring.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_41351A
string.body: Reversed Drakan Scale;Some [%dic:STR_DIC_E_Q41351all_1_1] have these mutated scales, which look similar to normal Balaur scales but have a duller sheen.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_41168A
string.body: Note Written in Blood;A note carried by a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4A_A2_DragonFly_57_An]. It may help you locate the missing Reian.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_41504a
string.body: Crushing Seed;A tiny grain of potent magic carried by the [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_T1_Skeletonre_58_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_41512a
string.body: Supplies;These supplies were in shiny metallic containers, so perhaps that is why the [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_T1_Dionaea_58_An] stole them.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_41520a
string.body: Transfiguration Fragment;An enchanted stone held by the [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_T2_Guardian_58_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_41528a
string.body: Frightcorn Filter: The porous stalk of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_T3_Corn_Spring_58_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_41530a
string.body: Transformation Stone;If used at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4b_SZ_T3_S9], it can transform nearby Dragonbound into Ribbits.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_41532a
string.body: Edible Meat;Apparently even ugly creatures like the [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_T3_Varanus_Spring_58_An]s are still made out of meat.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_41539a
string.body: Satra's Insignia;A mark of honour that [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_T4_Dragon_General_Named_60_Ae] wears around his neck.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_41540a
string.body: Powerful Aether Marble;A small, cloudy marble containing Aether energy. It resonates with the energy in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4b_SZ_T4_A2] area, creating a frequency that can shatter certain kinds of crystal.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_41543a
string.body: Caltrops Thorn;Short, curved thorns that grow beneath the [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_C1_Mimic_57_An]'s leaves.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_41543b
string.body: Gnarl's Moss;This thin, spongy moss grows on the branches of the [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_C1_Xipeto_57_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_41544a
string.body: Reian's Hair;The key ingredient in Davikik's magic potion. You can ask [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Ioran] for it.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_41545a
string.body: Transformation Dram;Davikik doesn't quite trust this potion, though he made it himself. Help him test it on other Gurriki before he uses it himself.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_41552a
string.body: Infinite Cage;A cage that's been magically enhanced so that it can contain an [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_C2_Enos_59_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_41553a
string.body: Copper Necklace;A simple necklace given to you by [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Shugo_LDF4b_16]. When dipped in the waters of the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4b_SZ_C2_S6], it becomes studded with stunning azurine crystals.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_41553b
string.body: Glittering Necklace;A necklace transformed from dull to dazzling in the rich waters of the Lapialus Mineral Lake. It's beautiful now, but what would another dip in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4b_SZ_C2_S6] do?

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_41554a
string.body: Sharp Crystal;A weapons material obtained from [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_C2_Silika_59_Ae].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_41556a
string.body: Kunati's Banner;A flag representing the group under [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_C3_Dragon_General2_Named_60_Ae]'s command.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_41558b
string.body: Astus' Journal;A journal kept by Wily Astus.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_ldf4b_questcomp_02
string.body: Trust Marble;A token given by [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Lumen] to signify his abiding trust in you.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_41561a
string.body: Essence of Remorse;A crystal carried deep within the breast of the dragon [%dic:STR_DIC_E_Raksha]. Inside, silver clouds swirl pensively.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_41562a
string.body: Vine Weapon;Cleverly-fashioned weapons carried by the [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4A_B1_BrohumBFi_57_An], [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4A_B1_BrohumGRa_57_An], [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4A_B1_BrohumMFi_57_An], and [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4A_B1_BrohumFRa_58_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_ldf4b_questcomp_01
string.body: Gilded Marble;A token that proves your personal abilities. You may trade these with [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Gneise] for a Malevite of Power.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_41564a
string.body: Vasharti's Seal;The seal of [%dic:STR_DIC_M_IDYun_Nmd_7Named_60_Ah] in Rentus Base.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_41565a
string.body: Traitor's Weapon;Weapons used by the [%dic:STR_DIC_M_Q39515all] at the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4b_SZ_T2_A3].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_41565b
string.body: Seal of Fanaticism;A seal given to Followers of the Balaur, who are gathered in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4b_SZ_T3_A3].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_41572a
string.body: Worg Skin;The thick, luxurious fur from a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_T2_Monster_Quest_Zaif].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_41574a
string.body: Orkanimum Essence;Essence you can capture from the slain [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_C2_Silika_59_Ae].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_ldf4b_weapon_upgrade_01
string.body: Upsorceller;Infused with magical power, this item can instantly upgrade a weapon. Speak to Grais to learn about this process.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_ldf4b_weapon_upgrade_02
string.body: Magical Aether Crystal;A powerful crystal held by [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Lumen], which can instantly upgrade a weapon.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_ldf4b_weapon_upgrade_03
string.body: Fusion Fragment;Capable of upgrading weapons, [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Ruaka] sells these in the Rancora Fortress.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_41584a
string.body: Mookie's Sap;A sap you can collect from [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_T1_Fungy_58_An]s that makes an ideal cleaning agent.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_41592a
string.body: Maintenance Tools;Tools for repairing the Reian Trebuchets. [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_T1_S3_DrakanFi_PagatiDrop_Destroy_58_An] have absconded with them, those scandalous reptilian rapscallions.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_41594a
string.body: Griffon Egg;An egg gathered from slaying a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_T1_Griffon_Crack_58_An]. Their yolks are bright orange and make impressive omelettes.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_41596a
string.body: Hard Ore;Ore mined and refined by the [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_T3_FanaticWorker_58_An]s--an excellent weapons material.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_41597a
string.body: Dragonbound Weapon;A weapon locked in the [%dic:STR_DIC_OBJ_LDF4b_FOBJ_Q41597A].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_12001a
string.body: Frillneck Rib Chop;A chop cut from the [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_T1_Frillfaimam_58_An]. The Reians like to pound these chops thin and pan-fry them.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_12011a
string.body: Zefirun's Mane;The mane of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_T2_Unicorn_58_An] in Edendell.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_12014a
string.body: Light Bead;A small glowing marble you can get from a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_T3_Elementallight_m_spring_58_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_12018a
string.body: Magic Power Crystal;An eerily-glowing crystal you can get from the [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_T4_YunFi_Ghost_59_An]s. They look substantial, but weigh nothing at all.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_tiamat_banner_01
string.body: Legionary's Epaulet;An epaulet carried by Naduka, Basrasa, and Satra Legionaries, along with some Balaur warriors elsewhere in Tiamaranta.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_12024a
string.body: Lindis's Ice Horn;This can be taken from a slain [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_C2_Fethlot_59_An]. Though it is horn, it looks like it should be made from ice or crystal.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_12026a
string.body: Protectorate Weapon;A weapon obtained from a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_C3_DrakanFi_Noble_60_Ae],a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_C3_DrakanSc_Noble_60_Ae], a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_C3_DrakanWi_Noble_60_Ae], or a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_C3_DrakanCl_Noble_60_Ae].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_12040a
string.body: Vitality Fragment;Fragments you can find on a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_T1_Fungy_58_An], [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_T2_Sam_58_An], [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_T3_Xipeto_Rage_58_An], or [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_T4_Twister_Aurora_60_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_22010a
string.body: Leaf Leg;The leg of an Edendell [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_T2_Spider_Leaf_58_An]. It's shaped like a leaf in order to help camoflage the Arachna.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_22012a
string.body: Lava Essence;A fire-filled essence you can sap from a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_T3_ElementalFire2_58_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_22014a
string.body: Organ Sac;The slimy, steaming organ sac of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_T3_Starfish_59_An]. Though fascinating to some natural scholars, and appetizing to a crazy few, it's hard to imagine wanting one of these.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_22018a
string.body: Magic Power Crystal;A crystal carried by [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_T4_YunWi_Ghost_59_An]s that gives off a malevolent aura. They look substantial, but weigh nothing at all.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_22023a
string.body: Brax Brisket;The tender brisket cut from a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_C1_Brax_57_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_22026a
string.body: Protectorate Insignia;An insignia carried by a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_C3_DrakanFi_Noble_60_Ae], [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_C3_DrakanSc_Noble_60_Ae], [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_C3_DrakanWi_Noble_60_Ae], or a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_C3_DrakanCl_Noble_60_Ae].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_22001a
string.body: Scolopen Poison;A poison you can take from the stinger of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4b_T1_Scorpion_Giant_58_An]. It is generally considered best to kill the creature first.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_junk_kahrun_quest_material
string.body: Information Officer's Seal;A seal sold by [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Equous] that indicates the authenticity of Sarpan promotional materials.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Lignt_HouseIllusionGate_G1
string.body: Homeward Bound;This skill opens a corridor leading directly to your front door. You're given this Skillbook when you purchase your first home.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_junk_od_fragment_sad_01
string.body: Vernal Flower Aether Ore;An Aether ore produced by Audria ore, which can be found in Oriel and may be produced by seasonal Agrints.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_junk_od_fragment_happy_01

string.body: Pearl Whelkus;These pearls are formed by the sealife in Pernon, and are occasionally recovered through essencetapping from fish and shellfish.

string.body: Aether Meteorite;Some mineral veins in the Pernon region are formed around these, and you can occasionally recover one when essencetapping from ores.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_junk_dailygather_plant_d_01
string.body: Cycle Flower;A genetic mutation unique to Pernon, these flowers can sometimes be recovered by essencetapping from plants.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_JUNK_CRYSTAL_SPRING_01
string.body: Spring Crystal;This crystal forms the heart of the Spring Agrint. When held to the light, it glows the pale green of new leaves. It is exceptionally rare and highly valuable to collectors.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_JUNK_CRYSTAL_SUMMER_01
string.body: Summer Crystal;This crystal forms the heart of the Summer Agrint. When held to the light, it glows the deep green of flourishing foliage. It is exceptionally rare and highly valuable to collectors.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_JUNK_CRYSTAL_FALL_01
string.body: Fall Crystal;This crystal forms the heart of the Fall Agrint. When held to the light, it glows a rich orange, like a harvest moon. It is exceptionally rare and highly valuable to collectors.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_JUNK_CRYSTAL_WINTER_01
string.body: Winter Crystal;This crystal forms the heart of the Winter Agrint. When held to the light, it gives off a spectrum from pale peach to silvery violet, like earliest sunrise. It is exceptionally rare and highly valuable to collectors.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_JUNK_LEAF_SPRING_01
string.body: Spring Leaf;A pale-green early leaf that covers the Spring Agrint.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_JUNK_LEAF_SUMMER_01
string.body: Summer Leaf;A broad, rich-green leaf that covers the Summer Agrint.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_JUNK_LEAF_FALL_01
string.body: Autumn Leaf;A brilliant red leaf that covers the Fall Agrint.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_JUNK_LEAF_WINTER_01
string.body: Winter Leaf;A faded-brown, brittle leaf that covers the Winter Agrint.

string.body: Minced Brax Meat;Brax and [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4A_D_SandShark_58_An] meats minced fine enough for a juvenile Pagati. In the wild, mother Pagatis regurgitate something similar to this for their young to eat.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF4a_Dandelion_Big
string.body: Giant Astriclox;Gigantic Astriclox flowers grow in the Wildflower Field. If jostled, their fluffy seeds split off and float away.

string.name: STR_DIC_N_LDF4a_Dandelion_Small
string.body: Astriclox Seed;This seed is tufted with dense white fluff, big enough to carry off a person if the wind is strong.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_18306All_1
string.body: Technological Prize;The personal belongings of a Sky Fortress worker, possibly containing Kaichin Engineering secrets. Workers who carry these include [%dic:STR_DIC_M_IDStation_01_GolemFi_Worker_58_n]s, [%dic:STR_DIC_M_IDStation_01_GolemKn_Worker_58_n]s, [%dic:STR_DIC_M_IDStation_01_GolemFi_Test_58_n]s, [%dic:STR_DIC_M_IDStation_01_ShulackFi_58_An]s, and [%dic:STR_DIC_M_IDStation_01_ShulackPr_58_An]s.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_11511_bottle
string.body: Deadly Poisonous Pollen;The pollen of the [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4A_A3_Dionae_DR_57_An]. It looks ordinary enough, but if ingested it can cause powerful hallucinations and even death.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_IDStation_FOBJ_S_BOX
string.body: Popuchin's Document Chest;A chest in which [%dic:STR_DIC_M_IDStation_ShulackFlight_NM_58_An] keeps important documents regarding the Sky Fortress.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_18302A
string.body: Sky Fortress Blueprint;A detailed blueprint of [%dic:STR_DIC_W_IDStation_SZ_Station], which [%dic:STR_DIC_M_IDStation_ShulackFlight_NM_58_An] keeps safe.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_21506_1
string.body: Feena Box;A box expected by the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF4a_SZ_B1_01] that contains much needed cargo.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Karuncoin
string.body: Kahrun's Symbol;A token granted by [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Kahrun] himself. It is given only to those who have shown great dedication to the safety of the Reian people through battle with the Balaur.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Q41253b
string.body: Modest Bloom;This flower is simple and pure-white, often laid on a grave as a symbol of abiding love.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Q41253a_flaower
string.body: Bunch of Simple Flowers;A bouquet of small, lovely flowers symbolic of abiding love.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Q41267a_bomb
string.body: Powerful Aether Bomb;A bomb made by [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Joubis]. Although crude, a bomb is still a bomb. Try not to drop it.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Q41270A_pagati
string.body: Pagati Soup;A rich, salty soup that is usually eaten with torn herbs. It might make [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Kinotia] feel better.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Q41257B_stone
string.body: Relics with Healing Power;These relics are blessed by Lady Yustiel, patron of Clerics and Chanters and guardian of life.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Q41300_pagati
string.body: Wild Pagati Reins;Reins used to break and tame wild Pagati.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Q41452B_WS
string.body: Truth Dagger;A dagger that used to sit at the waist of the Holy Statue. Its design is known only to Weaponsmithing Masters.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Q41452B_AS
string.body: Decorative Armour;Elegant armour to adorn the Holy Statue. The design is known to Armoursmithing Masters.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Q41452B_TA
string.body: Holy Insignia;An insignia that represents the Reian Tribe. Knowledgable Tailoring Masters know its design.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Q41452B_HA
string.body: Orb of Sacrifice;A beautiful sphere representing the rising sun, made in honour of Lady Siel's great sacrifice. Handicrafting Masters know its design.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Q41452B_AL
string.body: Empyrean Lady Siel's Essence;A decoction said to mimic the energies of the Empyrean Lady Siel. The best of the Alchemy Masters know how to make it.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Q41452B_CO
string.body: Bladder Glue;A high-quality glue made by processing rare fish bladders. Cooking Masters can make this.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Q41452B_ME
string.body: Elaborate Rack;A rack inlaid with different-colored woods in gorgeous Reian motifs. Construction Masters know how to make it.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Q41451a_1
string.body: Warm Fragrant Energy;An energy that gives off the scent of growth. It smells like springtime rain, or summer grass. You can get this from a [%dic:STR_DIC_E_househerb_Q41451_l] in Oriel, or a [%dic:STR_DIC_E_househerb_Q41451_d] in Pernon.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Q41451b_1
string.body: Cool Fragrant Energy;An energy that gives off the scent of delicate decay. It smells like piles of autumn leaves, or a crisp snowfall. You can take it from a [%dic:STR_DIC_E_househerb_Q41451_l2] in Oriel, or a [%dic:STR_DIC_E_househerb_Q41451_d2] in Pernon.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Q41452a_1
string.body: Shining Holy Statue of Siel;A complicated statue of Empyrean Lady Siel. You need all available crafting skills to make the [%dic:STR_DIC_E_Q41452_recip].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Q41453b_01
string.body: Noble Dew;Dew you can collect from [%dic:STR_DIC_E_Q41453_list] while wearing the [%dic:STR_DIC_I_Q41453a_01].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Q41454a_01

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Q41454a_02

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Q41453a_01
string.body: Shabby Ring;A tarnished old ring passed down through the Siel's Spear Legion for ages.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Q60devanion_01
string.body: Sign of Faith;An insignia that declares the wearer's faith in Lady Siel. You can buy one from [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Aughoetia].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Q60devanion_02
string.body: Sign of Strong Faith;An insignia that declares the wearer's strong faith in Lady Siel. You can buy one from [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Aughoetia].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Q60devanion_03
string.body: Sign of Earnest Faith;An insignia that declares the wearer's earnest faith in Lady Siel. You can buy one from [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Aughoetia].

string.body: Fortune Card;You can make this card from a [%dic:STR_DIC_I_ASSEMBLY_WORLD_EVENT_MATERIAL_CHINA_01A] and a [%dic:STR_DIC_I_ASSEMBLY_WORLD_EVENT_MATERIAL_CHINA_02A]. These cards are valuable to Fortunetellers, who will trade for them.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_ASSEMBLY_WORLD_EVENT_MATERIAL_EASTER_04A
string.body: Smooth Eggshell;An eggshell from a giant Pluma. You can obtain this by hunting during Easter.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_30602a
string.body: Dredgion Supplies;Get these supplies from the Supplies Storage room of the Terath Dredgion or from Shulack Drudges.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_HCOIN201A_BOX_04
string.body: Fortune Envelope;An envelope you can make by combining a [%dic:STR_DIC_I_ASSEMBLY_WORLD_EVENT_MATERIAL_CHINA_01A] and a [%dic:STR_DIC_I_ASSEMBLY_WORLD_EVENT_MATERIAL_CHINA_02A]. Open the envelope and you can obtain the precious [%dic:STR_DIC_I_WORLD_EVENT_COIN_AU_CCU_CHINA_01]. If you're lucky, you may also get useful consumables.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_WORLD_EVENT_COIN_AU_CCU_WORLD_01
string.body: Golden Stew;You can obtain this by opening a [%dic:STR_DIC_I_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_HCOIN202A_BOX_04]. Gather many bowls and take them to Kiryak or Varya, who will exchange them for a valuable gift.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_ASSEMBLY_WORLD_EVENT_MATERIAL_WORLD_01A
string.body: Golden Fragment;Bright, glittering fragment you can obtain by hunting.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_ASSEMBLY_WORLD_EVENT_MATERIAL_WORLD_02A
string.body: Tasty Grain;Grain blown about by the wind that is automatically collected in your inventory. You can almost taste the delicious recipes that can be made with it.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_HCOIN202A_BOX_04
string.body: Yellow Dough Pouch;A pouch you can make by combining a [%dic:STR_DIC_I_ASSEMBLY_WORLD_EVENT_MATERIAL_WORLD_01A] and [%dic:STR_DIC_I_ASSEMBLY_WORLD_EVENT_MATERIAL_WORLD_02A]. Open the pouch to find precious [%dic:STR_DIC_I_WORLD_EVENT_COIN_AU_CCU_WORLD_01]. If you're lucky, you may also get useful consumables.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_50007a
string.body: Granker's Bridle;A bridle restraining Red Nose Grankers near Oriel Plaza. Defeat a Granker restrained by this item, and you may get it for yourself.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_51007a
string.body: Granker's Bridle;A bridle restraining Red Nose Grankers near Pernon Plaza. Defeat a Granker restrained by this item, and you may get it for yourself.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_50011a
string.body: Sweet Chocolate;[%dic:STR_DIC_M_ValentineEvent_Brownie_Solo]s became jealous of the goodies and absconded with the chocolate. Defeat them to get it back.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_50012a
string.body: Very Bitter Chocolate;[%dic:STR_DIC_M_ValentineEvent_Shulack_Couple]s give this chocolate to their SOs. No one wants to eat it, though, since it fills the mouth with bitterness.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Quest_50017a
string.body: Fine Handmade Candy;An item that Shulacks tried to smuggle through [%dic:STR_DIC_E_FOBJ_Event_Cargobox] to give their sweethearts.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Quest_50018a
string.body: Loner Member Association Appreciation Shovel;A gift for the Loners, which was in the shipment of [%dic:STR_DIC_E_FOBJ_Event_Cargobox] scattered by Shulacks.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Pccafe_eventitem
string.body: Perseverance Scroll; An event item. You can earn three of these by serving your faction for over an hour.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Heart1
string.body: Right Half of a Broken Heart;This combines with the left half to make an exchangeable item. If you can't find the match, put your half in the Love Letterbox.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Heart2
string.body: Left Half of a Broken Heart;This combines with the right half to make an exchangeable item. If you can't find the match, put your half in the Love Letterbox.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_wingwar_coin
string.body: Lord's Scattered Fragments;You will receive these if you stay in Atreia for approximately one hour. Bring them to [%dic:STR_DIC_N_tinofos] and receive a reward.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_wingwar_coin_d
string.body: Lord's Scattered Fragments;You will receive these if you stay in Atreia for approximately one hour. Bring them to [%dic:STR_DIC_N_gildrof] and receive a reward.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Q41463_poty
string.body: Siel's Petal Bloom;You can obtain Siel's Petals from this bloom. Meticulous care is required as it is a very valuable bloom.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Q41463a
string.body: Siel's Petal[s];A sacred petal that contains the essence of Lady Siel. You can obtain it from the [%dic:STR_DIC_I_Q41463_poty].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Q41464a
string.body: Essence[s] of Rancour;An essence of concentrated rancour. You can obtain it from the [plur][%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4A_C1_Yun_undead_Fi_57_An] and [plur][%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF4A_C1_Yun_undead_Wi_57_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Q41466_shopmaterial
string.body: Mysterious Powder[s];Material used for making bright lightbeams. It will glow brightly if it comes into contact with DP. It is available from[%dic:STR_DIC_N_Safadorn].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Q41466a
string.body: Pure Light[s];There is a slight possibility that you will acquire this when you create bright lightbeams. An important material for Luminaciel Weapons.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Q41466b
string.body: Bright Light Beam[s];There is a slight possibility of acquiring pure light when producing bright light beams. The pattern can be obtained from [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Safadorn].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Q41467_shopmaterial
string.body: Activation booster;A booster required for collecting [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Q41467_od]. It is available from[%dic:STR_DIC_N_Safadorn].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Q41467a
string.body: Sacred Odium;Material for Luminaciel Weapons. You can obtain it by gathering[%dic:STR_DIC_N_Q41467_od].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Q41467b
string.body: Burning Sacred Odium;There is a slight possibility that you will acquire this when gathering [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Q41467_od].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_Q41468a
string.body: Sign of Faith;A sign indicating profound faith in Siel. It can be obtained from [%dic:STR_DIC_N_Aughoetia].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_event_worlddrop_1
string.body: Vitality of the Soul;Earn this by killing monsters all over Atreia during the Event. It is known to be an Alchemists' ingredient.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_event_worlddrop_2
string.body: Essence of Life;You will receive this by killing monsters all over throughout Atreia during the Event. It is known to be an Alchemists' ingredient.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_WORLD_EVENT_COIN_DEVASDAY_01
string.body: Aether Glow;Bright radiant Aether Glow; Elyos receive it at[%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF3_SZ_A1], in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LF4_SZ_OP], in Sarpan, in Tiamaranta or in the Abyss. Asmodians receive it in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_STR_DF3_SZ_A], in the Gelkmaros Stronhold, in Sarpan, in Tiamaranta or in the Abyss. Bring Aether Glow to [%dic:STR_DIC_N_EVENT_Happolia] or [%dic:STR_DIC_N_EVENT_Berdinea], and you will receive a candle in exchange that you can use on the[%dic:STR_DIC_N_World_Cake_of_Devas_Day_L].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_WORLD_EVENT_COIN_DEVASDAY_02
string.body: Lord's Crystal[pl:"Lord's Crystals"];Earn this crystal by staying in Atreia during the Event, killing monsters or doing favours for Israphel's delegation. Collect multiple crystals and bring them to Lord [%dic:STR_DIC_N_EVENT_Lupoise]'s and [%dic:STR_DIC_N_EVENT_Clantia]'s traders on [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA31] and at [%dic:STR_DIC_W_DC1_3] and receive various gifts.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_WORLD_EVENT_SCROLL_Devas_Day_L
string.body: Burning Candle[pl:"Burning Candles"];If you use it on the [%dic:STR_DIC_N_World_Cake_of_Devas_Day_L], the EP of all Daevas in your vicinity increases threefold.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_WORLD_EVENT_SCROLL_Devas_Day_L_02
string.body: Magic Candle[pl:"Magic Candles"];If you use it on the [%dic:STR_DIC_N_World_Cake_of_Devas_Day_L], the EP of all Daevas in your vicinity increases threefold.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_WORLD_EVENT_SCROLL_Devas_Day_L_03
string.body: Holy Candle Energy[pl:"Holy Candle Energies"];If you use this on the [%dic:STR_DIC_N_World_Cake_of_Devas_Day_L], you and all Daevas in the vicinity immediately recover 2000 GK points. Your attack speed increases by 10%% and your activation time for magic skills decreases by 10%% while in this status.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_vip_01a
string.body: Sign of Glory;Reward for being victorious in the Arena of Glory in the Crucible Coliseum.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_WORLD_EVENT_ITEM_FIRST_BEER
string.body: First-Rate Beer;A beer classified as first-rate by [%dic:STR_DIC_NPC_Octorung] because of its good taste and aroma. It has a strange effect. You feel rested and recover 50%% of Energy of Repose.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_WORLD_EVENT_ITEM_SECOND_BEER
string.body: Second-Rate Beer;A beer classified as second-rate by [%dic:STR_DIC_NPC_Octorung] because of its good taste and aroma. It has a strange effect. You feel rested and recover 20%% of Energy of Repose.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_WORLD_EVENT_ITEM_THIRD_BEER
string.body: Third-Rate Beer;A beer classified as third-rate by [%dic:STR_DIC_NPC_Octorung] because of its good taste and aroma. It has a strange effect. You feel rested and recover 10%% of Energy of Repose.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_WORLD_EVENT_ITEM_FOURTH_BEER
string.body: Partly Fermented Beer;A sample that [%dic:STR_DIC_NPC_Octorung] gives to Daevas who bring him wet barley. It tastes bitter, but it has a strange effect. You feel a little more rested and recover 5%% of Energy of Repose.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_WORLD_EVENT_COIN_REKLOV
string.body: Reklov Ticket[pl:"Reklov Tickets"];With this ticket, you can buy beer or the <Drunken Master> title from [%dic:STR_DIC_NPC_Reklov].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_WORLD_EVENT_COIN_NITRAM

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_80284A
string.body: Wet Barley;If you bring this to [%dic:STR_DIC_NPC_Octorung] in Sanctum or Pandaemonium, you will receive valuable rewards, such as a rare beer that can recover Energy of Repose. The barley will already be spoiled and useless when the Beer Festival begins.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_WORLD_EVENT_COIN_INGREDIENT
string.body: Well-Dried Barley;Barley that [%dic:STR_DIC_NPC_Octorung] has dried well. Bring it to the master brewer and exchange it for a ticket that you can use to buy valuable rewards, such as a rare beer that can recover Energy of Repose.

string.body: Energy Shield Absorber;Located in the interior of the [%dic:STR_DIC_M_IDTiamat_S2_StealthUnit_60_Ae]. It decreases the power of the energy shield.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_ASSEMBLY_WORLD_EVENT_INST_ITEM_MAP
string.body: Imperial Tomb Treasure Map;A map marking the locations where the Empire's treasures were hidden. There are four pieces in total. The map will only reveal its secrets when you have joined all four pieces. You will obtain the pieces by killing the [%dic:STR_DIC_M_IDEVENT01] or opening the [%dic:STR_DIC_I_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_INST_01_COIN_01] in the[%dic:STR_DIC_W_IDDF2flying_event01].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_INST_01_COIN_01

string.name: STR_DIC_I_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_INST_01_KEY_01
string.body: Ordinary Treasure Chest Key;A key wehich emanates a silver glow. It is needed to open the Treasure Chest in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_IDDF2flying_event01_Room]. As it emanates no magical power, it will disappear from your inventory as soon as you leave the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_IDDF2flying_event01].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_CASH_01_KEY_01

string.body: Contaminated Idgel Fragment;A small quantity of Idgel, extracted from contaminated Drakan. It seems to be useful for researching the cause of the Balaur contamination. This item can be obtained from [%dic:STR_DIC_E_LDF5b_B2_VriZomb].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_23021a
string.body: Research Report[pl:"Reports"];The research report of the Beritra Army's Intelligence Service, which contains information about the experiments in the [%dic:STR_DIC_W_LDF5b_SZ_B2]. [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF5B_B2_Vri2_Tanker_Fi_DD_65_An] carry this item on their person.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_23027a
string.body: BeritrAn insignia[pl:"Insignia"];An insignia worn by the soldiers in the Beritra army. You can take this item from [%dic:STR_DIC_E_LDF5b_B3_Vri].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_23031a
string.body: Purified Idgel;Idgel, purified by a magical force. It exudes particularly strong energy. It can be obtained by investigating in the [%dic:STR_DIC_N_LDF5b_FOBJ_D1_UnstableIdgel] area.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_23036a
string.body: Dragonbound Necklace;A sign of faith, worn by the members of the Dragonbound. [%dic:STR_DIC_E_LDF5b_D2_Vri_Fanatic] is in possession of this item.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_23037a
string.body: Kinah Pouch;A pouch used by Shugos to hold money. This item can be obtained by killing [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF5B_D2_Vri2_Fanatic_Fi_65_An].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_23041a
string.body: Shugo Kinah Pouch;Pouch used by Shugos to hold Kinah.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_23044a

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_23052a
string.body: Insignia of the Material Supplies Troop;An insignia that indicates members of the Beritra Army's Supplies Troop. You can take this item from members of the [%dic:STR_DIC_E_LDF5b_F123_Vri].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_23053c

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_23056a

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_23300a
string.body: Report about Idgel Experiments;A research report about the contaminated area of the 40th Legion. The report can be obtained from [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF5B_b2_Vri_Weabind_Ri_SN_NmdQ_65_Ae].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_23307a

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_23317a

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_23327a

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_23336a

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_23337a
string.body: List[pl:"Lists"] of Beritra War Materials;The status of the Beritra Army's war materials supply is noted on this list. This item can be taken from the [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF5B_f3_Vri2_Confuse_El_SN_NmdQ_65_Ae].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_23341a

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_23345a
string.body: Strategy Plan[pl:"Plans"] of the Murak Troop;A mission plan for the First Troop. The content is somewhat different to other mission plans. This item can be taken from [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF5B_f4_Vri_Confuse_El_SN_NmdQ_65_Ae].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_QUEST_13653a
string.body: Kataluna Healing Herb;A special cave plant that grows in the Katalam underground. It has extraordinary healing powers. This item can be obtained from [%dic:STR_DIC_N_OBJ_LDF5_Under_FOBJ_A1_Plant].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_doc_quest_12506a

string.body: Squishy Clodworm Innards;The innards of a [%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF5_Under_Clodworm_65_An]. No one would ever think of using them as an ingredient for food.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_13655a
string.body: Purified Idium Ore;The Idium Ore is digested, and thus purified, by the Klaw in the Katalam Underground. [plur][%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF5_Under_Neuth1_Worker_65_An] and [plur][%dic:STR_DIC_M_LDF5_Under_Neuth2_Abyss_65_An] carry it on their person.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_16930a
string.body: Part[pl:"Parts"] of Hyperion;A part of the ancient weapon of the Rune Tribe. You can find it in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_IDRuneweapon].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_26930a
string.body: Part[pl:"Parts"] of the Ancient Weapon;This is a part of Hyperion, the ancient weapon of the Rune Tribe. You can find this part of Hyperion in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_IDRuneweapon].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_16921a
string.body: Research Journal[pl:"Research Journals"] of the Rune Witch;The Rune Witch Grendal records her research in this journal. Her desire is to resurrect her beloved Narcis. She can be found in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_IDLDF5_Under_Rune] and always carries the book on her person.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_26921a
string.body: Tool Component[pl:"Components"] for Summoning Spirits;A tool used by the Rune Witch Grendal to resurrect her dead lover, Narcis. She is in [%dic:STR_DIC_W_IDLDF5_Under_Rune] and carries this object on her person.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_13510a
string.body: Katalam Conquest Diary;Obtain it by combining the [%dic:STR_DIC_I_quest_13511a] with the [%dic:STR_DIC_I_quest_13512a], [%dic:STR_DIC_I_quest_13513a] and the [%dic:STR_DIC_I_quest_13514a].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_13511a
string.body: First Patrol report;You receive this report when doing a special mission for [%dic:STR_DIC_N_LDF5A_Portis_E]. Combine this report with the [%dic:STR_DIC_I_quest_13512a], [%dic:STR_DIC_I_quest_13513a], and [%dic:STR_DIC_I_quest_13514a] to obtain the [%dic:STR_DIC_I_quest_13510a].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_quest_13512a

string.name: STR_DIC_I_item_Lotto_instance
string.body: Instant Win[pl:"Instant Wins"] from the Atreia Lottery;A scratch card issued by the Atreia Lottery. Carefully scratch off the silver coating to see the prize. Instant Wins come in three different types, [%dic:STR_DIC_I_item_Lotto_instance_300], [%dic:STR_DIC_I_item_Lotto_instance_100] and [%dic:STR_DIC_I_item_Lotto_instance_5].

string.name: STR_DIC_I_item_Lotto_instance_300
string.body: Mega Kinah 300;One of the [plur][%dic:STR_DIC_I_item_Lotto_instance]. You can buy up to 10 of these tickets per day for 1 million Kinah each. The first prize is 300 million Kinah, the second prize is 100 million Kinah, the third prize is 5 million Kinah, the fourth prize is 1.5 million Kinah and the fifth prize is 10,000 Kinah.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_item_Lotto_instance_100
string.body: Mega Kinah 100;One of the [plur][%dic:STR_DIC_I_item_Lotto_instance]. You can buy up to 20 of these tickets per day for 100,000 Kinah each. The first prize is 100 million Kinah, the second prize is 10 million Kinah, the third prize is 1 million Kinah, the fourth prize is 250,000 Kinah and the fifth prize is 100 Kinah.

string.name: STR_DIC_I_item_Lotto_instance_5
string.body: Mega Kinah 5;One of the [plur][%dic:STR_DIC_I_item_Lotto_instance]. You can buy up to 10 of these tickets per day for 1 million Kinah each. The first prize is 5 million Kinah, the second prize is 2.2 million Kinah, the third prize is 1.3 million Kinah, the fourth prize is 110,000 Kinah and the fifth prize is 100 Kinah.
